title: Edges Are All You Need: Robust Gait Recognition via Label-Free Structure
summary: Gait recognition is a non-intrusive biometric technique for security applications, yet existing studies are dominated by silhouette- and parsing-based representations. Silhouettes are sparse and miss internal structural details, limiting discriminability. Parsing enriches silhouettes with part-level structures, but relies heavily on upstream human parsers (e.g., label granularity and boundary precision), leading to unstable performance across datasets and sometimes even inferior results to silhouettes. We revisit gait representations from a structural perspective and describe a design space defined by edge density and supervision form: silhouettes use sparse boundary edges with weak single-label supervision, while parsing uses denser cues with strong semantic priors. In this space, we identify an underexplored paradigm: dense part-level structure without explicit semantic labels, and introduce SKETCH as a new visual modality for gait recognition. Sketch extracts high-frequency structural cues (e.g., limb articulations and self-occlusion contours) directly from RGB images via edge-based detectors in a label-free manner. We further show that label-guided parsing and label-free sketch are semantically decoupled and structurally complementary. Based on this, we propose SKETCHGAIT, a hierarchically disentangled multi-modal framework with two independent streams for modality-specific learning and a lightweight early-stage fusion branch to capture structural complementarity. Extensive experiments on SUSTech1K and CCPG validate the proposed modality and framework: SketchGait achieves 92.9% Rank-1 on SUSTech1K and 93.1% mean Rank-1 on CCPG.

AI.tldr: 提出SKETCHGAIT框架，使用无标签的密集边缘结构（SKETCH）作为步态识别新模态，结合解析模态实现层次解耦多模态学习，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有步态识别研究主要基于轮廓和解析表示，轮廓稀疏缺乏内部结构细节，解析依赖上游人体解析器导致性能不稳定。需要探索新的步态表示方法。
AI.method: 从结构视角重新审视步态表示，提出SKETCH作为新视觉模态，通过边缘检测器从RGB图像提取高频结构线索。设计SKETCHGAIT框架，包含两个独立模态流（解析和SKETCH）和轻量级早期融合分支。
AI.result: 在SUSTech1K数据集上达到92.9% Rank-1准确率，在CCPG数据集上达到93.1%平均Rank-1准确率，验证了SKETCH模态和框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SKETCH作为无标签的密集结构表示与标签引导的解析在语义上解耦、结构上互补，SKETCHGAIT框架通过层次解耦多模态学习有效提升了步态识别性能。

title: Thinking with Spatial Code for Physical-World Video Reasoning
summary: We introduce Thinking with Spatial Code, a framework that transforms RGB video into explicit, temporally coherent 3D representations for physical-world visual question answering. We highlight the empirical finding that our proposed spatial encoder can parse videos into structured spatial code with explicit 3D oriented bounding boxes and semantic labels, enabling large language models (LLMs) to reason directly over explicit spatial variables. Specifically, we propose the spatial encoder that encodes image and geometric features by unifying 6D object parsing and tracking backbones with geometric prediction, and we further finetuning LLMs with reinforcement learning using a spatial rubric reward that encourages perspective-aware, geometrically grounded inference. As a result, our model outperforms proprietary vision-language models on VSI-Bench, setting a new state-of-the-art. Code is available at https://github.com/Beckschen/spatialcode.

AI.tldr: 提出Thinking with Spatial Code框架，将RGB视频转换为显式的、时间一致的3D表示，用于物理世界视觉问答。通过空间编码器将视频解析为结构化空间代码（包含3D定向边界框和语义标签），使大语言模型能够直接基于显式空间变量进行推理。
AI.motivation: 解决物理世界视觉问答中需要深度理解3D空间关系和几何推理的问题。现有视觉语言模型在处理复杂空间推理时存在局限性，需要更显式的3D表示来支持精确的几何推理。
AI.method: 1. 提出空间编码器，统一6D物体解析和跟踪骨干网络与几何预测，编码图像和几何特征；2. 将RGB视频转换为结构化空间代码（包含3D定向边界框和语义标签）；3. 使用强化学习微调大语言模型，采用空间评分奖励机制，鼓励视角感知和几何基础的推理。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench基准测试中超越了专有视觉语言模型，创造了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视频转换为显式3D表示并让大语言模型直接基于空间变量推理，能够显著提升物理世界视觉问答的性能，证明了显式空间表示在复杂视觉推理任务中的重要性。

title: From Decoupled to Coupled: Robustness Verification for Learning-based Keypoint Detection with Joint Specifications
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2408.00117
summary: Keypoint detection underpins many vision tasks, including pose estimation, viewpoint recovery, and 3D reconstruction, yet modern neural models remain vulnerable to small input perturbations. Despite its importance, formal robustness verification for keypoint detectors is largely unexplored due to high-dimensional inputs and continuous coordinate outputs. We propose the first coupled robustness verification framework for heatmap-based keypoint detectors that bounds the joint deviation across all keypoints, capturing their interdependencies and downstream task requirements. Unlike prior decoupled, classification-style approaches that verify each keypoint independently and yield conservative guarantees, our method verifies collective behavior. We formulate verification as a falsification problem using a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) that combines reachable heatmap sets with a polytope encoding joint deviation constraints. Infeasibility certifies robustness, while feasibility provides counterexamples, and we prove the method is sound: if it certifies the model as robust, then the keypoint detection model is guaranteed to be robust. Experiments show that our coupled approach achieves high verified rates and remains effective under strict error thresholds where decoupled methods fail.

AI.tldr: 首个针对基于热图的关键点检测器的耦合鲁棒性验证框架，通过混合整数线性规划验证所有关键点的联合偏差，提供比解耦方法更强的鲁棒性保证
AI.motivation: 关键点检测是许多视觉任务的基础，但现代神经网络模型对输入扰动仍然脆弱。由于高维输入和连续坐标输出，关键点检测器的形式化鲁棒性验证尚未充分探索
AI.method: 提出耦合鲁棒性验证框架，将验证表述为使用混合整数线性规划（MILP）的证伪问题，结合可达热图集合和编码联合偏差约束的多面体
AI.result: 实验表明耦合方法在严格误差阈值下实现高验证率，而解耦方法失效；方法具有可靠性：如果认证模型鲁棒，则关键点检测模型保证鲁棒
AI.conclusion: 首个针对热图关键点检测器的耦合鲁棒性验证框架，能有效验证关键点间的相互依赖关系，为下游任务提供更强的鲁棒性保证

title: DreamCAD: Scaling Multi-modal CAD Generation using Differentiable Parametric Surfaces
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) relies on structured and editable geometric representations, yet existing generative methods are constrained by small annotated datasets with explicit design histories or boundary representation (BRep) labels. Meanwhile, millions of unannotated 3D meshes remain untapped, limiting progress in scalable CAD generation. To address this, we propose DreamCAD, a multi-modal generative framework that directly produces editable BReps from point-level supervision, without CAD-specific annotations. DreamCAD represents each BRep as a set of parametric patches (e.g., Bézier surfaces) and uses a differentiable tessellation method to generate meshes. This enables large-scale training on 3D datasets while reconstructing connected and editable surfaces. Furthermore, we introduce CADCap-1M, the largest CAD captioning dataset to date, with 1M+ descriptions generated using GPT-5 for advancing text-to-CAD research. DreamCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on ABC and Objaverse benchmarks across text, image, and point modalities, improving geometric fidelity and surpassing 75% user preference. Code and dataset will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DreamCAD：无需CAD标注的多模态生成框架，通过点级监督直接生成可编辑的BRep，并发布最大CAD标注数据集CADCap-1M
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成方法受限于小型标注数据集和显式设计历史或BRep标签，而数百万未标注的3D网格数据未被充分利用，限制了可扩展CAD生成的发展
AI.method: 将每个BRep表示为参数化曲面片集合，使用可微分细分方法生成网格，通过点级监督进行大规模训练，同时重建连接且可编辑的曲面
AI.result: 在ABC和Objaverse基准测试中，DreamCAD在文本、图像和点云模态上均达到最先进性能，几何保真度提升，用户偏好超过75%
AI.conclusion: DreamCAD通过点级监督实现可编辑BRep生成，无需CAD特定标注，并发布CADCap-1M数据集推动文本到CAD研究，代码和数据集将公开

title: Verify as You Go: An LLM-Powered Browser Extension for Fake News Detection
summary: The rampant spread of fake news in the digital age poses serious risks to public trust and democratic institutions, underscoring the need for effective, transparent, and user-centered detection tools. Existing browser extensions often fall short due to opaque model behavior, limited explanatory support, and a lack of meaningful user engagement. This paper introduces Aletheia, a novel browser extension that leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to detect fake news and provide evidence-based explanations. Aletheia further includes two interactive components: a Discussion Hub that enables user dialogue around flagged content and a Stay Informed feature that surfaces recent fact-checks. Through extensive experiments, we show that Aletheia outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in detection performance. Complementing this empirical evaluation, a complementary user study with 250 participants confirms the system's usability and perceived effectiveness, highlighting its potential as a transparent tool for combating online fake news.

AI.tldr: Aletheia是一个基于RAG和LLM的浏览器扩展，用于检测假新闻并提供证据解释，包含讨论中心和及时信息功能，在检测性能和用户体验方面均优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: 数字时代假新闻的泛滥严重威胁公众信任和民主制度，现有浏览器扩展存在模型行为不透明、解释支持有限、用户参与度不足等问题，需要开发更有效、透明和以用户为中心的工具。
AI.method: 提出Aletheia浏览器扩展，采用检索增强生成（RAG）和大语言模型（LLM）检测假新闻并提供基于证据的解释；包含两个交互组件：讨论中心（用户围绕标记内容进行对话）和及时信息功能（展示近期事实核查）。
AI.result: 通过大量实验证明Aletheia在检测性能上优于最先进的基线方法；补充性用户研究（250名参与者）证实了系统的可用性和感知有效性。
AI.conclusion: Aletheia作为一个透明工具，在打击在线假新闻方面具有潜力，通过结合先进检测技术和用户参与功能，为假新闻检测提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents
summary: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for spatial reasoning and 3D scene layout generation from open-ended language instructions. However, generating layouts that are not only semantically coherent but also feasible for interaction by embodied agents remains challenging, particularly in physically constrained indoor environments. In this paper, RoboLayout is introduced as an extension of LayoutVLM that augments the original framework with agent-aware reasoning and improved optimization stability. RoboLayout integrates explicit reachability constraints into a differentiable layout optimization process, enabling the generation of layouts that are navigable and actionable by embodied agents. Importantly, the agent abstraction is not limited to a specific robot platform and can represent diverse entities with distinct physical capabilities, such as service robots, warehouse robots, humans of different age groups, or animals, allowing environment design to be tailored to the intended agent. In addition, a local refinement stage is proposed that selectively reoptimizes problematic object placements while keeping the remainder of the scene fixed, improving convergence efficiency without increasing global optimization iterations. Overall, RoboLayout preserves the strong semantic alignment and physical plausibility of LayoutVLM while enhancing applicability to agent-centric indoor scene generation, as demonstrated by experimental results across diverse scene configurations.

AI.tldr: RoboLayout扩展了LayoutVLM，通过集成显式可达性约束和局部细化阶段，生成适合具身智能体交互的室内场景布局
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在空间推理和3D场景布局生成方面表现出色，但生成的布局往往缺乏对具身智能体交互可行性的考虑，特别是在物理受限的室内环境中。需要一种既能保持语义连贯性，又能确保智能体可导航和可操作的布局生成方法。
AI.method: RoboLayout在LayoutVLM基础上扩展，集成了显式可达性约束到可微分布局优化过程中，支持多种具身智能体（服务机器人、仓库机器人、不同年龄段人类、动物等）。此外，提出了局部细化阶段，选择性重新优化问题对象放置，同时保持场景其余部分固定，提高收敛效率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RoboLayout在保持LayoutVVM强语义对齐和物理合理性的同时，增强了面向智能体中心的室内场景生成适用性。该方法能够生成适合不同具身智能体交互的布局，并在多种场景配置中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: RoboLayout成功地将具身智能体感知推理集成到布局生成框架中，通过可达性约束和局部优化策略，实现了既语义连贯又交互可行的室内场景布局生成，为面向智能体的环境设计提供了有效解决方案。

title: Adversarial Batch Representation Augmentation for Batch Correction in High-Content Cellular Screening
summary: High-Content Screening routinely generates massive volumes of cell painting images for phenotypic profiling. However, technical variations across experimental executions inevitably induce biological batch (bio-batch) effects. These cause covariate shifts and degrade the generalization of deep learning models on unseen data. Existing batch correction methods typically rely on additional prior knowledge (e.g., treatment or cell culture information) or struggle to generalize to unseen bio-batches. In this work, we frame bio-batch mitigation as a Domain Generalization (DG) problem and propose Adversarial Batch Representation Augmentation (ABRA). ABRA explicitly models batch-wise statistical fluctuations by parameterizing feature statistics as structured uncertainties. Through a min-max optimization framework, it actively synthesizes worst-case bio-batch perturbations in the representation space, guided by a strict angular geometric margin to preserve fine-grained class discriminability. To prevent representation collapse during this adversarial exploration, we introduce a synergistic distribution alignment objective. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale RxRx1 and RxRx1-WILDS benchmarks demonstrate that ABRA establishes a new state-of-the-art for siRNA perturbation classification.

AI.tldr: 提出ABRA方法，通过对抗性批量表示增强解决细胞成像中的生物批次效应问题，在RxRx1和RxRx1-WILDS基准测试中取得最先进性能
AI.motivation: 高通量筛选产生大量细胞成像数据，但实验执行中的技术变异导致生物批次效应，引起协变量偏移并降低深度学习模型在未见数据上的泛化能力。现有批次校正方法通常需要额外先验知识或难以泛化到未见生物批次。
AI.method: 将生物批次缓解问题框架化为领域泛化问题，提出对抗性批量表示增强方法。通过参数化特征统计量为结构化不确定性来显式建模批次间统计波动，使用最小-最大优化框架在表示空间中主动合成最坏情况生物批次扰动，通过严格的角几何边界保持细粒度类别可区分性，并引入协同分布对齐目标防止表示崩溃。
AI.result: 在大型RxRx1和RxRx1-WILDS基准测试上进行广泛评估，证明ABRA在siRNA扰动分类任务中建立了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: ABRA方法有效解决了细胞成像中的生物批次效应问题，通过对抗性表示增强和分布对齐实现了更好的领域泛化能力，为高通量筛选数据分析提供了有效解决方案。

title: Attention Meets Reachability: Structural Equivalence and Efficiency in Grammar-Constrained LLM Decoding
summary: We study grammar-constrained decoding (GCD) as a coupling between an autoregressive next-token distribution and a reachability oracle over a pushdown system compiled from a context-free grammar (CFG). We prove an oracle invariance theorem: language-equivalent grammars induce identical admissible next-token sets for every prefix, hence identical logit masks, yet can yield provably different compiled state spaces and online ambiguity costs. We give exact control-state blowup counts for the canonical $a^n b^n$ language under redundant nonterminal delegation, and introduce a left-to-right structural ambiguity cost (SAC) measuring incremental packed-parse-forest growth per token. For two equivalent grammars over all finite strings, SAC is $O(1)$ per token under right-recursion but $Θ(t^2)$ per token and $Θ(n^3)$ cumulatively under concatenation. We establish engine-independent lower bounds: any sound, retrieval-efficient, parse-preserving online masking engine must incur $Ω(t^2)$ work per token on a specific constant-size CFG family, unconditionally within this model. We define decoding-cost equivalence classes of grammars and prove existence of minimal-SAC representatives within bounded rewrite families. Finally, we characterize the true conditional sampler via a Doob $h$-transform and derive sharp one-step KL and total-variation distortion bounds for hard-masked decoding in terms of survival-probability spread among admissible next tokens. We integrate these results with Transformer and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, derive latency envelopes in terms of vocabulary size, active state sets, and beam width, and connect SAC to instrumentation-based predictive performance models and automated grammar optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语法约束解码(GCD)作为自回归下一个token分布与基于上下文无关文法(CFG)编译的下推系统可达性预言之间的耦合，证明了预言不变性定理，分析了状态空间爆炸和结构歧义成本，建立了引擎无关的下界，并推导了硬掩码解码的KL散度和总变差失真界限。
AI.motivation: 研究语法约束解码中不同但语言等价的文法如何影响编译状态空间和在线解码成本，探索文法优化以减少解码延迟并提高效率。
AI.method: 将GCD建模为自回归下一个token分布与CFG编译的下推系统可达性预言的耦合，提出结构歧义成本(SAC)度量每个token的增量打包解析森林增长，分析文法等价类的解码成本，推导硬掩码解码的失真界限。
AI.result: 证明了预言不变性定理：语言等价的文法产生相同的下一个token掩码但不同的编译状态空间；给出了$a^n b^n$语言在冗余非终结符委托下的精确状态爆炸计数；发现右递归下SAC为O(1)每token，而连接下为Θ(t²)每token；建立了任何在线掩码引擎在特定CFG族上必须承担Ω(t²)每token工作的下界。
AI.conclusion: 文法选择显著影响语法约束解码的计算成本，存在最小SAC的代表文法，硬掩码解码的失真界限与可接受下一个token的生存概率分布相关，这些结果可集成到Transformer和MoE架构中用于延迟分析和文法优化。

title: Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum
summary: Real-time AI services increasingly operate across the device-edge-cloud continuum, where autonomous AI agents generate latency-sensitive workloads, orchestrate multi-stage processing pipelines, and compete for shared resources under policy and governance constraints. This article shows that the structure of service-dependency graphs, modelled as DAGs whose nodes represent compute stages and whose edges encode execution ordering, is a primary determinant of whether decentralised, price-based resource allocation can work reliably at scale. When dependency graphs are hierarchical (tree or series-parallel), prices converge to stable equilibria, optimal allocations can be computed efficiently, and under appropriate mechanism design (with quasilinear utilities and discrete slice items), agents have no incentive to misreport their valuations within each decision epoch. When dependencies are more complex, with cross-cutting ties between pipeline stages, prices oscillate, allocation quality degrades, and the system becomes difficult to manage. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid management architecture in which cross-domain integrators encapsulate complex sub-graphs into resource slices that present a simpler, well-structured interface to the rest of the market. A systematic ablation study across six experiments (1,620 runs, 10 seeds each) confirms that (i) dependency-graph topology is a first-order determinant of price stability and scalability,(ii) the hybrid architecture reduces price volatility by up to 70-75% without sacrificing throughput, (iii) governance constraints create quantifiable efficiency-compliance trade-offs that depend jointly on topology and load, and (iv) under truthful bidding the decentralised market matches a centralised value-optimal baseline, confirming that decentralised coordination can replicate centralised allocation quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在设备-边缘-云连续体中的实时AI服务资源分配问题，发现服务依赖图的结构是决定去中心化价格机制能否可靠扩展的关键因素。树状或串并联的层次化依赖图能实现稳定均衡，而复杂交叉依赖会导致价格振荡。作者提出了一种混合管理架构来封装复杂子图，实验证明该架构能显著降低价格波动。
AI.motivation: 随着实时AI服务在设备-边缘-云连续体中的普及，自主AI代理生成延迟敏感的工作负载，编排多阶段处理流水线，并在策略和治理约束下竞争共享资源。当前面临的主要挑战是：去中心化、基于价格的资源分配机制在复杂服务依赖关系下能否可靠扩展。
AI.method: 将服务依赖关系建模为DAG（有向无环图），其中节点表示计算阶段，边编码执行顺序。提出混合管理架构，通过跨域集成器将复杂子图封装为资源切片，向市场呈现更简单、结构良好的接口。进行了系统消融研究，包含6个实验（1,620次运行，每个10个种子）。
AI.result: 1) 依赖图拓扑是价格稳定性和可扩展性的首要决定因素；2) 混合架构将价格波动降低70-75%而不牺牲吞吐量；3) 治理约束产生可量化的效率-合规权衡，取决于拓扑和负载；4) 在诚实出价下，去中心化市场能与集中化价值最优基线匹配。
AI.conclusion: 服务依赖图的结构是决定去中心化价格机制能否有效工作的关键。对于层次化依赖图，价格机制表现良好；对于复杂交叉依赖，需要混合架构来封装复杂性。去中心化协调能够复制集中化分配质量，但需要适当的结构设计和机制设计。

title: NOTAI.AI: Explainable Detection of Machine-Generated Text via Curvature and Feature Attribution
summary: We present NOTAI.AI, an explainable framework for machine-generated text detection that extends Fast-DetectGPT by integrating curvature-based signals with neural and stylometric features in a supervised setting. The system combines 17 interpretable features, including Conditional Probability Curvature, ModernBERT detector score, readability metrics, and stylometric cues, within a gradient-boosted tree (XGBoost) meta-classifier to determine whether a text is human- or AI-generated. Furthermore, NOTAI.AI applies Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) to provide both local and global feature-level attribution. These attributions are further translated into structured natural-language rationales through an LLM-based explanation layer, which enables user-facing interpretability. The system is deployed as an interactive web application that supports real-time analysis, visual feature inspection, and structured evidence presentation. A web interface allows users to input text and inspect how neural and statistical signals influence the final decision. The source code and demo video are publicly available to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: NOTAI.AI是一个可解释的AI文本检测框架，通过结合曲率信号、神经特征和文体特征，使用XGBoost元分类器检测机器生成文本，并提供SHAP解释和自然语言推理。
AI.motivation: 开发一个可解释的机器生成文本检测系统，不仅能够准确识别AI生成的文本，还能提供透明、可理解的决策依据，增强用户对检测结果的信任和理解。
AI.method: 扩展Fast-DetectGPT方法，整合17个可解释特征（包括条件概率曲率、ModernBERT检测器分数、可读性指标和文体线索），使用XGBoost梯度提升树作为元分类器，并应用SHAP进行特征归因，最后通过LLM生成自然语言解释。
AI.result: 开发了一个交互式Web应用程序，支持实时分析、可视化特征检查和结构化证据展示，源代码和演示视频已公开以支持可重复性。
AI.conclusion: NOTAI.AI提供了一个全面、可解释的AI文本检测框架，通过多特征融合和透明解释机制，在保持检测准确性的同时增强了系统的可信度和用户友好性。

title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting misbehaviors and understanding the motivations of modern reasoning models. However, if models can control what they verbalize in their CoT, it could undermine CoT monitorability. To measure this undesirable capability -- CoT controllability -- we introduce the CoT-Control evaluation suite, which includes tasks that require models to solve problems while adhering to CoT instructions, e.g., reasoning about a genetics question without using the word 'chromosome'. We show that reasoning models possess significantly lower CoT controllability than output controllability; for instance, Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control its CoT only 2.7% of the time but 61.9% when controlling its final output. We also find that CoT controllability is higher for larger models and decreases with more RL training, test-time compute, and increased problem difficulty. CoT controllability failures extend even to situations in which models are given incentives (as opposed to direct requests) to evade CoT monitors, although models exhibit slightly higher controllability when they are told they are being monitored. Similarly, eliciting controllability by adversarially optimizing prompts does not meaningfully increase controllability. Our results leave us cautiously optimistic that CoT controllability is currently unlikely to be a failure mode of CoT monitorability. However, the mechanism behind low controllability is not well understood. Given its importance for maintaining CoT monitorability, we recommend that frontier labs track CoT controllability in future models.

AI.tldr: 研究评估大语言模型控制思维链内容的能力，发现模型对思维链的控制能力远低于对最终输出的控制能力，且受模型大小、训练方式等因素影响。
AI.motivation: 思维链监控是检测模型不当行为和理解其推理过程的重要工具，但如果模型能够控制思维链中的内容，就会破坏思维链的可监控性。研究旨在测量这种不良能力——思维链可控性。
AI.method: 引入CoT-Control评估套件，包含需要模型在遵循思维链指令的同时解决问题的任务（例如在不使用"染色体"一词的情况下回答遗传学问题）。评估不同模型在多种条件下的表现。
AI.result: 推理模型的思维链可控性显著低于输出可控性（Claude Sonnet 4.5的思维链可控性仅为2.7%，而输出可控性为61.9%）。可控性随模型增大而提高，但随更多RL训练、测试时计算和问题难度增加而降低。即使给予激励，模型也难以控制思维链。
AI.conclusion: 目前思维链可控性不太可能成为思维链监控的失效模式，但低可控性的机制尚不清楚。建议前沿实验室在未来模型中跟踪思维链可控性，以维护思维链监控的有效性。

title: Rethinking Concept Bottleneck Models: From Pitfalls to Solutions
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) ground predictions in human-understandable concepts but face fundamental limitations: the absence of a metric to pre-evaluate concept relevance, the "linearity problem" causing recent CBMs to bypass the concept bottleneck entirely, an accuracy gap compared to opaque models, and finally the lack of systematic study on the impact of different visual backbones and VLMs. We introduce CBM-Suite, a methodological framework to systematically addresses these challenges. First, we propose an entropy-based metric to quantify the intrinsic suitability of a concept set for a given dataset. Second, we resolve the linearity problem by inserting a non-linear layer between concept activations and the classifier, which ensures that model accuracy faithfully reflects concept relevance. Third, we narrow the accuracy gap by leveraging a distillation loss guided by a linear teacher probe. Finally, we provide comprehensive analyses on how different vision encoders, vision-language models, and concept sets interact to influence accuracy and interpretability in CBMs. Extensive evaluations show that CBM-Suite yields more accurate models and provides insights for improving concept-based interpretability.

AI.tldr: CBM-Suite框架解决了概念瓶颈模型的四个核心问题：概念相关性预评估指标、线性化问题、准确率差距，以及不同视觉骨干和视觉语言模型的系统性分析。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型虽然基于人类可理解的概念进行预测，但存在四个基本限制：缺乏预评估概念相关性的指标、线性化问题导致模型绕过概念瓶颈、与不透明模型存在准确率差距、缺乏对不同视觉骨干和视觉语言模型影响的系统性研究。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于熵的指标来量化概念集对特定数据集的固有适用性；2. 通过在概念激活和分类器之间插入非线性层来解决线性化问题；3. 使用线性教师探针引导的蒸馏损失来缩小准确率差距；4. 提供关于不同视觉编码器、视觉语言模型和概念集如何影响CBM准确率和可解释性的全面分析。
AI.result: 广泛的评估表明，CBM-Suite能够产生更准确的模型，并为改进基于概念的可解释性提供见解。
AI.conclusion: CBM-Suite是一个方法论框架，系统地解决了概念瓶颈模型的关键挑战，通过引入新的评估指标、解决线性化问题、缩小准确率差距，并提供对不同模型组件的系统性分析，从而提高了概念瓶颈模型的准确性和可解释性。

title: Safer Reasoning Traces: Measuring and Mitigating Chain-of-Thought Leakage in LLMs
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning but can increase privacy risk by resurfacing personally identifiable information (PII) from the prompt into reasoning traces and outputs, even under policies that instruct the model not to restate PII. We study such direct, inference-time PII leakage using a model-agnostic framework that (i) defines leakage as risk-weighted, token-level events across 11 PII types, (ii) traces leakage curves as a function of the allowed CoT budget, and (iii) compares open- and closed-source model families on a structured PII dataset with a hierarchical risk taxonomy. We find that CoT consistently elevates leakage, especially for high-risk categories, and that leakage is strongly family- and budget-dependent. Increasing the reasoning budget can either amplify or attenuate leakage depending on the base model. We then benchmark lightweight inference-time gatekeepers: a rule-based detector, a TF-IDF + logistic regression classifier, a GLiNER-based NER model, and an LLM-as-judge, using risk-weighted F1, Macro-F1, and recall. No single method dominates across models or budgets, motivating hybrid, style-adaptive gatekeeping policies that balance utility and risk under a common, reproducible protocol.

AI.tldr: CoT提示提升LLM推理能力但增加隐私风险，使PII从提示泄露到推理轨迹和输出中。研究提出模型无关框架量化泄漏风险，发现CoT持续增加泄漏，特别是高风险类别，泄漏程度受模型家族和推理预算影响。评估多种轻量级检测方法，无单一方法在所有场景下最优，需混合自适应策略平衡效用与风险。
AI.motivation: CoT提示虽然能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但会增加隐私风险，即使模型被指示不要复述PII，个人身份信息仍可能从提示泄露到推理轨迹和输出中。需要系统研究这种推理时的直接PII泄漏问题。
AI.method: 提出模型无关框架：(1)将泄漏定义为跨11种PII类型的风险加权、令牌级事件；(2)追踪泄漏曲线随CoT预算的变化；(3)在结构化PII数据集上比较开源和闭源模型家族，使用分层风险分类法。评估四种轻量级推理时门控方法：基于规则的检测器、TF-IDF+逻辑回归分类器、GLiNER-based NER模型和LLM-as-judge。
AI.result: CoT持续增加PII泄漏，特别是高风险类别；泄漏程度强烈依赖于模型家族和推理预算；增加推理预算可能放大或减弱泄漏，取决于基础模型。在评估的检测方法中，没有单一方法在所有模型或预算下表现最优，风险加权F1、Macro-F1和召回率各有优劣。
AI.conclusion: 需要混合、风格自适应的门控策略来平衡效用与风险，在通用、可复现的协议下管理CoT提示带来的隐私风险。研究为理解和管理LLM推理中的PII泄漏提供了系统框架。

title: Making Reconstruction FID Predictive of Diffusion Generation FID
summary: It is well known that the reconstruction FID (rFID) of a VAE is poorly correlated with the generation FID (gFID) of a latent diffusion model. We propose interpolated FID (iFID), a simple variant of rFID that exhibits a strong correlation with gFID. Specifically, for each element in the dataset, we retrieve its nearest neighbor (NN) in the latent space and interpolate their latent representations. We then decode the interpolated latent and compute the FID between the decoded samples and the original dataset. Additionally, we refine the claim that rFID correlates poorly with gFID, by showing that rFID correlates with sample quality in the diffusion refinement phase, whereas iFID correlates with sample quality in the diffusion navigation phase. Furthermore, we provide an explanation for why iFID correlates well with gFID, and why reconstruction metrics are negatively correlated with gFID, by connecting to results in the diffusion generalization and hallucination. Empirically, iFID is the first metric to demonstrate a strong correlation with diffusion gFID, achieving Pearson linear and Spearman rank correlations approximately 0.85. The source code is provided in https://github.com/tongdaxu/Making-rFID-Predictive-of-Diffusion-gFID.

AI.tldr: 提出iFID（插值FID），一种改进的rFID变体，能有效预测扩散模型的生成质量，解决了传统重建FID与扩散生成FID相关性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统VAE重建FID（rFID）与潜在扩散模型生成FID（gFID）相关性很差，需要一种能准确预测扩散模型生成质量的评估指标。
AI.method: 提出iFID方法：对数据集中的每个元素，在潜在空间中检索其最近邻，插值它们的潜在表示，然后解码插值后的潜在向量，计算解码样本与原始数据集的FID。
AI.result: iFID与扩散gFID呈现强相关性（Pearson线性相关和Spearman秩相关约0.85），是首个能有效预测扩散生成质量的指标。同时澄清了rFID与扩散细化阶段质量相关，而iFID与扩散导航阶段质量相关。
AI.conclusion: iFID是一种简单有效的评估指标，能准确预测潜在扩散模型的生成质量，为模型评估提供了新的视角，并通过连接扩散泛化和幻觉现象解释了其有效性。

title: The Fragility Of Moral Judgment In Large Language Models
summary:
People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for everyday moral and interpersonal guidance, yet these systems cannot interrogate missing context and judge dilemmas as presented. We introduce a perturbation framework for testing the stability and manipulability of LLM moral judgments while holding the underlying moral conflict constant. Using 2,939 dilemmas from r/AmItheAsshole (January-March 2025), we generate three families of content perturbations: surface edits (lexical/structural noise), point-of-view shifts (voice and stance neutralization), and persuasion cues (self-positioning, social proof, pattern admissions, victim framing). We also vary the evaluation protocol (output ordering, instruction placement, and unstructured prompting). We evaluated all variants with four models (GPT-4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek V3, Qwen2.5-72B) (N=129,156 judgments).
  Surface perturbations produce low flip rates (7.5%), largely within the self-consistency noise floor (4-13%), whereas point-of-view shifts induce substantially higher instability (24.3%). A large subset of dilemmas (37.9%) is robust to surface noise yet flips under perspective changes, indicating that models condition on narrative voice as a pragmatic cue. Instability concentrates in morally ambiguous cases; scenarios where no party is assigned blame are most susceptible. Persuasion perturbations yield systematic directional shifts. Protocol choices dominate all other factors: agreement between structured protocols is only 67.6% (kappa=0.55), and only 35.7% of model-scenario units match across all three protocols. These results show that LLM moral judgments are co-produced by narrative form and task scaffolding, raising reproducibility and equity concerns when outcomes depend on presentation skill rather than moral substance.

AI.tldr: 研究通过扰动框架测试LLM道德判断的稳定性，发现视角转换比表面编辑更容易改变判断结果，评估协议选择是影响判断的最主要因素。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地使用大型语言模型进行日常道德和人际指导，但这些系统无法审视缺失的背景信息，只能基于呈现的困境进行判断。需要测试LLM道德判断的稳定性和可操纵性。
AI.method: 引入扰动框架测试LLM道德判断稳定性，使用2,939个来自r/AmItheAsshole的道德困境，生成三类内容扰动：表面编辑、视角转换和说服线索。同时改变评估协议（输出顺序、指令位置和非结构化提示）。使用四个模型进行评估。
AI.result: 表面扰动产生低翻转率（7.5%），视角转换导致显著更高的不稳定性（24.3%）。37.9%的困境对表面噪声稳健但在视角变化下翻转。说服扰动产生系统性方向性变化。协议选择是最主要影响因素：结构化协议间一致性仅67.6%。
AI.conclusion: LLM道德判断是由叙事形式和任务框架共同产生的，当结果依赖于呈现技巧而非道德实质时，会引发可重复性和公平性担忧。

title: The World Won't Stay Still: Programmable Evolution for Agent Benchmarks
summary: LLM-powered agents fulfill user requests by interacting with environments, querying data, and invoking tools in a multi-turn process. Yet, most existing benchmarks assume static environments with fixed schemas and toolsets, neglecting the evolutionary nature of the real world and agents' robustness to environmental changes. In this paper, we study a crucial problem: how to evolve the agent environment in a scalable and controllable way, thereby better evaluating agents' adaptability to real-world dynamics. We propose ProEvolve, a graph-based framework that makes environment evolution programmable. At its core, a typed relational graph provides a unified, explicit representation of the environment: data, tools, and schema. Under this formalism, adding, removing, or modifying capabilities are expressed as graph transformations that coherently propagate updates across tools, schemas, and data access. Building on this, ProEvolve can (1) program the evolutionary dynamics as graph transformations to generate environments automatically, and (2) instantiate task sandboxes via subgraph sampling and programming. We validate ProEvolve by evolving a single environment into 200 environments and 3,000 task sandboxes, and benchmark representative agents accordingly.

AI.tldr: ProEvolve是一个基于图的框架，用于以可编程方式演化LLM代理环境，通过图变换自动生成多样化环境，评估代理对现实世界动态变化的适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试大多假设静态环境，忽略了现实世界的演化特性，无法有效评估代理对环境变化的适应能力。需要一种可扩展、可控的环境演化方法来更好地评估代理在动态现实世界中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出ProEvolve框架，使用类型化关系图统一表示环境的数据、工具和模式。通过图变换（添加、删除、修改能力）来编程环境演化动态，并通过子图采样和编程实例化任务沙箱。
AI.result: 将单个环境演化成200个环境和3000个任务沙箱，并据此对代表性代理进行基准测试，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ProEvolve提供了一种可编程的环境演化方法，能够生成多样化的动态环境，更好地评估LLM代理在现实世界变化中的适应能力。

title: When Rubrics Fail: Error Enumeration as Reward in Reference-Free RL Post-Training for Virtual Try-On
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) have driven strong gains in domains with clear correctness signals and even in subjective domains by synthesizing evaluation criteria from ideal reference answers. But many real-world tasks admit multiple valid outputs and lack the single ideal answer that rubric generation depends on. We identify this reference-free setting as a gap in current post-training methods and propose Implicit Error Counting (IEC) to fill it. Instead of checking what a response gets right against a rubric, IEC enumerates what it gets wrong, applying severity-weighted scores across task-relevant axes and converting them into calibrated per-aspect rewards. We show that naïve explicit enumeration is too noisy for stable optimization, and that two design choices: implicit score emission and group calibration are necessary to make error counting a reliable reward. As a case study, we validate IEC on virtual try-on (VTO), a domain that is simultaneously too constrained for holistic scoring and too permissive for rubric-based evaluation: subtle garment errors are unacceptable, yet many output variations are correct. We introduce Cascaded Error Counting (CEC) as an evaluation metric, which tracks human preferences well (60% top-1 vs. 30% others), and curate Mismatch-DressCode (MDressBench), a benchmark with maximal attribute mismatch to stress-test reward designs. On MDressBench, IEC outperforms RaR across all metrics (CEC: 5.31 vs. 5.60 on flat references; 5.20 vs. 5.53 on non-flat). On VITON-HD and DressCode, IEC matches or surpasses six baselines on 6 of 8 perceptual metrics. These results suggest that when ideal answers are unavailable, counting errors provide a stronger signal than constructing rubrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了隐式错误计数（IEC）方法，用于解决缺乏理想参考答案的任务中的强化学习奖励问题。传统方法依赖单一理想答案生成评分标准，而IEC通过枚举错误并加权评分来提供校准后的奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 当前基于参考答案的强化学习方法（如RLVR和RaR）在许多现实任务中存在局限性，因为这些任务允许多种有效输出且缺乏单一理想答案。作者识别出这种"无参考"场景是当前后训练方法的空白，需要新的奖励设计方法。
AI.method: 提出隐式错误计数（IEC）方法：1）枚举响应中的错误而非检查正确部分；2）在任务相关维度上应用严重性加权评分；3）通过隐式分数发射和组校准将错误计数转换为校准后的奖励信号。还提出了级联错误计数（CEC）作为评估指标。
AI.result: 在虚拟试穿（VTO）领域验证IEC：1）CEC指标能很好跟踪人类偏好（60% top-1 vs. 30%其他）；2）在MDressBench基准上，IEC在所有指标上优于RaR；3）在VITON-HD和DressCode数据集上，IEC在8个感知指标中的6个上匹配或超越6个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 当理想答案不可用时，计数错误比构建评分标准能提供更强的信号。IEC方法填补了无参考场景下强化学习奖励设计的空白，为允许多种有效输出的任务提供了有效的优化信号。

title: DeepFact: Co-Evolving Benchmarks and Agents for Deep Research Factuality
summary: Search-augmented LLM agents can produce deep research reports (DRRs), but verifying claim-level factuality remains challenging. Existing fact-checkers are primarily designed for general-domain, factoid-style atomic claims, and there is no benchmark to test whether such verifiers transfer to DRRs. Yet building such a benchmark is itself difficult. We first show that static expert-labeled benchmarks are brittle in this setting: in a controlled study with PhD-level specialists, unassisted experts achieve only 60.8% accuracy on a hidden micro-gold set of verifiable claims. We propose Evolving Benchmarking via Audit-then-Score (AtS), where benchmark labels and rationales are explicitly revisable: when a verifier disagrees with the current benchmark, it must submit evidence; an auditor adjudicates the dispute; and accepted revisions update the benchmark before models are scored. Across four AtS rounds, expert micro-gold accuracy rises to 90.9%, indicating experts are substantially more reliable as auditors than as one-shot labelers. We instantiate AtS as DeepFact-Bench, a versioned DRR factuality benchmark with auditable rationales, and DeepFact-Eval, a document-level verification agent (with a grouped lite variant) that outperforms existing verifiers on DeepFact-Bench and transfers well to external factuality datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于深度研究报告事实核查的演进式基准构建方法（AtS），通过审计-评分机制创建了DeepFact-Bench基准和DeepFact-Eval验证代理，显著提升了事实核查的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查工具主要针对通用领域的事实性原子声明，缺乏针对深度研究报告（DRRs）的专门基准。静态专家标注基准在这种复杂场景下表现脆弱，专家单次标注准确率仅60.8%。需要一种更可靠的基准构建方法来支持DRR的事实核查。
AI.method: 提出了演进式基准构建方法AtS（Audit-then-Score）：当验证器与当前基准标签不一致时，必须提交证据；审计员裁决争议；接受的修订更新基准后再对模型评分。基于此方法构建了DeepFact-Bench（版本化DRR事实性基准）和DeepFact-Eval（文档级验证代理）。
AI.result: 经过四轮AtS迭代，专家微金标准确率从60.8%提升至90.9%，表明专家作为审计员比单次标注者更可靠。DeepFact-Eval在DeepFact-Bench上优于现有验证器，并在外部事实性数据集上表现出良好的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: AtS方法通过可修订的基准标签和审计机制，显著提升了DRR事实核查的可靠性。DeepFact-Bench和DeepFact-Eval为深度研究报告的事实核查提供了有效的基准和工具，推动了该领域的发展。

title: Keeping the Evidence Chain: Semantic Evidence Allocation for Training-Free Token Pruning in Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) localizes the temporal boundaries of a query-relevant moment in long, untrimmed videos, making video-language-model (VLM) pipelines prohibitively expensive. While recent training-free visual token pruning has shown success in video question answering, naively applying these objectives to VTG often causes drastic degradation, as VTG crucially depends on boundary-sensitive evidence and cross-frame reasoning chains. We therefore identify two VTG-specific pruning principles: Evidence Retention (ER), which keeps query-critical patches especially around event boundaries, and Connectivity Strength (CS), which preserves token-level cross-frame connectivity for long-range evidence aggregation. Building on these insights, we propose SemVID, a training-free pruning framework that constructs a compact yet coherent token subset with complementary semantic roles. SemVID first allocates per-frame token budgets by balancing query relevance and inter-frame variation to avoid over-pruned segments, and then selects three types of tokens: object tokens for diverse query-critical evidence, motion tokens to capture meaningful transitions and serve as cross-frame relays, and a small set of context tokens for scene continuity. Extensive experiments on VTG benchmarks show that SemVID achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, retaining up to 95.4% mIoU with only 12.5% visual tokens and delivering up to a 5.8x prefill speedup, consistently outperforming prior methods under the same budgets.

AI.tldr: SemVID是一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，专门针对视频时序定位任务，通过保留关键证据和跨帧连接性，在仅使用12.5%视觉token的情况下保持95.4%的mIoU准确率，实现5.8倍的前向加速。
AI.motivation: 视频时序定位需要处理长视频，直接使用视频语言模型计算成本过高。现有的视觉token剪枝方法虽然适用于视频问答，但在VTG任务上效果不佳，因为VTG需要边界敏感的证据和跨帧推理链。
AI.method: 提出SemVID框架，基于两个VTG专用剪枝原则：证据保留（保持查询关键补丁，特别是事件边界周围）和连接强度（保持token级跨帧连接性）。框架首先平衡查询相关性和帧间变化来分配每帧token预算，然后选择三种token：对象token（多样化查询关键证据）、运动token（捕捉有意义的过渡并作为跨帧中继）和少量上下文token（保持场景连续性）。
AI.result: 在VTG基准测试中，SemVID实现了优秀的准确率-效率权衡，仅使用12.5%视觉token就能保持95.4%的mIoU，提供高达5.8倍的前向加速，在相同预算下持续优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: SemVID通过VTG特定的剪枝原则和语义角色分配，构建了紧凑而连贯的token子集，有效解决了视频时序定位中的计算效率问题，为实际应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Towards Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation Based on Knowledge Graph: A Comparative Analysis
comment: The paper is 6 pages long and includes 5 figures and 3 tables illustrating the experimental framework and results. It is submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2025) and studies improving the robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems using knowledge graph based GraphRAG approaches
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) was introduced to enhance the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond their encoded prior knowledge. This is achieved by providing LLMs with an external source of knowledge, which helps reduce factual hallucinations and enables access to new information not available during pretraining. However, inconsistent retrieved information can negatively affect LLM responses. The Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmark (RGB) was introduced to evaluate the robustness of RAG systems under such conditions. In this work, we use the RGB corpus to evaluate LLMs in four scenarios: noise robustness, information integration, negative rejection, and counterfactual robustness. We perform a comparative analysis between the RGB RAG baseline and GraphRAG, a knowledge graph based retrieval system. We test three GraphRAG customizations to improve robustness. Results show improvements over the RGB baseline and provide insights for designing more reliable RAG systems for real world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用RGB基准评估RAG系统在不同检索场景下的鲁棒性，比较了传统RAG基线与基于知识图谱的GraphRAG系统，并测试了三种GraphRAG定制方案以提升系统可靠性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统虽然能增强大语言模型的能力，但检索信息的不一致性会影响模型响应质量。需要评估RAG系统在不同检索场景下的鲁棒性，特别是当检索信息存在噪声、矛盾或错误时的表现。
AI.method: 使用RGB基准在四种场景下评估RAG系统：噪声鲁棒性、信息整合、负面拒绝和反事实鲁棒性。比较RGB RAG基线与基于知识图谱的GraphRAG系统，并测试了三种GraphRAG定制方案来改进鲁棒性。
AI.result: GraphRAG系统相比RGB基线有所改进，特别是在处理不一致检索信息方面表现更好。三种GraphRAG定制方案进一步提升了系统鲁棒性，为设计更可靠的RAG系统提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 基于知识图谱的检索系统在处理不一致检索信息方面具有优势，通过适当的定制可以显著提升RAG系统在实际应用场景中的可靠性和鲁棒性。

title: An Interactive Multi-Agent System for Evaluation of New Product Concepts
comment: 46 pages, 3 figures + This paper proposes an LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) for automated evaluation of new product concepts, incorporating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and cross-functional virtual agents to assess technical and market feasibility
summary: Product concept evaluation is a critical stage that determines strategic resource allocation and project success in enterprises. However, traditional expert-led approaches face limitations such as subjective bias and high time and cost requirements. To support this process, this study proposes an automated approach utilizing a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system (MAS). Through a systematic analysis of previous research on product development and team collaboration, this study established two primary evaluation dimensions, namely technical feasibility and market feasibility. The proposed system consists of a team of eight virtual agents representing specialized domains such as R&D and marketing. These agents use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and real-time search tools to gather objective evidence and validate concepts through structured deliberations based on the established criteria. The agents were further fine-tuned using professional product review data to enhance their judgment accuracy. A case study involving professional display monitor concepts demonstrated that the system's evaluation rankings were consistent with those of senior industry experts. These results confirm the usability of the proposed multi-agent-based evaluation approach for supporting product development decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，用于自动化产品概念评估，通过八个专业领域智能体进行技术可行性和市场可行性评估，结果与行业专家评估一致。
AI.motivation: 产品概念评估对企业资源分配和项目成功至关重要，但传统专家主导方法存在主观偏见、时间和成本高等局限性，需要更客观高效的评估方法。
AI.method: 建立基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，包含八个代表不同专业领域（如研发、营销）的虚拟智能体。采用检索增强生成和实时搜索工具收集客观证据，基于技术可行性和市场可行性两个维度进行结构化审议。使用专业产品评审数据对智能体进行微调以提高判断准确性。
AI.result: 通过专业显示监视器概念的案例研究，系统评估排名与资深行业专家的评估结果一致，验证了多智能体评估方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于多智能体的评估方法可用于支持产品开发决策，为传统专家评估提供了自动化、客观的替代方案。

title: OWL: A Novel Approach to Machine Perception During Motion
summary: We introduce a perception-related function, OWL, designed to address the complex challenges of 3D perception during motion. It derives its values directly from two fundamental visual motion cues, with one set of cue values per point per time instant. During motion, two visual motion cues relative to a fixation point emerge: 1) perceived local visual looming of points near the fixation point, and 2) perceived rotation of the rigid object relative to the fixation point. It also expresses the relation between two well-known physical quantities, the relative instantaneous directional range and directional translation in 3D between the camera and any visible 3D point, without explicitly requiring their measurement or prior knowledge of their individual values. OWL offers a unified, analytical time-based approach that enhances and simplifies key perception capabilities, including scaled 3D mapping and camera heading. Simulations demonstrate that OWL achieves geometric constancy of 3D objects over time and enables scaled 3D scene reconstruction from visual motion cues alone. By leveraging direct measurements from raw visual motion image sequences, OWL values can be obtained without prior knowledge of stationary environments, moving objects, or camera motion. This approach employs minimalistic, pixel-based, parallel computations, providing an alternative real-time representation for 3D points in relative motion. OWL bridges the gap between theoretical concepts and practical applications in robotics and autonomous navigation and may unlock new possibilities for real-time decision-making and interaction, potentially serving as a building block for next-generation autonomous systems. This paper offers an alternative perspective on machine perception, with implications that may extend to natural perception and contribute to a better understanding of behavioral psychology and neural functionality.

AI.tldr: OWL是一种基于视觉运动线索的3D感知函数，通过分析局部视觉逼近和刚性物体旋转来重建3D场景，无需先验环境知识或相机运动信息。
AI.motivation: 解决运动过程中3D感知的复杂挑战，特别是在机器人学和自主导航中，需要一种能够直接从原始视觉运动图像序列中提取3D信息的统一分析方法。
AI.method: 基于两个基本视觉运动线索：1) 固定点附近点的感知局部视觉逼近，2) 刚性物体相对于固定点的感知旋转。通过像素级并行计算，直接从原始视觉运动图像序列中推导OWL值，无需测量或先验知识。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明OWL实现了3D物体的几何恒常性，并能够仅从视觉运动线索进行缩放3D场景重建。该方法提供了一种实时表示相对运动中3D点的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: OWL为机器感知提供了新的视角，填补了理论概念与实际应用之间的差距，可能成为下一代自主系统的构建模块，并对自然感知、行为心理学和神经功能研究有启示意义。

title: Cultural Perspectives and Expectations for Generative AI: A Global Survey Approach
summary: There is a lack of empirical evidence about global attitudes around whether and how GenAI should represent cultures. This paper assesses understandings and beliefs about culture as it relates to GenAI from a large-scale global survey. We gathered data about what culture means to different groups, and about how GenAI should approach the representation of cultural artifacts, concepts, or values. We distill working definitions of culture directly from these communities to build an understanding of its conceptual complexities and how they relate to representations in Generative AI. We survey from across parts of Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa. We conclude with a set of recommendations for Culture and GenAI development. These include participatory approaches, prioritizing specific cultural dimensions beyond geography, such as religion and tradition, and a sensitivity framework for addressing cultural ``redlines''.

AI.tldr: 通过全球大规模调查评估人们对GenAI应如何代表文化的理解和信念，收集不同群体对文化的定义以及GenAI应如何处理文化表现，提出文化参与式方法、超越地理维度的文化优先考虑等建议。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏关于全球对GenAI是否以及如何代表文化的态度的实证证据，需要了解不同群体对文化的理解以及GenAI应如何处理文化表现。
AI.method: 采用大规模全球调查方法，收集欧洲、北美、南美、亚洲和非洲地区的数据，直接从社区中提炼文化的操作性定义，理解其概念复杂性及其与生成式AI表现的关系。
AI.result: 建立了从社区直接提炼的文化操作性定义，理解了文化的概念复杂性及其与生成式AI表现的关系，形成了关于文化和GenAI发展的具体建议。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套文化和GenAI发展的建议，包括参与式方法、超越地理维度的特定文化维度优先考虑（如宗教和传统），以及处理文化"红线"的敏感性框架。

title: Agentic LLM Planning via Step-Wise PDDL Simulation: An Empirical Characterisation
summary: Task planning, the problem of sequencing actions to reach a goal from an initial state, is a core capability requirement for autonomous robotic systems. Whether large language models (LLMs) can serve as viable planners alongside classical symbolic methods remains an open question. We present PyPDDLEngine, an open-source Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) simulation engine that exposes planning operations as LLM tool calls through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Rather than committing to a complete action sequence upfront, the LLM acts as an interactive search policy that selects one action at a time, observes each resulting state, and can reset and retry. We evaluate four approaches on 102 International Planning Competition (IPC) Blocksworld instances under a uniform 180-second budget: Fast Downward lama-first and seq-sat-lama-2011 as classical baselines, direct LLM planning (Claude Haiku 4.5), and agentic LLM planning via PyPDDLEngine. Fast Downward achieves 85.3% success. The direct and agentic LLM approaches achieve 63.7% and 66.7%, respectively, a consistent but modest three-percentage-point advantage for the agentic approach at $5.7\times$ higher token cost per solution. Across most co-solved difficulty blocks, both LLM approaches produce shorter plans than seq-sat-lama-2011 despite its iterative quality improvement, a result consistent with training-data recall rather than generalisable planning. These results suggest that agentic gains depend on the nature of environmental feedback. Coding agents benefit from externally grounded signals such as compiler errors and test failures, whereas PDDL step feedback is self-assessed, leaving the agent to evaluate its own progress without external verification.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了LLM与经典规划方法在任务规划中的表现，开发了PyPDDLEngine作为PDDL模拟引擎，让LLM通过MCP接口进行交互式规划。实验显示LLM规划成功率低于经典方法，但能生成更短的计划，表明其优势可能源于训练数据记忆而非通用规划能力。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型是否能够作为可行的任务规划器，与经典的符号规划方法相媲美。任务规划是自主机器人系统的核心能力需求，但LLM在此领域的实际效果仍是一个开放性问题。
AI.method: 开发了PyPDDLEngine开源PDDL模拟引擎，通过模型上下文协议接口将规划操作暴露为LLM工具调用。LLM作为交互式搜索策略，一次选择一个动作，观察结果状态，并可重置重试。在102个国际规划竞赛Blocksworld实例上评估了四种方法：Fast Downward lama-first和seq-sat-lama-2011作为经典基线，直接LLM规划，以及通过PyPDDLEngine的代理式LLM规划。
AI.result: Fast Downward达到85.3%成功率，直接LLM规划为63.7%，代理式LLM规划为66.7%。代理式方法比直接方法有3个百分点的优势，但每个解决方案的token成本高出5.7倍。在大多数共同解决的难度块中，两种LLM方法都产生了比seq-sat-lama-2011更短的计划，尽管后者有迭代质量改进。
AI.conclusion: 代理式LLM规划在PDDL任务中仅带来有限的性能提升，表明代理式增益取决于环境反馈的性质。编码代理受益于编译器错误和测试失败等外部基础信号，而PDDL步骤反馈是自我评估的，让代理在没有外部验证的情况下评估自身进展。LLM的优势可能源于训练数据记忆而非通用规划能力。

title: MultiHaystack: Benchmarking Multimodal Retrieval and Reasoning over 40K Images, Videos, and Documents
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on benchmarks that evaluate text, image, or video understanding separately. However, these settings do not assess a critical real-world requirement, which involves retrieving relevant evidence from large, heterogeneous multimodal corpora prior to reasoning. Most existing benchmarks restrict retrieval to small, single-modality candidate sets, substantially simplifying the search space and overstating end-to-end reliability. To address this gap, we introduce MultiHaystack, the first benchmark designed to evaluate both retrieval and reasoning under large-scale, cross-modal conditions. MultiHaystack comprises over 46,000 multimodal retrieval candidates across documents, images, and videos, along with 747 open yet verifiable questions. Each question is grounded in a unique validated evidence item within the retrieval pool, requiring evidence localization across modalities and fine-grained reasoning. In our study, we find that models perform competitively when provided with the corresponding evidence, but their performance drops sharply when required to retrieve that evidence from the full corpus. Additionally, even the strongest retriever, E5-V, achieves only 40.8% Recall@1, while state-of-the-art MLLMs such as GPT-5 experience a significant drop in reasoning accuracy from 80.86% when provided with the corresponding evidence to 51.4% under top-5 retrieval. These results indicate that multimodal retrieval over heterogeneous pools remains a primary bottleneck for MLLMs, positioning MultiHaystack as a valuable testbed that highlights underlying limitations obscured by small-scale evaluations and promotes retrieval-centric advances in multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: MultiHaystack是首个评估大规模跨模态检索与推理的基准测试，包含超过46,000个多模态检索候选项和747个可验证问题，揭示当前多模态大语言模型在真实检索场景下的显著性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要评估文本、图像或视频的单独理解能力，但忽略了真实世界的关键需求：从大规模异构多模态语料库中检索相关证据后再进行推理。大多数现有基准将检索限制在小规模、单模态候选集中，过度简化了搜索空间并夸大了端到端的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者提出了MultiHaystack基准测试，包含超过46,000个跨文档、图像和视频的多模态检索候选项，以及747个开放但可验证的问题。每个问题都基于检索池中唯一的验证证据项，要求跨模态的证据定位和细粒度推理。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）当提供相应证据时，模型表现具有竞争力；2）当需要从完整语料库中检索证据时，性能急剧下降；3）最强的检索器E5-V仅达到40.8%的Recall@1；4）最先进的MLLMs如GPT-5在提供相应证据时推理准确率为80.86%，但在top-5检索下降至51.4%。
AI.conclusion: 异构多模态检索仍然是MLLMs的主要瓶颈，MultiHaystack作为一个有价值的测试平台，揭示了小规模评估所掩盖的底层限制，并促进多模态系统中以检索为中心的进展。

title: Structured Multidimensional Representation Learning for Large Language Models
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures. Preprint of a journal submission
summary: Transformer architectures achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of pattern recognition and natural language processing tasks, but their scaling is accompanied by substantial parameter growth and redundancy in the embedding dimension. In this work, we introduce a structured spectral factorization of the embedding space based on the L-product for third-order tensors. By reshaping token representations into spectral tensor slices and performing attention and feed-forward operations in the transform domain, we obtain a Tensor Transformer architecture that decomposes the encoder into p independent spectral sub-transformers while preserving standard Transformer semantics. We prove that the proposed L-Transformer is spectrally equivalent to p parallel Transformers operating on reduceddimensional embeddings, which yields approximately 1/p reduction (up to lower-order terms such as biases and normalization parameters) in encoder parameters under fixed total embedding size. When instantiated with a real-valued Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), the method remains fully differentiable and compatible with existing training pipelines. Beyond compression, the spectral decomposition introduces an inductive bias over embedding frequencies, enabling slice-dependent frequency scaling that improves generalization. Experiments on IMDB and AG~News show that the proposed model can substantially reduce encoder parameters (up to 75\% for p=4) while maintaining competitive accuracy. On IMDB, the tensorized encoder matches or improves upon the standard baseline under compression, whereas on AG~News at moderate width we observe a small accuracy decrease in exchange for a 4 times encoder reduction; at BERT-base width (d=768), performance returns to parity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于L-积的张量Transformer架构，通过谱分解将嵌入空间分解为独立谱子变换器，在保持Transformer语义的同时实现约1/p的编码器参数减少
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在扩展时面临参数增长和嵌入维度冗余的问题，需要更高效的架构设计来减少参数冗余同时保持性能
AI.method: 基于三阶张量的L-积进行结构化谱分解，将token表示重塑为谱张量切片，在变换域执行注意力和前馈操作，构建张量Transformer架构
AI.result: 在IMDB和AG News数据集上，模型可减少高达75%的编码器参数（p=4时），在IMDB上匹配或优于标准基线，在AG News上BERT-base宽度下性能恢复至同等水平
AI.conclusion: 提出的L-Transformer通过谱分解实现了参数效率提升，同时引入了嵌入频率的归纳偏置，在保持竞争力的准确率下显著减少了编码器参数

title: Aggregative Semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks
summary: Formal argumentation is being used increasingly in artificial intelligence as an effective and understandable way to model potentially conflicting pieces of information, called arguments, and identify so-called acceptable arguments depending on a chosen semantics. This paper deals with the specific context of Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAF), where arguments have intrinsic weights and can attack or support each other. In this context, we introduce a novel family of gradual semantics, called aggregative semantics. In order to deal with situations in which attackers and supporters do not play a symmetric role, and in contrast to modular semantics, we propose to aggregate attackers and supporters separately. This leads to a three-stage computation, which consists in computing a global weight for attackers and another for supporters, before aggregating these two values with the intrinsic weight of the argument. We discuss the properties that the three aggregation functions should satisfy depending on the context, as well as their relationships with the classical principles for gradual semantics. This discussion is supported by various simple examples, as well as a final example on which five hundred aggregative semantics are tested and compared, illustrating the range of possible behaviours with aggregative semantics. Decomposing the computation into three distinct and interpretable steps leads to a more parametrisable computation: it keeps the bipolarity one step further than what is done in the literature, and it leads to more understandable gradual semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的渐进语义家族——聚合语义，用于处理具有内在权重的定量双极论证框架，通过将攻击者和支持者分开聚合的三阶段计算，增强了参数化和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 在定量双极论证框架中，现有的渐进语义在处理攻击者和支持者时通常采用对称方式，但现实中攻击者和支持者往往扮演不对称的角色。需要一种更灵活、更可解释的语义来更好地建模这种不对称性。
AI.method: 提出聚合语义家族，采用三阶段计算：1) 单独计算攻击者的全局权重；2) 单独计算支持者的全局权重；3) 将这两个值与论证的内在权重进行聚合。讨论了三种聚合函数在不同情境下应满足的性质及其与经典渐进语义原则的关系。
AI.result: 通过简单示例和最终测试500种聚合语义的案例，展示了聚合语义可能的行为范围。三阶段分解计算使得语义更加参数化，保持了双极性，并增强了渐进语义的可理解性。
AI.conclusion: 聚合语义通过将攻击者和支持者分开处理，提供了一种更灵活、更可解释的渐进语义方法，能够更好地建模论证框架中攻击者和支持者的不对称角色，同时保持了计算的可解释性和参数化特性。

title: Interpretable Perception and Reasoning for Audiovisual Geolocation
summary: While recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have improved image-based localization, precise global geolocation remains a formidable challenge due to the inherent ambiguity of visual landscapes and the largely untapped potential of auditory cues. In this paper, we introduce Audiovisual Geolocation, a framework designed to resolve geographic ambiguity through interpretable perception and reasoning. We present AVG, a high-quality global-scale video benchmark for geolocation, comprising 20,000 curated clips across 1,000 distinct locations. To address the complexity of audiovisual geolocation, we propose a three-stage framework: (1) a Perception stage that utilizes a mixture-autoregressive sparse autoencoder to decompose noisy audio into semantically grounded "acoustic atoms"; (2) a Multimodal Reasoning stage that employs an MLLM finetuned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to synthesize these atoms with visual features; and (3) a Precision Prediction stage using Riemannian Flow Matching on the $S^2$ manifold. Our experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms unimodal baselines. These results entail that interpretable perception of the soundscape provides a critical, orthogonal signal that, when coupled with multimodal reasoning, enables high-precision global localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Audiovisual Geolocation框架，通过视听融合解决地理定位难题，在AVG基准上显著优于单模态方法
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在图像定位方面虽有进展，但精确的全球地理定位仍面临挑战，主要因为视觉景观的固有模糊性和听觉线索的未充分利用
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：1)感知阶段使用混合自回归稀疏自编码器分解噪声音频为"声学原子"；2)多模态推理阶段使用GRPO微调的MLLM融合声学原子与视觉特征；3)精确预测阶段在S^2流形上使用黎曼流匹配
AI.result: 实验表明该框架显著优于单模态基线，证明可解释的声音感知提供了关键正交信号，结合多模态推理可实现高精度全球定位
AI.conclusion: 声音景观的可解释感知为地理定位提供了关键补充信号，与视觉特征结合通过多模态推理能够实现精确的全球定位

title: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
summary: Recent advances in deep learning inspired neural network-based approaches to computational materials discovery (CMD). A plethora of problems in this field involve finding materials that optimize a target property. Nevertheless, the increasingly popular generative modeling methods are ineffective at boldly exploring attractive regions of the materials space due to their maximum likelihood training. In this work, we offer an alternative CMD technique based on offline model-based optimization (MBO) that fuses direct optimization of a target material property into generation. To that end, we introduce a domain-specific model, dubbed CliqueFlowmer, that incorporates recent advances of clique-based MBO into transformer and flow generation. We validate CliqueFlowmer's optimization abilities and show that materials it produces strongly outperform those provided by generative baselines. To enable employment of CliqueFlowmer in specialized materials optimization problems and support interdisciplinary research, we open-source our code at https://github.com/znowu/CliqueFlowmer.

AI.tldr: CliqueFlowmer：一种基于离线模型优化的材料发现方法，通过将目标属性直接优化融入生成过程，超越传统生成模型
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型基于最大似然训练，在材料空间中大胆探索有吸引力区域方面效果有限，需要一种能直接优化目标属性的材料发现方法
AI.method: 提出CliqueFlowmer模型，将基于clique的模型优化最新进展融入transformer和flow生成中，实现离线模型优化与材料生成的融合
AI.result: CliqueFlowmer在优化能力上表现出色，其生成的材料性能显著优于传统生成基线方法
AI.conclusion: CliqueFlowmer为计算材料发现提供了一种有效的替代方法，通过开源代码支持专业材料优化问题和跨学科研究

title: CodeScout: Contextual Problem Statement Enhancement for Software Agents
summary: Current AI-powered code assistance tools often struggle with poorly-defined problem statements that lack sufficient task context and requirements specification. Recent analysis of software engineering agents reveals that failures on such underspecified requests are highly correlated with longer trajectories involving either over-exploration or repeated attempts at applying the same fix without proper evolution or testing, leading to suboptimal outcomes across software development tasks. We introduce CodeScout, a contextual query refinement approach that systematically converts underspecified user requests into comprehensive, actionable problem statements through lightweight pre-exploration of the target codebase. Our key innovation is demonstrating that structured analysis before task execution can supplement existing agentic capabilities without requiring any modifications to their underlying scaffolds. CodeScout performs targeted context scoping, conducts multi-perspective analysis examining potential fixes and exploration opportunities, then synthesizes these insights into enhanced problem statements with reproduction steps, expected behaviors, and targeted exploration hints. This pre-exploration directly addresses the identified failure patterns by reducing non-converging agent trajectories while clarifying user intent in natural language space. We evaluate CodeScout using state-of-the-art agentic scaffolds and language models on SWEBench-Verified, demonstrating a 20\% improvement in resolution rates with up to 27 additional issues resolved compared to the default baseline method. Our results suggest that systematic query refinement through contextual analysis represents a promising direction for enhancing AI code assistance capabilities.

AI.tldr: CodeScout通过轻量级预探索将不明确的代码请求转化为全面的问题陈述，在SWEBench-Verified上实现20%的解决率提升
AI.motivation: 当前AI代码辅助工具在处理缺乏足够任务上下文和需求规格的模糊问题陈述时表现不佳，失败通常与过长的探索轨迹或重复尝试相同修复而缺乏适当演进和测试相关
AI.method: CodeScout采用上下文查询精化方法，在任务执行前对目标代码库进行轻量级预探索，执行针对性上下文界定、多视角分析（检查潜在修复和探索机会），然后将这些见解合成为增强的问题陈述，包含重现步骤、预期行为和针对性探索提示
AI.result: 在SWEBench-Verified上使用最先进的代理框架和语言模型评估，CodeScout相比默认基线方法实现了20%的解决率提升，额外解决了27个问题
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文分析进行系统性查询精化是增强AI代码辅助能力的有前景方向，任务执行前的结构化分析可以补充现有代理能力而无需修改其底层框架

title: Conversational Demand Response: Bidirectional Aggregator-Prosumer Coordination through Agentic AI
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/RedaElMakroum/cdr
summary: Residential demand response depends on sustained prosumer participation, yet existing coordination is either fully automated, or limited to one-way dispatch signals and price alerts that offer little possibility for informed decision-making. This paper introduces Conversational Demand Response (CDR), a coordination mechanism where aggregators and prosumers interact through bidirectional natural language, enabled through agentic AI. A two-tier multi-agent architecture is developed in which an aggregator agent dispatches flexibility requests and a prosumer Home Energy Management System (HEMS) assesses deliverability and cost-benefit by calling an optimization-based tool. CDR also enables prosumer-initiated upstream communication, where changes in preferences can reach the aggregator directly. Proof-of-concept evaluation shows that interactions complete in under 12 seconds. The architecture illustrates how agentic AI can bridge the aggregator-prosumer coordination gap, providing the scalability of automated DR while preserving the transparency, explainability, and user agency necessary for sustained prosumer participation. All system components, including agent prompts, orchestration logic, and simulation interfaces, are released as open source to enable reproducibility and further development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对话式需求响应(CDR)，通过双向自然语言交互协调聚合商和产消者，使用代理AI实现透明、可解释的需求响应协调机制。
AI.motivation: 当前住宅需求响应协调机制存在不足：要么完全自动化，要么仅限于单向调度信号和价格警报，缺乏让产消者做出知情决策的可能性，难以维持产消者的持续参与。
AI.method: 开发了双层多代理架构：聚合商代理调度灵活性请求，产消者家庭能源管理系统通过调用基于优化的工具评估可交付性和成本效益。支持双向自然语言交互，产消者可主动向上游通信表达偏好变化。
AI.result: 概念验证评估显示交互在12秒内完成。该架构展示了代理AI如何弥合聚合商-产消者协调差距，在保持自动化需求响应可扩展性的同时，保留了维持产消者参与所需的透明度、可解释性和用户自主权。
AI.conclusion: 对话式需求响应通过代理AI实现双向自然语言交互，为住宅需求响应提供了更透明、可解释且尊重用户自主权的协调机制，所有系统组件已开源发布以促进可重复性和进一步发展。

title: Unlocking ImageNet's Multi-Object Nature: Automated Large-Scale Multilabel Annotation
summary: The original ImageNet benchmark enforces a single-label assumption, despite many images depicting multiple objects. This leads to label noise and limits the richness of the learning signal. Multi-label annotations more accurately reflect real-world visual scenes, where multiple objects co-occur and contribute to semantic understanding, enabling models to learn richer and more robust representations. While prior efforts (e.g., ReaL, ImageNetv2) have improved the validation set, there has not yet been a scalable, high-quality multi-label annotation for the training set. To this end, we present an automated pipeline to convert the ImageNet training set into a multi-label dataset, without human annotations. Using self-supervised Vision Transformers, we perform unsupervised object discovery, select regions aligned with original labels to train a lightweight classifier, and apply it to all regions to generate coherent multi-label annotations across the dataset. Our labels show strong alignment with human judgment in qualitative evaluations and consistently improve performance across quantitative benchmarks. Compared to traditional single-label scheme, models trained with our multi-label supervision achieve consistently better in-domain accuracy across architectures (up to +2.0 top-1 accuracy on ReaL and +1.5 on ImageNet-V2) and exhibit stronger transferability to downstream tasks (up to +4.2 and +2.3 mAP on COCO and VOC, respectively). These results underscore the importance of accurate multi-label annotations for enhancing both classification performance and representation learning. Project code and the generated multi-label annotations are available at https://github.com/jchen175/MultiLabel-ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化流程将ImageNet训练集转换为多标签数据集，无需人工标注，通过自监督ViT进行无监督物体发现和轻量级分类器训练，生成高质量多标签标注
AI.motivation: 原始ImageNet基准强制单标签假设，但许多图像包含多个物体，导致标签噪声并限制学习信号的丰富性。多标签标注能更准确反映真实视觉场景，使模型学习更丰富、更鲁棒的表征
AI.method: 使用自监督Vision Transformers进行无监督物体发现，选择与原始标签对齐的区域训练轻量级分类器，然后应用于所有区域生成跨数据集的一致多标签标注
AI.result: 多标签监督训练的模型在架构间获得一致更好的域内准确率（ReaL上最高+2.0 top-1，ImageNet-V2上+1.5），并在下游任务上表现出更强的可迁移性（COCO上最高+4.2 mAP，VOC上+2.3 mAP）
AI.conclusion: 准确的多标签标注对于提升分类性能和表征学习都很重要，自动化流程能生成高质量多标签标注，显著改善模型性能

title: NERdME: a Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Indexing Research Artifacts in Code Repositories
summary: Existing scholarly information extraction (SIE) datasets focus on scientific papers and overlook implementation-level details in code repositories. README files describe datasets, source code, and other implementation-level artifacts, however, their free-form Markdown offers little semantic structure, making automatic information extraction difficult. To address this gap, NERdME is introduced: 200 manually annotated README files with over 10,000 labeled spans and 10 entity types. Baseline results using large language models and fine-tuned transformers show clear differences between paperlevel and implementation-level entities, indicating the value of extending SIE benchmarks with entity types available in README files. A downstream entity-linking experiment was conducted to demonstrate that entities derived from READMEs can support artifact discovery and metadata integration.

AI.tldr: NERdME数据集包含200个手动标注的README文件，包含10,000多个标注跨度和10种实体类型，用于解决学术信息提取中实现级别细节的缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有学术信息提取数据集主要关注科学论文，但忽略了代码仓库中的实现级别细节。README文件描述了数据集、源代码等实现级别工件，但其自由格式的Markdown缺乏语义结构，使得自动信息提取变得困难。
AI.method: 引入了NERdME数据集，包含200个手动标注的README文件，超过10,000个标注跨度和10种实体类型。使用大型语言模型和微调的transformer模型进行基线实验，并通过下游实体链接实验验证README实体的实用性。
AI.result: 基线结果显示论文级别和实现级别实体之间存在明显差异，表明将SIE基准扩展到README文件中可用的实体类型具有价值。实体链接实验证明从README派生的实体可以支持工件发现和元数据集成。
AI.conclusion: NERdME数据集填补了学术信息提取中实现级别细节的空白，README文件中的实体类型对于扩展SIE基准具有重要价值，并能支持代码仓库中的工件发现和元数据集成。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Climate Adaptation: Reinforcement Learning for Climate Change-Resilient Transport
summary: Climate change is expected to intensify rainfall and, consequently, pluvial flooding, leading to increased disruptions in urban transportation systems over the coming decades. Designing effective adaptation strategies is challenging due to the long-term, sequential nature of infrastructure investments, deep climate uncertainty, and the complex interactions between flooding, infrastructure, and mobility impacts. In this work, we propose a novel decision-support framework using reinforcement learning (RL) for long-term flood adaptation planning. Formulated as an integrated assessment model (IAM), the framework combines rainfall projection and flood modeling, transport simulation, and quantification of direct and indirect impacts on infrastructure and mobility. Our RL-based approach learns adaptive strategies that balance investment and maintenance costs against avoided impacts. We evaluate the framework through a case study of Copenhagen's inner city over the 2024-2100 period, testing multiple adaptation options, and different belief and realized climate scenarios. Results show that the framework outperforms traditional optimization approaches by discovering coordinated spatial and temporal adaptation pathways and learning trade-offs between impact reduction and adaptation investment, yielding more resilient strategies. Overall, our results showcase the potential of reinforcement learning as a flexible decision-support tool for adaptive infrastructure planning under climate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的决策支持框架，用于城市长期洪水适应规划，通过整合降雨预测、洪水建模、交通模拟和影响评估，在哥本哈根案例研究中展示了比传统优化方法更优的适应性策略。
AI.motivation: 气候变化预计会加剧降雨和洪水，导致城市交通系统中断增加。设计有效的适应策略面临挑战，包括基础设施投资的长期性、气候不确定性以及洪水、基础设施和交通影响之间的复杂相互作用。
AI.method: 提出基于强化学习（RL）的决策支持框架，将其构建为综合评估模型（IAM），整合降雨预测和洪水建模、交通模拟、基础设施和交通影响的直接和间接影响量化。RL方法学习平衡投资和维护成本与避免影响的适应性策略。
AI.result: 在哥本哈根市中心2024-2100年的案例研究中，测试了多种适应方案和不同气候情景。结果显示该框架优于传统优化方法，能够发现协调的空间和时间适应路径，学习影响减少和适应投资之间的权衡，产生更具韧性的策略。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习作为一种灵活的决策支持工具，在气候不确定性下具有自适应基础设施规划的潜力，能够发现更有效的长期适应策略。

title: From Phase Grounding to Intelligent Surgical Narratives
summary: Video surgery timelines are an important part of tool-assisted surgeries, as they allow surgeons to quickly focus on key parts of the procedure. Current methods involve the surgeon filling out a post-operation (OP) report, which is often vague, or manually annotating the surgical videos, which is highly time-consuming. Our proposed method sits between these two extremes: we aim to automatically create a surgical timeline and narrative directly from the surgical video. To achieve this, we employ a CLIP-based multi-modal framework that aligns surgical video frames with textual gesture descriptions. Specifically, we use the CLIP visual encoder to extract representations from surgical video frames and the text encoder to embed the corresponding gesture sentences into a shared embedding space. We then fine-tune the model to improve the alignment between video gestures and textual tokens. Once trained, the model predicts gestures and phases for video frames, enabling the construction of a structured surgical timeline. This approach leverages pretrained multi-modal representations to bridge visual gestures and textual narratives, reducing the need for manual video review and annotation by surgeons.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CLIP的多模态框架，自动从手术视频生成结构化时间线和叙述，减少外科医生手动标注工作
AI.motivation: 当前手术时间线创建方法存在缺陷：术后报告通常模糊不清，而手动标注视频又极其耗时。需要一种折中方案来自动化这一过程
AI.method: 采用CLIP多模态框架，将手术视频帧与文本手势描述对齐。使用CLIP视觉编码器提取视频帧表示，文本编码器嵌入手势句子到共享嵌入空间，通过微调改善视频手势与文本标记的对齐
AI.result: 训练后的模型能够预测视频帧的手势和阶段，从而构建结构化手术时间线。利用预训练多模态表示连接视觉手势和文本叙述
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自动创建手术时间线和叙述，显著减少了外科医生手动视频审查和标注的需求，为工具辅助手术提供了更高效的时间线生成方案

title: The EpisTwin: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Personal AI
summary: Personal Artificial Intelligence is currently hindered by the fragmentation of user data across isolated silos. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation offers a partial remedy, its reliance on unstructured vector similarity fails to capture the latent semantic topology and temporal dependencies essential for holistic sensemaking. We introduce EpisTwin, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds generative reasoning in a verifiable, user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph. EpisTwin leverages Multimodal Language Models to lift heterogeneous, cross-application data into semantic triples. At inference, EpisTwin enables complex reasoning over the personal semantic graph via an agentic coordinator that combines Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Online Deep Visual Refinement, dynamically re-grounding symbolic entities in their raw visual context. We also introduce PersonalQA-71-100, a synthetic benchmark designed to simulate a realistic user's digital footprint and evaluate EpisTwin performance. Our framework demonstrates robust results across a suite of state-of-the-art judge models, offering a promising direction for trustworthy Personal AI.

AI.tldr: EpisTwin是一个神经符号框架，通过构建可验证的个人知识图谱来解决个人AI中的数据孤岛问题，结合图检索增强生成和在线深度视觉细化实现复杂推理。
AI.motivation: 当前个人AI面临用户数据分散在孤立数据孤岛中的问题，而传统的检索增强生成方法依赖非结构化向量相似性，无法捕捉潜在语义拓扑和时间依赖关系，限制了整体感知能力。
AI.method: EpisTwin使用多模态语言模型将异构跨应用数据提升为语义三元组，构建用户中心的个人知识图谱。在推理时，通过代理协调器结合图检索增强生成和在线深度视觉细化，在原始视觉上下文中动态重新锚定符号实体。
AI.result: 研究团队创建了PersonalQA-71-100合成基准来模拟真实用户数字足迹并评估EpisTwin性能。该框架在一系列最先进的评判模型中表现出稳健的结果。
AI.conclusion: EpisTwin为可信赖的个人AI提供了一个有前景的方向，通过神经符号方法在可验证的个人知识图谱基础上实现生成推理。

title: Full Dynamic Range Sky-Modelling For Image Based Lighting
summary: Accurate environment maps are a key component to modelling real-world outdoor scenes. They enable captivating visual arts, immersive virtual reality and a wide range of scientific and engineering applications. To alleviate the burden of physical-capture, physically-simulation and volumetric rendering, sky-models have been proposed as fast, flexible, and cost-saving alternatives. In recent years, sky-models have been extended through deep learning to be more comprehensive and inclusive of cloud formations, but recent work has demonstrated these models fall short in faithfully recreating accurate and photorealistic natural skies. Particularly at higher resolutions, DNN sky-models struggle to accurately model the 14EV+ class-imbalanced solar region, resulting in poor visual quality and scenes illuminated with skewed light transmission, shadows and tones. In this work, we propose Icarus, an all-weather sky-model capable of learning the exposure range of Full Dynamic Range (FDR) physically captured outdoor imagery. Our model allows conditional generation of environment maps with intuitive user-positioning of solar and cloud formations, and extends on current state-of-the-art to enable user-controlled texturing of atmospheric formations. Through our evaluation, we demonstrate Icarus is interchangeable with FDR physically captured outdoor imagery or parametric sky-models, and illuminates scenes with unprecedented accuracy, photorealism, lighting directionality (shadows), and tones in Image Based Lightning (IBL).

AI.tldr: Icarus是一个全天气天空模型，能够学习全动态范围物理捕捉户外图像，实现高精度、逼真的天空环境图生成，特别解决了太阳区域建模难题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习天空模型在重现真实自然天空方面存在不足，特别是在高分辨率下难以准确建模14EV+类别不平衡的太阳区域，导致视觉质量差、光照传输、阴影和色调失真。
AI.method: 提出Icarus模型，能够学习全动态范围物理捕捉户外图像的曝光范围，支持条件生成环境图，允许用户直观定位太阳和云层形态，并扩展了当前最先进技术以实现用户控制的大气形态纹理。
AI.result: Icarus可与全动态范围物理捕捉户外图像或参数化天空模型互换，在基于图像的照明中实现了前所未有的精度、真实感、光照方向性（阴影）和色调。
AI.conclusion: Icarus是一个功能强大的全天气天空模型，能够生成高质量、逼真的天空环境图，解决了现有模型在太阳区域建模和光照准确性方面的关键问题。

title: Tutor Move Taxonomy: A Theory-Aligned Framework for Analyzing Instructional Moves in Tutoring
summary: Understanding what makes tutoring effective requires methods for systematically analyzing tutors' instructional actions during learning interactions. This paper presents a tutor move taxonomy designed to support large-scale analysis of tutoring dialogue within the National Tutoring Observatory. The taxonomy provides a structured annotation framework for labeling tutors' instructional moves during one-on-one tutoring sessions. We developed the taxonomy through a hybrid deductive-inductive process. First, we synthesized research from cognitive science, the learning sciences, classroom discourse analysis, and intelligent tutoring systems to construct a preliminary framework of tutoring moves. We then refined the taxonomy through iterative coding of authentic tutoring transcripts conducted by expert annotators with extensive instructional and qualitative research experience. The resulting taxonomy organizes tutoring behaviors into four categories: tutoring support, learning support, social-emotional and motivational support, and logistical support. Learning support moves are further organized along a spectrum of student engagement, distinguishing between moves that elicit student reasoning and those that provide direct explanation or answers. By defining tutoring dialogue in terms of discrete instructional actions, the taxonomy enables scalable annotation using AI, computational modeling of tutoring strategies, and empirical analysis of how tutoring behaviors relate to learning outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个用于大规模分析辅导对话的辅导行为分类法，通过混合演绎-归纳过程构建，将辅导行为分为四类：辅导支持、学习支持、社会情感与动机支持、后勤支持。
AI.motivation: 理解辅导有效性的关键是需要系统分析辅导者在学习互动中的教学行为，这需要一个能够支持大规模辅导对话分析的结构化框架。
AI.method: 采用混合演绎-归纳方法：首先综合认知科学、学习科学、课堂话语分析和智能辅导系统的研究构建初步框架，然后通过专家标注者对真实辅导转录文本的迭代编码来完善分类法。
AI.result: 开发了一个包含四个主要类别的辅导行为分类法：辅导支持、学习支持、社会情感与动机支持、后勤支持。学习支持行为进一步按学生参与度分为激发学生推理的行为和提供直接解释或答案的行为。
AI.conclusion: 该分类法通过将辅导对话定义为离散的教学行为，能够支持AI规模化标注、辅导策略的计算建模，以及辅导行为与学习结果关系的实证分析。

title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement. 20 pages, 5 figures
summary: Recursive self-improvement is moving from theory to practice: modern systems can critique, revise, and evaluate their own outputs, yet iterative self-modification risks subtle alignment drift. We introduce SAHOO, a practical framework to monitor and control drift through three safeguards: (i) the Goal Drift Index (GDI), a learned multi-signal detector combining semantic, lexical, structural, and distributional measures; (ii) constraint preservation checks that enforce safety-critical invariants such as syntactic correctness and non-hallucination; and (iii) regression-risk quantification to flag improvement cycles that undo prior gains. Across 189 tasks in code generation, mathematical reasoning, and truthfulness, SAHOO produces substantial quality gains, including 18.3 percent improvement in code tasks and 16.8 percent in reasoning, while preserving constraints in two domains and maintaining low violations in truthfulness. Thresholds are calibrated on a small validation set of 18 tasks across three cycles. We further map the capability-alignment frontier, showing efficient early improvement cycles but rising alignment costs later and exposing domain-specific tensions such as fluency versus factuality. SAHOO therefore makes alignment preservation during recursive self-improvement measurable, deployable, and systematically validated at scale.

AI.tldr: SAHOO框架通过三个安全机制监控和控制递归自我改进中的对齐漂移，在代码生成、数学推理和真实性任务中实现显著质量提升，同时保持约束。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进正从理论走向实践，但迭代自我修改可能导致微妙的对齐漂移，需要实用框架来监控和控制这种漂移风险。
AI.method: SAHOO框架包含三个安全机制：1)目标漂移指数(GDI)，结合语义、词汇、结构和分布测量的多信号检测器；2)约束保持检查，强制执行安全关键不变量；3)回归风险量化，标记可能撤销先前改进的循环。
AI.result: 在189个任务中，SAHOO在代码任务上实现18.3%改进，推理任务上实现16.8%改进，同时在两个领域保持约束，在真实性任务中保持低违规率。阈值在18个任务的验证集上校准。
AI.conclusion: SAHOO使递归自我改进期间的对齐保持变得可测量、可部署和可系统验证，揭示了能力-对齐边界，显示早期改进效率高但后期对齐成本上升。

title: Layer-wise Instance Binding for Regional and Occlusion Control in Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformers
summary: Region-instructed layout control in text-to-image generation is highly practical, yet existing methods suffer from limitations: (i) training-based approaches inherit data bias and often degrade image quality, and (ii) current techniques struggle with occlusion order, limiting real-world usability. To address these issues, we propose LayerBind. By modeling regional generation as distinct layers and binding them during the generation, our method enables precise regional and occlusion controllability.
