We propose a critic-free and efficient RL algorithm named MAPO that leverages dense process feedback from a judge model and propagates long-horizon effects through Monte Carlo returns. To stabilize optimization, we introduce a mixed advantage estimator that combines turn-level normalization with batch-level normalization, enabling fine-grained yet scalable credit assignment. Across multiple subjective dialogue benchmarks, including EMPA, EmoBench, and EQ-Bench, and model scales ranging from 7B to 32B, our method consistently improves both training stability and final performance over outcome-only GRPO and single-level normalization baselines. On EMPA, we improve rates by up to 9 points and increase dialogue scores by as much as +43.2 over the 7B base model. Despite training only on EMPA-style environments, our approach generalizes well, yielding consistent improvements on unseen emotional-intelligence benchmarks, including up to +4 points on EmoBench and +3.5 on EQ-Bench. Together, these results demonstrate that dense process supervision combined with mixed-level normalization enables effective and scalable RL for subjective, open-ended multi-turn dialogue.

AI.tldr: MAPO：一种基于密集过程反馈和混合优势估计的无critic强化学习算法，用于主观多轮对话任务，通过蒙特卡洛回报传播长时程效应，在多个情感对话基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 主观多轮对话任务（如情感支持）需要适应动态用户状态并优化长期交互质量的对话策略。然而，强化学习在此类任务中面临挑战：缺乏可靠的过程监督，仅基于结果的训练将多轮信用分配压缩为单一轨迹级奖励，而简单的轮级组采样在交互环境中成本过高。
AI.method: 提出MAPO算法：1）利用评判模型提供密集过程反馈；2）通过蒙特卡洛回报传播长时程效应；3）引入混合优势估计器，结合轮级归一化和批次级归一化，实现细粒度且可扩展的信用分配。
AI.result: 在EMPA、EmoBench和EQ-Bench等多个主观对话基准上，从7B到32B不同模型规模下，MAPO均优于仅基于结果的GRPO和单级归一化基线。在EMPA上提升率高达9个百分点，对话分数比7B基础模型提升+43.2。尽管仅在EMPA风格环境中训练，方法在未见过的情感智能基准上泛化良好，在EmoBench上提升高达+4分，EQ-Bench上+3.5分。
AI.conclusion: 密集过程监督与混合级归一化相结合，能够实现主观、开放式多轮对话的有效且可扩展强化学习，显著提升训练稳定性和最终性能，并展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: Towards Driver Behavior Understanding: Weakly-Supervised Risk Perception in Driving Scenes
summary: Achieving zero-collision mobility remains a key objective for intelligent vehicle systems, which requires understanding driver risk perception-a complex cognitive process shaped by voluntary response of the driver to external stimuli and the attentiveness of surrounding road users towards the ego-vehicle. To support progress in this area, we introduce RAID (Risk Assessment In Driving scenes)-a large-scale dataset specifically curated for research on driver risk perception and contextual risk assessment. RAID comprises 4,691 annotated video clips, covering diverse traffic scenarios with labels for driver's intended maneuver, road topology, risk situations (e.g., crossing pedestrians), driver responses, and pedestrian attentiveness. Leveraging RAID, we propose a weakly supervised risk object identification framework that models the relationship between driver's intended maneuver and responses to identify potential risk sources. Additionally, we analyze the role of pedestrian attention in estimating risk and demonstrate the value of the proposed dataset. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves 20.6% and 23.1% performance gains over prior state-of-the-art approaches on the RAID and HDDS datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RAID数据集，这是一个专门用于驾驶员风险感知研究的大规模数据集，包含4,691个标注视频片段，并提出了一种弱监督风险对象识别框架，在RAID和HDDS数据集上分别实现了20.6%和23.1%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 实现零碰撞移动性是智能车辆系统的关键目标，这需要理解驾驶员的风险感知——一个复杂的认知过程，受到驾驶员对外部刺激的自愿反应以及周围道路使用者对自车的关注度的影响。目前缺乏专门用于驾驶员风险感知研究的大规模数据集。
AI.method: 1. 引入RAID数据集：包含4,691个标注视频片段，涵盖多样交通场景，标注内容包括驾驶员意图操作、道路拓扑、风险情况、驾驶员反应和行人注意力等。2. 提出弱监督风险对象识别框架：通过建模驾驶员意图操作与反应之间的关系来识别潜在风险源。3. 分析行人注意力在风险评估中的作用。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，所提出的方法在RAID数据集上比现有最先进方法性能提升20.6%，在HDDS数据集上提升23.1%。
AI.conclusion: RAID数据集为驾驶员风险感知研究提供了有价值的资源，提出的弱监督风险对象识别框架有效提升了风险识别性能，行人注意力分析进一步增强了风险评估的准确性。

title: Wisdom of the AI Crowd (AI-CROWD) for Ground Truth Approximation in Content Analysis: A Research Protocol & Validation Using Eleven Large Language Models
summary: Large-scale content analysis is increasingly limited by the absence of observable ground truth or gold-standard labels, as creating such benchmarks through extensive human coding becomes impractical for massive datasets due to high time, cost, and consistency challenges. To overcome this barrier, we introduce the AI-CROWD protocol, which approximates ground truth by leveraging the collective outputs of an ensemble of large language models (LLMs). Rather than asserting that the resulting labels are true ground truth, the protocol generates a consensus-based approximation derived from convergent and divergent inferences across multiple models. By aggregating outputs via majority voting and interrogating agreement/disagreement patterns with diagnostic metrics, AI-CROWD identifies high-confidence classifications while flagging potential ambiguity or model-specific biases.

AI.tldr: AI-CROWD协议通过集成多个大语言模型的集体输出来近似真实标签，解决大规模内容分析中缺乏可观测真实标签的问题
AI.motivation: 大规模内容分析面临缺乏可观测真实标签的挑战，因为通过人工编码创建基准在大数据集上变得不切实际，存在时间、成本和一致性方面的困难
AI.method: 引入AI-CROWD协议，利用大语言模型集合的集体输出近似真实标签，通过多数投票聚合输出，并使用诊断指标分析一致/不一致模式
AI.result: 协议生成基于共识的近似标签，识别高置信度分类，同时标记潜在歧义或模型特定偏差
AI.conclusion: AI-CROWD协议为大规模内容分析提供了一种实用的解决方案，通过模型集体智慧近似真实标签，克服了传统人工标注的限制

title: MM-ISTS: Cooperating Irregularly Sampled Time Series Forecasting with Multimodal Vision-Text LLMs
summary: Irregularly sampled time series (ISTS) are widespread in real-world scenarios, exhibiting asynchronous observations on uneven time intervals across variables. Existing ISTS forecasting methods often solely utilize historical observations to predict future ones while falling short in learning contextual semantics and fine-grained temporal patterns. To address these problems, we achieve MM-ISTS, a multimodal framework augmented by vision-text large language models, that bridges temporal, visual, and textual modalities, facilitating ISTS forecasting. MM-ISTS encompasses a novel two-stage encoding mechanism. In particular, a cross-modal vision-text encoding module is proposed to automatically generate informative visual images and textual data, enabling the capture of intricate temporal patterns and comprehensive contextual understanding, in collaboration with multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). In parallel, ISTS encoding extracts complementary yet enriched temporal features from historical ISTS observations, including multi-view embedding fusion and a temporal-variable encoder. Further, we propose an adaptive query-based feature extractor to compress the learned tokens of MLLMs, filtering out small-scale useful knowledge, which in turn reduces computational costs. In addition, a multimodal alignment module with modality-aware gating is designed to alleviate the modality gap across ISTS, images, and text. Extensive experiments on real data offer insight into the effectiveness of the proposed solutions.

AI.tldr: MM-ISTS是一个基于视觉-文本大语言模型的多模态框架，用于不规则采样时间序列预测，通过融合时间、视觉和文本模态来提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有不规则采样时间序列预测方法主要依赖历史观测数据，缺乏对上下文语义和细粒度时间模式的学习能力，需要更全面的多模态解决方案。
AI.method: 提出两阶段编码机制：1)跨模态视觉-文本编码模块自动生成信息丰富的视觉图像和文本数据；2)ISTS编码提取历史观测的时序特征。还包括自适应查询特征提取器和多模态对齐模块。
AI.result: 在真实数据上的大量实验证明了所提解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MM-ISTS通过融合时间、视觉和文本模态，能够捕捉复杂的时间模式和全面的上下文理解，为不规则采样时间序列预测提供了有效的多模态解决方案。

title: Beyond Static Frames: Temporal Aggregate-and-Restore Vision Transformer for Human Pose Estimation
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have recently achieved state-of-the-art performance in 2D human pose estimation due to their strong global modeling capability. However, existing ViT-based pose estimators are designed for static images and process each frame independently, thereby ignoring the temporal coherence that exists in video sequences. This limitation often results in unstable predictions, especially in challenging scenes involving motion blur, occlusion, or defocus. In this paper, we propose TAR-ViTPose, a novel Temporal Aggregate-and-Restore Vision Transformer tailored for video-based 2D human pose estimation. TAR-ViTPose enhances static ViT representations by aggregating temporal cues across frames in a plug-and-play manner, leading to more robust and accurate pose estimation. To effectively aggregate joint-specific features that are temporally aligned across frames, we introduce a joint-centric temporal aggregation (JTA) that assigns each joint a learnable query token to selectively attend to its corresponding regions from neighboring frames. Furthermore, we develop a global restoring attention (GRA) to restore the aggregated temporal features back into the token sequence of the current frame, enriching its pose representation while fully preserving global context for precise keypoint localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAR-ViTPose substantially improves upon the single-frame baseline ViTPose, achieving a +2.3 mAP gain on the PoseTrack2017 benchmark. Moreover, our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art video-based methods, while also achieving a noticeably higher runtime frame rate in real-world applications. Project page: https://github.com/zgspose/TARViTPose.

AI.tldr: TAR-ViTPose：一种用于视频2D人体姿态估计的时序聚合与恢复视觉Transformer，通过聚合跨帧的时序线索提升静态ViT表示，实现更鲁棒准确的姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有基于ViT的姿态估计器针对静态图像设计，独立处理每一帧，忽略了视频序列中的时序一致性，导致在运动模糊、遮挡或失焦等挑战性场景中预测不稳定。
AI.method: 提出TAR-ViTPose，包含两个核心模块：1）关节中心时序聚合（JTA）：为每个关节分配可学习的查询token，选择性地关注相邻帧中对应区域；2）全局恢复注意力（GRA）：将聚合的时序特征恢复回当前帧的token序列，丰富姿态表示同时保留全局上下文。
AI.result: 在PoseTrack2017基准测试上相比单帧基线ViTPose提升+2.3 mAP，超越现有最先进的视频方法，并在实际应用中实现更高的运行时帧率。
AI.conclusion: TAR-ViTPose通过有效的时序聚合与恢复机制，显著提升了视频姿态估计的准确性和鲁棒性，同时保持了高效的推理速度。

title: LIT-RAGBench: Benchmarking Generator Capabilities of Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Published as a conference paper at LREC 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a framework in which a Generator, such as a Large Language Model (LLM), produces answers by retrieving documents from an external collection using a Retriever. In practice, Generators must integrate evidence from long contexts, perform multi-step reasoning, interpret tables, and abstain when evidence is missing. However, existing benchmarks for Generators provide limited coverage, with none enabling simultaneous evaluation of multiple capabilities under unified conditions. To bridge the gap between existing evaluations and practical use, we introduce LIT-RAGBench (the Logic, Integration, Table, Reasoning, and Abstention RAG Generator Benchmark), which defines five categories: Integration, Reasoning, Logic, Table, and Abstention, each further divided into practical evaluation aspects. LIT-RAGBench systematically covers patterns combining multiple aspects across categories. By using fictional entities and scenarios, LIT-RAGBench evaluates answers grounded in the provided external documents. The dataset consists of 114 human-constructed Japanese questions and an English version generated by machine translation with human curation. We use LLM-as-a-Judge for scoring and report category-wise and overall accuracy. Across API-based and open-weight models, no model exceeds 90% overall accuracy. By making strengths and weaknesses measurable within each category, LIT-RAGBench serves as a valuable metric for model selection in practical RAG deployments and for building RAG-specialized models. We release LIT-RAGBench, including the dataset and evaluation code, at https://github.com/Koki-Itai/LIT-RAGBench.

AI.tldr: LIT-RAGBench是一个新的RAG生成器基准测试，涵盖集成、推理、逻辑、表格和弃权五个类别，通过虚构实体和场景评估模型在实际RAG部署中的综合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG生成器基准测试覆盖范围有限，无法在统一条件下同时评估多种实际应用所需的能力，如长上下文整合、多步推理、表格解释和证据缺失时的弃权判断。
AI.method: 创建LIT-RAGBench基准测试，定义五个评估类别（集成、推理、逻辑、表格、弃权），每个类别进一步细分为实际评估方面。使用虚构实体和场景构建114个人工编写的日语问题，并通过机器翻译和人工校对生成英文版本。采用LLM-as-a-Judge方法进行评分。
AI.result: 在API和开源模型测试中，没有任何模型超过90%的整体准确率。基准测试能够清晰测量各模型在不同类别中的优势和弱点，为实际RAG部署中的模型选择和RAG专用模型构建提供有价值的指标。
AI.conclusion: LIT-RAGBench填补了现有评估与实际应用需求之间的差距，通过系统覆盖多类别组合模式，为RAG生成器的综合能力评估提供了统一框架，有助于推动RAG技术的实际部署和专用模型开发。

title: Demystifying KAN for Vision Tasks: The RepKAN Approach
summary: Remote sensing image classification is essential for Earth observation, yet standard CNNs and Transformers often function as uninterpretable black-boxes. We propose RepKAN, a novel architecture that integrates the structural efficiency of CNNs with the non-linear representational power of KANs. By utilizing a dual-path design -- Spatial Linear and Spectral Non-linear -- RepKAN enables the autonomous discovery of class-specific spectral fingerprints and physical interaction manifolds. Experimental results on the EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45 datasets demonstrate that RepKAN provides explicit physically interpretable reasoning while outperforming state-of-the-art models. These findings indicate that RepKAN holds significant potential to serve as the backbone for future interpretable visual foundation models.

AI.tldr: RepKAN是一种新颖的遥感图像分类架构，结合CNN的结构效率和KAN的非线性表示能力，通过双路径设计实现物理可解释的分类，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN和Transformer在遥感图像分类中通常作为不可解释的黑盒模型，缺乏对分类决策的物理可解释性，这限制了模型在实际地球观测应用中的可信度和实用性。
AI.method: 提出RepKAN架构，集成CNN的结构效率和KAN的非线性表示能力，采用双路径设计：空间线性路径和光谱非线性路径，能够自主发现类别特定的光谱指纹和物理交互流形。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT和NWPU-RESISC45数据集上的实验结果表明，RepKAN在提供明确的物理可解释推理的同时，性能超越了当前最先进的模型。
AI.conclusion: RepKAN具有显著潜力成为未来可解释视觉基础模型的主干架构，为遥感图像分类提供了既高性能又具有物理可解释性的解决方案。

title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling
summary: Long-context modeling is a pivotal capability for Large Language Models, yet the quadratic complexity of attention remains a critical bottleneck, particularly during the compute-intensive prefilling phase. While various sparse attention mechanisms have been explored, they typically suffer from either significant search latency or insufficient sparsity. In this paper, we propose FlashPrefill, a framework enabling ultra-fast prefilling via instantaneous pattern discovery and thresholding. FlashPrefill leverages a fast block-searching technique to simultaneously locate dynamic vertical, slash, and block-sparse attention patterns. Crucially, it introduces a dynamic thresholding mechanism that bypasses the prohibitive overhead of sorting or accumulating attention scores while effectively eliminating the long-tail distribution to enhance sparsity. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FlashPrefill achieves a substantial leap in efficiency, delivering an unprecedented 27.78x speedup on 256K sequences. Notably, unlike existing methods that incur efficiency degradation on shorter contexts, FlashPrefill maintains a 1.71x speedup even at a 4K context length, demonstrating its robustness and practical utility across varying sequence scales.

AI.tldr: FlashPrefill是一个通过即时模式发现和阈值处理实现超快速预填充的框架，解决了长上下文建模中注意力机制二次复杂度的问题，在256K序列上实现了27.78倍加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文建模是大语言模型的关键能力，但注意力的二次复杂度在计算密集的预填充阶段成为关键瓶颈。现有的稀疏注意力机制要么有显著的搜索延迟，要么稀疏性不足。
AI.method: FlashPrefill采用快速块搜索技术同时定位动态垂直、斜线和块稀疏注意力模式，并引入动态阈值机制，避免了对注意力分数排序或累积的过高开销，同时有效消除长尾分布以增强稀疏性。
AI.result: 在256K序列上实现了前所未有的27.78倍加速，即使在4K上下文长度下也能保持1.71倍加速，表明该方法在不同序列规模下都具有鲁棒性和实用价值。
AI.conclusion: FlashPrefill通过创新的模式发现和动态阈值技术，显著提高了长上下文建模的预填充效率，解决了现有稀疏注意力方法的局限性，为大规模序列处理提供了实用解决方案。

title: SPOT: Span-level Pause-of-Thought for Efficient and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Explicit Chain-of-Thought improves the reasoning performance of large language models but often incurs high inference cost due to verbose token-level traces. While recent approaches reduce this overhead via concise prompting or step pruning, they largely truncate what the model says rather than internalize what the model thinks. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by performing computation in the hidden space, yet prior methods face two critical challenges. Many existing approaches rely on rigid point-to-point alignment, forcing a latent token to approximate the final representation of a reasoning step, which can be insufficient to capture the dense, variable-length semantics of an entire reasoning segment. Furthermore, these methods often suffer from a lack of interpretability: latent states are commonly produced by unconstrained optimization or embedding mixing, yielding vectors that are difficult to decode or audit under the pretrained language head. We propose SPOT, a flexible framework that compresses explicit CoT into compact latent pause tokens without enforcing a fixed response template. At the core of SPOT is Span-level Semantic Alignment, a Sinkhorn optimal-transport objective that softly matches each pause token to the semantics of an entire reasoning segment, overcoming the rigidity of step-end alignment. To further improve interpretability, SPOT introduces a Frozen-Head Decoding Constraint that keeps latent states directly decodable as token distributions under the frozen pretrained LM head, enabling readable keyword interpretations of latent thoughts. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPOT improves accuracy by 2.3 points on average while reducing generated tokens by 37.5% and provides faithful semantic interpretations of the latent reasoning process.

AI.tldr: SPOT框架通过将显式思维链压缩为紧凑的潜在暂停令牌，在减少推理成本的同时提升推理性能，并提供可解释的潜在推理过程。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链虽然能提升大语言模型的推理性能，但会产生冗长的令牌级追踪，导致高昂的推理成本。现有方法主要通过简洁提示或步骤剪枝来减少开销，但大多只是截断模型输出而非内化模型思考。潜在推理提供了有前景的替代方案，但面临两个关键挑战：1) 现有方法依赖刚性的点对点对齐，强制潜在令牌近似推理步骤的最终表示，难以捕捉整个推理段的密集、变长语义；2) 缺乏可解释性，潜在状态通常通过无约束优化或嵌入混合产生，难以在预训练语言头下解码或审计。
AI.method: SPOT框架通过两个核心技术：1) 跨度级语义对齐：使用Sinkhorn最优传输目标，将每个暂停令牌软匹配到整个推理段的语义，克服步骤末端对齐的刚性；2) 冻结头解码约束：保持潜在状态在冻结的预训练LM头下可直接解码为令牌分布，实现对潜在思考的可读关键词解释。该方法不强制固定的响应模板，灵活地将显式思维链压缩为紧凑的潜在暂停令牌。
AI.result: 在推理基准测试中，SPOT平均提升准确率2.3个百分点，同时减少生成令牌37.5%，并能提供潜在推理过程的忠实语义解释。
AI.conclusion: SPOT框架成功解决了潜在推理中的语义对齐和可解释性挑战，在减少推理成本的同时提升性能，并为潜在推理过程提供了可解释的语义洞察。

title: Probing Visual Concepts in Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Automated Driving
summary: The use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in automated driving applications is becoming increasingly common, with the aim of leveraging their reasoning and generalisation capabilities to handle long tail scenarios. However, these models often fail on simple visual questions that are highly relevant to automated driving, and the reasons behind these failures remain poorly understood. In this work, we examine the intermediate activations of VLMs and assess the extent to which specific visual concepts are linearly encoded, with the goal of identifying bottlenecks in the flow of visual information. Specifically, we create counterfactual image sets that differ only in a targeted visual concept and then train linear probes to distinguish between them using the activations of four state-of-the-art (SOTA) VLMs. Our results show that concepts such as the presence of an object or agent in a scene are explicitly and linearly encoded, whereas other spatial visual concepts, such as the orientation of an object or agent, are only implicitly encoded by the spatial structure retained by the vision encoder. In parallel, we observe that in certain cases, even when a concept is linearly encoded in the model's activations, the model still fails to answer correctly. This leads us to identify two failure modes. The first is perceptual failure, where the visual information required to answer a question is not linearly encoded in the model's activations. The second is cognitive failure, where the visual information is present but the model fails to align it correctly with language semantics. Finally, we show that increasing the distance of the object in question quickly degrades the linear separability of the corresponding visual concept. Overall, our findings improve our understanding of failure cases in VLMs on simple visual tasks that are highly relevant to automated driving.

AI.tldr: 研究通过分析视觉语言模型在自动驾驶场景中的中间激活，发现某些视觉概念（如物体存在）是线性编码的，而其他空间概念（如物体朝向）则仅隐式编码，并识别出感知失败和认知失败两种故障模式。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶应用中越来越普遍，但它们经常在简单的视觉问题上失败，且失败原因尚不清楚。本研究旨在通过分析模型中间激活来理解这些失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 创建仅针对特定视觉概念不同的反事实图像集，然后训练线性探针来区分这些图像，使用四种最先进视觉语言模型的激活进行分析，评估视觉概念的线性编码程度。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）物体存在等概念是显式线性编码的；2）物体朝向等空间概念仅通过视觉编码器保留的空间结构隐式编码；3）识别出两种故障模式：感知失败（视觉信息未线性编码）和认知失败（信息存在但未正确对齐语言语义）；4）物体距离增加会快速降低对应视觉概念的线性可分性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提高了对视觉语言模型在自动驾驶相关简单视觉任务中失败案例的理解，揭示了视觉信息在模型中的编码方式以及故障的根本原因，为改进模型性能提供了重要见解。

title: Mind the Gap: Pitfalls of LLM Alignment with Asian Public Opinion
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in multilingual, multicultural settings, yet their reliance on predominantly English-centric training data risks misalignment with the diverse cultural values of different societies. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, multilingual audit of the cultural alignment of contemporary LLMs including GPT-4o-Mini, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Llama 3.2, Mistral and Gemma 3 across India, East Asia and Southeast Asia. Our study specifically focuses on the sensitive domain of religion as the prism for broader alignment. To facilitate this, we conduct a multi-faceted analysis of every LLM's internal representations, using log-probs/logits, to compare the model's opinion distributions against ground-truth public attitudes. We find that while the popular models generally align with public opinion on broad social issues, they consistently fail to accurately represent religious viewpoints, especially those of minority groups, often amplifying negative stereotypes. Lightweight interventions, such as demographic priming and native language prompting, partially mitigate but do not eliminate these cultural gaps. We further show that downstream evaluations on bias benchmarks (such as CrowS-Pairs, IndiBias, ThaiCLI, KoBBQ) reveal persistent harms and under-representation in sensitive contexts. Our findings underscore the urgent need for systematic, regionally grounded audits to ensure equitable global deployment of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在跨文化部署中存在宗教价值观错位问题，尤其对少数群体存在负面刻板印象，需要系统性的区域化审计。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs主要依赖英语中心训练数据，在多元文化环境中部署时，其文化价值观与不同社会的多样性存在错配风险，特别是在宗教等敏感领域。
AI.method: 对GPT-4o-Mini、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Llama 3.2、Mistral和Gemma 3等当代LLMs进行多语言审计，聚焦印度、东亚和东南亚地区，使用对数概率/对数似然分析模型内部表征，对比模型观点分布与真实公众态度。
AI.result: 主流模型在广泛社会议题上能与公众意见保持一致，但在宗教观点上持续失败，尤其无法准确代表少数群体观点，经常放大负面刻板印象。轻量级干预（如人口统计提示和母语提示）只能部分缓解但无法消除文化差距。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在敏感语境中存在持续伤害和代表性不足问题，迫切需要系统性的、基于区域的审计，以确保LLMs在全球部署中的公平性。

title: SLER-IR: Spherical Layer-wise Expert Routing for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: Image restoration under diverse degradations remains challenging for unified all-in-one frameworks due to feature interference and insufficient expert specialization. We propose SLER-IR, a spherical layer-wise expert routing framework that dynamically activates specialized experts across network layers. To ensure reliable routing, we introduce a Spherical Uniform Degradation Embedding with contrastive learning, which maps degradation representations onto a hypersphere to eliminate geometry bias in linear embedding spaces. In addition, a Global-Local Granularity Fusion (GLGF) module integrates global semantics and local degradation cues to address spatially non-uniform degradations and the train-test granularity gap. Experiments on three-task and five-task benchmarks demonstrate that SLER-IR achieves consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods in both PSNR and SSIM. Code and models will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: SLER-IR是一个球面分层专家路由框架，通过动态激活各层专家处理多样化图像退化问题，使用球面均匀退化嵌入消除几何偏差，结合全局-局部粒度融合模块处理空间非均匀退化。
AI.motivation: 现有统一框架在处理多样化退化时面临特征干扰和专家专业化不足的问题，需要更有效的动态专家选择和退化表示方法。
AI.method: 提出球面分层专家路由框架，包含球面均匀退化嵌入（通过对比学习映射到超球面消除几何偏差）和全局-局部粒度融合模块（整合全局语义和局部退化线索）。
AI.result: 在三任务和五任务基准测试中，SLER-IR在PSNR和SSIM指标上均优于现有最先进方法，取得了持续改进。
AI.conclusion: SLER-IR通过球面退化表示和分层专家路由有效解决了多样化图像恢复中的特征干扰和专家专业化问题，为统一框架提供了新思路。

title: The Art That Poses Back: Assessing AI Pastiches after Contemporary Artworks
summary: This study explores artificial visual creativity, focusing on ChatGPT's ability to generate new images intentionally pastiching original artworks such as paintings, drawings, sculptures and installations. The process involved twelve artists from Romania, Bulgaria, France, Austria, and the United Kingdom, each invited to contribute with three of their artworks and to grade and comment on the AI-generated versions. The analysis combines human evaluation with computational methods aimed at detecting visual and stylistic similarities or divergences between the original works and their AI-produced renditions. The results point to a significant gap between color and texture-based similarity and compositional, conceptual, and perceptual one. Consequently, we advocate for the use of a "style transfer dashboard" of complementary metrics to evaluate the similarity between pastiches and originals, rather than using a single style metric. The artists' comments revealed limitations of ChatGPT's pastiches after contemporary artworks, which were perceived by the authors of the originals as lacking dimensionality, context, and intentional sense, and seeming more of a paraphrase or an approximate quotation rather than as a valuable, emotion-evoking artwork.

AI.tldr: 研究探索ChatGPT的人工视觉创造力，通过艺术家评估AI对原创艺术品的模仿能力，发现AI生成作品在色彩纹理相似度与构图概念感知度之间存在显著差距，建议使用多指标仪表板而非单一风格指标来评估相似性。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在探索人工智能（特别是ChatGPT）在视觉创造力方面的能力，特别是其能否有意识地模仿原创艺术作品（如绘画、素描、雕塑和装置艺术），并评估AI生成作品与原始作品之间的相似性和差异。
AI.method: 研究邀请了来自罗马尼亚、保加利亚、法国、奥地利和英国的12位艺术家，每位提供三件原创作品，并对ChatGPT生成的模仿版本进行评分和评论。分析结合了人类评估和计算方法，检测原始作品与AI生成作品之间的视觉和风格相似性或差异。
AI.result: 结果显示，基于颜色和纹理的相似性与构图、概念和感知相似性之间存在显著差距。艺术家评论指出ChatGPT模仿当代艺术作品的局限性：缺乏维度感、背景和意图感，更像是释义或近似引用，而非能引发情感的有价值艺术品。
AI.conclusion: 建议使用"风格转移仪表板"的互补指标来评估模仿作品与原始作品之间的相似性，而非依赖单一风格指标。AI在艺术模仿方面仍有局限性，特别是在传达作品的深层概念和情感维度方面。

title: Adaptive Radial Projection on Fourier Magnitude Spectrum for Document Image Skew Estimation
comment: This paper has been accepted to ICIP 2022
summary: Skew estimation is one of the vital tasks in document processing systems, especially for scanned document images, because its performance impacts subsequent steps directly. Over the years, an enormous number of researches focus on this challenging problem in the rise of digitization age. In this research, we first propose a novel skew estimation method that extracts the dominant skew angle of the given document image by applying an Adaptive Radial Projection on the 2D Discrete Fourier Magnitude spectrum. Second, we introduce a high quality skew estimation dataset DISE-2021 to assess the performance of different estimators. Finally, we provide comprehensive analyses that focus on multiple improvement aspects of Fourier-based methods. Our results show that the proposed method is robust, reliable, and outperforms all compared methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/phamquiluan/jdeskew.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于自适应径向投影的文档图像倾斜估计方法，在傅里叶幅度谱上提取主导倾斜角度，并创建了DISE-2021数据集进行评估。
AI.motivation: 文档倾斜估计是文档处理系统中的关键任务，其性能直接影响后续处理步骤。随着数字化时代的到来，这一挑战性问题需要更有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的倾斜估计方法，通过对2D离散傅里叶幅度谱应用自适应径向投影来提取文档图像的主导倾斜角度。
AI.result: 该方法表现出鲁棒性和可靠性，在所有对比方法中表现最优。同时创建了DISE-2021高质量倾斜估计数据集用于评估。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于自适应径向投影的傅里叶方法在文档倾斜估计任务中表现优异，为傅里叶基方法提供了全面的改进分析，代码已开源。

title: Text-Driven Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation
summary: Talking Face Generation (TFG) strives to create realistic and emotionally expressive digital faces. While previous TFG works have mastered the creation of naturalistic facial movements, they typically express a fixed target emotion in synthetic videos and lack the ability to exhibit continuously changing and natural expressions like humans do when conveying information. To synthesize realistic videos, we propose a novel task called Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation (EC-TFG), which takes a text segment and an emotion description with varying emotions as driving data, aiming to generate a video where the person speaks the text while reflecting the emotional changes within the description. Alongside this, we introduce a customized model, i.e., Temporal-Intensive Emotion Modulated Talking Face Generation (TIE-TFG), which innovatively manages dynamic emotional variations by employing Temporal-Intensive Emotion Fluctuation Modeling, allowing it to provide emotion variation sequences corresponding to the input text to drive continuous facial expression changes in synthesized videos. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our method's exceptional ability to produce smooth emotion transitions and uphold high-quality visuals and motion authenticity across diverse emotional states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出情感连续说话人脸生成（EC-TFG）新任务，并开发TIE-TFG模型，通过时序密集情感波动建模实现动态情感变化，生成具有自然情感过渡的说话视频。
AI.motivation: 现有说话人脸生成方法虽然能生成自然的面部运动，但通常只能表达固定的目标情感，缺乏人类在传达信息时那种连续变化的自然表达能力，无法展现真实的情感动态变化。
AI.method: 提出TIE-TFG模型，采用时序密集情感波动建模技术，能够根据输入文本生成对应的情感变化序列，驱动合成视频中连续的面部表情变化。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，该方法在生成平滑情感过渡方面表现优异，能够在不同情感状态下保持高质量的视觉效果和运动真实性。
AI.conclusion: EC-TFG任务和TIE-TFG模型成功解决了传统TFG方法中情感表达固定的局限性，实现了更自然、动态的情感连续变化，为生成更真实的说话人脸视频提供了有效解决方案。

title: LucidNFT: LR-Anchored Multi-Reward Preference Optimization for Generative Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Generative real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) can synthesize visually convincing details from severely degraded low-resolution (LR) inputs, yet its stochastic sampling makes a critical failure mode hard to avoid: outputs may look sharp but be unfaithful to the LR evidence (semantic and structural hallucination), while such LR-anchored faithfulness is difficult to assess without HR ground truth. Preference-based reinforcement learning (RL) is a natural fit because each LR input yields a rollout group of candidates to compare. However, effective alignment in Real-ISR is hindered by (i) the lack of a degradation-robust LR-referenced faithfulness signal, and (ii) a rollout-group optimization bottleneck where naive multi-reward scalarization followed by normalization compresses objective-wise contrasts, causing advantage collapse and weakening the reward-weighted updates in DiffusionNFT-style forward fine-tuning. Moreover, (iii) limited coverage of real degradations restricts rollout diversity and preference signal quality. We propose LucidNFT, a multi-reward RL framework for flow-matching Real-ISR. LucidNFT introduces LucidConsistency, a degradation-robust semantic evaluator that makes LR-anchored faithfulness measurable and optimizable; a decoupled advantage normalization strategy that preserves objective-wise contrasts within each LR-conditioned rollout group before fusion, preventing advantage collapse; and LucidLR, a large-scale collection of real-world degraded images to support robust RL fine-tuning. Experiments show that LucidNFT consistently improves strong flow-based Real-ISR baselines, achieving better perceptual-faithfulness trade-offs with stable optimization dynamics across diverse real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: LucidNFT是一个用于真实世界图像超分辨率的强化学习框架，通过引入LR锚定的忠实度评估器、解耦优势归一化策略和大规模真实退化图像数据集，解决了现有方法中的语义幻觉、优势崩溃和训练数据不足问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式真实世界图像超分辨率存在语义和结构幻觉问题，即输出看起来清晰但与低分辨率输入证据不忠实。基于偏好的强化学习虽然适合，但面临三个主要障碍：缺乏退化鲁棒的LR参考忠实度信号、rollout组优化瓶颈导致优势崩溃，以及真实退化数据覆盖有限。
AI.method: 提出LucidNFT框架：1) LucidConsistency - 退化鲁棒的语义评估器，使LR锚定的忠实度可测量和可优化；2) 解耦优势归一化策略 - 在融合前保留每个LR条件下的rollout组内目标间对比度，防止优势崩溃；3) LucidLR - 大规模真实世界退化图像数据集，支持鲁棒的RL微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，LucidNFT能持续改进基于流的真实世界超分辨率基线，在多样真实世界场景中实现更好的感知-忠实度权衡，并具有稳定的优化动态。
AI.conclusion: LucidNFT通过解决真实世界图像超分辨率中的忠实度评估、优化瓶颈和数据覆盖问题，为生成式超分辨率提供了有效的强化学习框架，实现了更好的感知质量与输入忠实度的平衡。

title: Evaluation of Deontic Conditional Reasoning in Large Language Models: The Case of Wason's Selection Task
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of EACL 2026
summary: As large language models (LLMs) advance in linguistic competence, their reasoning abilities are gaining increasing attention. In humans, reasoning often performs well in domain specific settings, particularly in normative rather than purely formal contexts. Although prior studies have compared LLM and human reasoning, the domain specificity of LLM reasoning remains underexplored. In this study, we introduce a new Wason Selection Task dataset that explicitly encodes deontic modality to systematically distinguish deontic from descriptive conditionals, and use it to examine LLMs' conditional reasoning under deontic rules. We further analyze whether observed error patterns are better explained by confirmation bias (a tendency to seek rule-supporting evidence) or by matching bias (a tendency to ignore negation and select items that lexically match elements of the rule). Results show that, like humans, LLMs reason better with deontic rules and display matching-bias-like errors. Together, these findings suggest that the performance of LLMs varies systematically across rule types and that their error patterns can parallel well-known human biases in this paradigm.

AI.tldr: LLMs在规范性条件推理中表现更好，显示出类似人类的匹配偏见错误模式
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型语言能力提升，其推理能力受到关注。人类推理在特定领域（特别是规范性而非纯形式化情境）表现良好，但LLM推理的领域特异性尚未充分探索
AI.method: 引入新的Wason选择任务数据集，明确编码道义模态以区分规范性条件句和描述性条件句，用于检验LLM在规范性规则下的条件推理能力，并分析错误模式是由确认偏见还是匹配偏见解释
AI.result: 与人类类似，LLMs在规范性规则下推理表现更好，并显示出类似匹配偏见的错误模式（倾向于忽略否定并选择与规则词汇匹配的项目）
AI.conclusion: LLMs的性能在不同规则类型间存在系统性差异，其错误模式可以平行于该范式中已知的人类偏见

title: From Prompting to Preference Optimization: A Comparative Study of LLM-based Automated Essay Scoring
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently reshaped Automated Essay Scoring (AES), yet prior studies typically examine individual techniques in isolation, limiting understanding of their relative merits for English as a Second Language (L2) writing. To bridge this gap, we presents a comprehensive comparison of major LLM-based AES paradigms on IELTS Writing Task~2. On this unified benchmark, we evaluate four approaches: (i) encoder-based classification fine-tuning, (ii) zero- and few-shot prompting, (iii) instruction tuning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and (iv) Supervised Fine-Tuning combined with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and RAG. Our results reveal clear accuracy-cost-robustness trade-offs across methods, the best configuration, integrating k-SFT and RAG, achieves the strongest overall results with F1-Score 93%. This study offers the first unified empirical comparison of modern LLM-based AES strategies for English L2, promising potential in auto-grading writing tasks. Code is public at https://github.com/MinhNguyenDS/LLM_AES-EnL2

AI.tldr: 该研究对基于大语言模型的英语二语写作自动评分方法进行了首次统一比较，在雅思写作任务2上评估了四种主要范式，发现最佳配置（k-SFT+RAG）达到93%的F1分数，揭示了不同方法在准确性、成本和鲁棒性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型已经重塑了自动作文评分领域，但先前研究通常孤立地考察个别技术，限制了人们对这些技术在英语二语写作评分中相对优势的理解。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在统一的雅思写作任务2基准上，评估了四种主要方法：(1) 基于编码器的分类微调；(2) 零样本和少样本提示；(3) 指令调优和检索增强生成；(4) 监督微调结合直接偏好优化和检索增强生成。
AI.result: 研究结果揭示了不同方法在准确性、成本和鲁棒性之间的明确权衡。最佳配置（集成k-SFT和RAG）取得了最强的整体结果，F1分数达到93%。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究首次对现代基于大语言模型的英语二语自动评分策略进行了统一的实证比较，展示了在自动评分写作任务方面的潜力。代码已公开。

title: Unify the Views: View-Consistent Prototype Learning for Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) has gained significant attention for its ability to generalize to novel classes with limited supervision, yet remains challenged by structural misalignment and cross-view inconsistency under large appearance or viewpoint variations. This paper tackles these challenges by introducing VINE (View-Informed NEtwork), a unified framework that jointly models structural consistency and foreground discrimination to refine class-specific prototypes. Specifically, VINE introduces a spatial-view graph on backbone features, where the spatial graph captures local geometric topology and the view graph connects features from different perspectives to propagate view-invariant structural semantics. To further alleviate foreground ambiguity, we derive a discriminative prior from the support-query feature discrepancy to capture category-specific contrast, which reweights SAM features by emphasizing salient regions and recalibrates backbone activations for improved structural focus. The foreground-enhanced SAM features and structurally enriched ResNet features are progressively integrated through masked cross-attention, yielding class-consistent prototypes used as adaptive prompts for the SAM decoder to generate accurate masks. Extensive experiments on multiple FSS benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of VINE, particularly under challenging scenarios with viewpoint shifts and complex structures. The code is available at https://github.com/HongliLiu1/VINE-main.

AI.tldr: VINE是一个统一的少样本分割框架，通过联合建模结构一致性和前景判别性来优化类别特定原型，特别针对视角变化和结构复杂场景。
AI.motivation: 少样本分割在有限监督下泛化到新类别时面临结构错位和跨视角不一致的挑战，特别是在外观或视角变化较大的情况下。
AI.method: 引入空间-视角图在骨干特征上，空间图捕捉局部几何拓扑，视角图连接不同视角特征以传播视角不变的结构语义；利用支持-查询特征差异获取判别性先验，重新加权SAM特征并重新校准骨干激活；通过掩码交叉注意力逐步集成前景增强的SAM特征和结构丰富的ResNet特征，生成类别一致原型作为SAM解码器的自适应提示。
AI.result: 在多个少样本分割基准测试上的广泛实验验证了VINE的有效性和鲁棒性，特别是在具有视角偏移和复杂结构的挑战性场景中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VINE通过联合建模结构一致性和前景判别性，有效解决了少样本分割中的结构错位和跨视角不一致问题，为视角变化和复杂结构场景提供了鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Abductive Reasoning with Syllogistic Forms in Large Language Models
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Human and Artificial Rationalities (HAR 2024), LNCS 15504, pp. 3-17
summary: Research in AI using Large-Language Models (LLMs) is rapidly evolving, and the comparison of their performance with human reasoning has become a key concern. Prior studies have indicated that LLMs and humans share similar biases, such as dismissing logically valid inferences that contradict common beliefs. However, criticizing LLMs for these biases might be unfair, considering our reasoning not only involves formal deduction but also abduction, which draws tentative conclusions from limited information. Abduction can be regarded as the inverse form of syllogism in its basic structure, that is, a process of drawing a minor premise from a major premise and conclusion. This paper explores the accuracy of LLMs in abductive reasoning by converting a syllogistic dataset into one suitable for abduction. It aims to investigate whether the state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit biases in abduction and to identify potential areas for improvement, emphasizing the importance of contextualized reasoning beyond formal deduction. This investigation is vital for advancing the understanding and application of LLMs in complex reasoning tasks, offering insights into bridging the gap between machine and human cognition.

AI.tldr: 该研究将三段论数据集转换为溯因推理任务，评估大语言模型在溯因推理中的准确性和偏见，探索其与人类推理的差异
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明大语言模型与人类存在相似的推理偏见，但批评大语言模型可能不公平，因为人类推理不仅包含形式演绎，还包含基于有限信息的溯因推理。需要评估大语言模型在溯因推理中的表现，探索其与人类认知的差距
AI.method: 将三段论数据集转换为适合溯因推理的形式，用于评估最先进的大语言模型在溯因推理中的准确性和偏见
AI.result: 研究发现大语言模型在溯因推理中存在偏见，需要进一步改进，强调超越形式演绎的语境化推理的重要性
AI.conclusion: 这项研究对于推进大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的理解和应用至关重要，为弥合机器与人类认知之间的差距提供了见解

title: OVGGT: O(1) Constant-Cost Streaming Visual Geometry Transformer
summary: Reconstructing 3D geometry from streaming video requires continuous inference under bounded resources. Recent geometric foundation models achieve impressive reconstruction quality through all-to-all attention, yet their quadratic cost confines them to short, offline sequences. Causal-attention variants such as StreamVGGT enable single-pass streaming but accumulate an ever-growing KV cache, exhausting GPU memory within hundreds of frames and precluding the long-horizon deployment that motivates streaming inference in the first place. We present OVGGT, a training-free framework that bounds both memory and compute to a fixed budget regardless of sequence length. Our approach combines Self-Selective Caching, which leverages FFN residual magnitudes to compress the KV cache while remaining fully compatible with FlashAttention, with Dynamic Anchor Protection, which shields coordinate-critical tokens from eviction to suppress geometric drift over extended trajectories. Extensive experiments on indoor, outdoor, and ultra-long sequence benchmarks demonstrate that OVGGT processes arbitrarily long videos within a constant VRAM envelope while achieving state-of-the-art 3D geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: OVGGT：一种训练无关的框架，通过自选择性缓存和动态锚点保护技术，在固定内存和计算预算下实现任意长度视频的3D几何重建，解决了现有方法因KV缓存无限增长而无法处理长序列的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有几何基础模型虽然重建质量高，但全注意力机制二次计算成本高，只能处理短序列；因果注意力变体如StreamVGGT虽然支持单次流式处理，但KV缓存会无限增长，导致GPU内存很快耗尽，无法实现真正意义上的长序列流式推理。
AI.method: 提出OVGGT框架：1）自选择性缓存：利用FFN残差幅度压缩KV缓存，同时完全兼容FlashAttention；2）动态锚点保护：保护坐标关键标记不被驱逐，抑制长轨迹中的几何漂移。该框架无需训练，可在固定内存和计算预算下工作。
AI.result: 在室内、室外和超长序列基准测试中，OVGGT能够在恒定VRAM限制下处理任意长度视频，同时实现最先进的3D几何精度。
AI.conclusion: OVGGT通过创新的缓存压缩和关键标记保护机制，首次实现了在固定资源预算下对任意长度视频的3D几何重建，解决了流式视频处理中的内存和计算瓶颈问题。

title: PONTE: Personalized Orchestration for Natural Language Trustworthy Explanations
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) seeks to enhance the transparency and accountability of machine learning systems, yet most methods follow a one-size-fits-all paradigm that neglects user differences in expertise, goals, and cognitive needs. Although Large Language Models can translate technical explanations into natural language, they introduce challenges related to faithfulness and hallucinations. To address these challenges, we present PONTE (Personalized Orchestration for Natural language Trustworthy Explanations), a human-in-the-loop framework for adaptive and reliable XAI narratives. PONTE models personalization as a closed-loop validation and adaptation process rather than prompt engineering. It combines: (i) a low-dimensional preference model capturing stylistic requirements; (ii) a preference-conditioned generator grounded in structured XAI artifacts; and (iii) verification modules enforcing numerical faithfulness, informational completeness, and stylistic alignment, optionally supported by retrieval-grounded argumentation. User feedback iteratively updates the preference state, enabling quick personalization. Automatic and human evaluations across healthcare and finance domains show that the verification-refinement loop substantially improves completeness and stylistic alignment over validation-free generation. Human studies further confirm strong agreement between intended preference vectors and perceived style, robustness to generation stochasticity, and consistently positive quality assessments.

AI.tldr: PONTE是一个个性化、可验证的XAI框架，通过闭环验证和适应过程生成可靠的自然语言解释，解决了传统XAI方法忽视用户差异和LLM幻觉的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前XAI方法大多采用一刀切模式，忽视了用户在专业知识、目标和认知需求上的差异。虽然大语言模型可以将技术解释转化为自然语言，但存在忠实性和幻觉问题。
AI.method: PONTE框架包含三个核心组件：1) 低维偏好模型捕捉风格要求；2) 基于结构化XAI工件的偏好条件生成器；3) 验证模块确保数值忠实性、信息完整性和风格对齐。通过用户反馈迭代更新偏好状态，实现快速个性化。
AI.result: 在医疗和金融领域的自动和人工评估显示，验证-精炼循环显著提高了完整性和风格对齐性。人工研究进一步证实了预期偏好向量与感知风格之间的强一致性、对生成随机性的鲁棒性以及持续积极的质量评估。
AI.conclusion: PONTE通过将个性化建模为闭环验证和适应过程，而非提示工程，实现了可靠且适应性的XAI叙述生成，有效解决了传统方法的局限性。

title: Place-it-R1: Unlocking Environment-aware Reasoning Potential of MLLM for Video Object Insertion
summary: Modern video editing techniques have achieved high visual fidelity when inserting video objects. However, they focus on optimizing visual fidelity rather than physical causality, leading to edits that are physically inconsistent with their environment. In this work, we present Place-it-R$1$, an end-to-end framework for video object insertion that unlocks the environment-aware reasoning potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework leverages the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning of MLLMs to orchestrate video diffusion, following a Think-then-Place paradigm. To bridge cognitive reasoning and generative execution, we introduce three key innovations: First, MLLM performs physical scene understanding and interaction reasoning, generating environment-aware chain-of-thought tokens and inferring valid insertion regions to explicitly guide the diffusion toward physically plausible insertion. Then, we introduce MLLM-guided Spatial Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), where diffusion outputs are fed back to the MLLM for scoring, enabling visual naturalness. During inference, the MLLM iteratively triggers refinement cycles and elicits adaptive adjustments from the diffusion model, forming a closed-loop that progressively enhances editing quality. Furthermore, we provide two user-selectable modes: a plausibility-oriented flexible mode that permits environment modifications (\eg, generating support structures) to enhance physical plausibility, and a fidelity-oriented standard mode that preserves scene integrity for maximum fidelity, offering users explicit control over the plausibility-fidelity trade-off. Extensive experiments demonstrate Place-it-R1 achieves physically-coherent video object insertion compared with state-of-the-art solutions and commercial models.

AI.tldr: Place-it-R1是一个端到端的视频物体插入框架，利用多模态大语言模型进行环境感知推理，实现物理一致的视频编辑
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑技术主要关注视觉保真度而非物理因果关系，导致插入的物体与环境物理不一致。需要开发能够理解物理场景并进行合理交互的编辑方法
AI.method: 采用"思考-然后-放置"范式，利用MLLM进行物理场景理解和交互推理，生成环境感知的思维链令牌和有效插入区域。引入MLLM引导的空间直接偏好优化，形成闭环迭代优化。提供两种用户可选模式：允许环境修改的灵活模式和保持场景完整性的标准模式
AI.result: 实验表明Place-it-R1相比最先进解决方案和商业模型，能够实现物理一致的视频物体插入，在物理连贯性方面表现优异
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过结合MLLM的认知推理能力和扩散模型的生成能力，实现了物理合理的视频物体插入，为用户提供了在物理合理性和视觉保真度之间的明确权衡控制

title: Exploring Open-Vocabulary Object Recognition in Images using CLIP
summary: To address the limitations of existing open-vocabulary object recognition methods, specifically high system complexity, substantial training costs, and limited generalization, this paper proposes a novel Open-Vocabulary Object Recognition (OVOR) framework based on a streamlined two-stage strategy: object segmentation followed by recognition. The framework eliminates the need for complex retraining and labor-intensive annotation. After cropping object regions, we generate object-level image embeddings alongside category-level text embeddings using CLIP, which facilitates arbitrary vocabularies. To reduce reliance on CLIP and enhance encoding flexibility, we further introduce a CNN/MLP-based method that extracts convolutional neural network (CNN) feature maps and utilizes a multilayer perceptron (MLP) to align visual features with text embeddings. These embeddings are concatenated and processed via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to construct a shared representation space. Finally, recognition is performed through embedding similarity matching. Experiments on COCO, Pascal VOC, and ADE20K demonstrate that training-free, CLIP-based encoding without SVD achieves the highest average AP, outperforming current state-of-the-art methods. Simultaneously, the results highlight the potential of CNN/MLP-based image encoding for OVOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的开放词汇目标识别框架，采用两阶段策略：先分割后识别，无需复杂重训练和标注，通过CLIP生成嵌入并使用SVD构建共享表示空间，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇目标识别方法存在系统复杂度高、训练成本大、泛化能力有限等问题，需要一种更简洁高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 目标分割；2) 识别。使用CLIP生成目标级图像嵌入和类别级文本嵌入，引入CNN/MLP方法提取特征并对齐视觉与文本特征，通过SVD构建共享表示空间，最后通过嵌入相似度匹配进行识别。
AI.result: 在COCO、Pascal VOC和ADE20K数据集上的实验表明，无训练、基于CLIP的编码（无SVD）获得了最高的平均AP，超越了当前最先进方法。同时验证了CNN/MLP图像编码在开放词汇目标识别中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架有效解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了高效、低成本的开放词汇目标识别，为相关研究提供了新的思路和方向。

title: Beyond Rows to Reasoning: Agentic Retrieval for Multimodal Spreadsheet Understanding and Editing
summary: Recent advances in multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze enterprise spreadsheet workbooks containing millions of cells, cross-sheet dependencies, and embedded visual artifacts. However, state-of-the-art approaches exclude critical context through single-pass retrieval, lose data resolution through compression, and exceed LLM context windows through naive full-context injection, preventing reliable multi-step reasoning over complex enterprise workbooks. We introduce Beyond Rows to Reasoning (BRTR), a multimodal agentic framework for spreadsheet understanding that replaces single-pass retrieval with an iterative tool-calling loop, supporting end-to-end Excel workflows from complex analysis to structured editing. Supported by over 200 hours of expert human evaluation, BRTR achieves state-of-the-art performance across three frontier spreadsheet understanding benchmarks, surpassing prior methods by 25 percentage points on FRTR-Bench, 7 points on SpreadsheetLLM, and 32 points on FINCH. We evaluate five multimodal embedding models, identifying NVIDIA NeMo Retriever 1B as the top performer for mixed tabular and visual data, and vary nine LLMs. Ablation experiments confirm that the planner, retrieval, and iterative reasoning each contribute substantially, and cost analysis shows GPT-5.2 achieves the best efficiency-accuracy trade-off. Throughout all evaluations, BRTR maintains full auditability through explicit tool-call traces.

AI.tldr: BRTR是一个多模态智能体框架，用于电子表格理解，通过迭代工具调用循环替代单次检索，在三个前沿基准测试中实现最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态RAG方法在处理包含数百万单元格、跨表依赖和嵌入视觉元素的复杂企业电子表格时存在三个主要问题：单次检索排除关键上下文、压缩导致数据分辨率损失、以及完整上下文注入超出LLM上下文窗口，阻碍了对复杂企业工作簿的可靠多步推理。
AI.method: BRTR采用多模态智能体框架，用迭代工具调用循环替代单次检索，支持从复杂分析到结构化编辑的端到端Excel工作流程。框架包含规划器、检索器和迭代推理组件，评估了5种多模态嵌入模型和9种LLM。
AI.result: BRTR在三个前沿电子表格理解基准测试中实现最先进性能：FRTR-Bench提升25个百分点，SpreadsheetLLM提升7个百分点，FINCH提升32个百分点。NVIDIA NeMo Retriever 1B在混合表格和视觉数据检索中表现最佳，GPT-5.2在效率-准确性权衡方面最优。消融实验证实规划器、检索器和迭代推理都有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: BRTR框架通过迭代工具调用循环解决了现有方法的局限性，在复杂企业电子表格理解方面实现了显著性能提升，同时通过显式工具调用痕迹保持完全可审计性，为电子表格分析提供了可靠的端到端解决方案。

title: VLM-RobustBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robustness of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on standard, high-quality datasets, but we still do not fully understand how they perform under real-world image distortions. We present VLM-RobustBench, a benchmark spanning 49 augmentation types across noise, blur, weather, digital, and geometric perturbations, evaluated under graded severities (low/mid/high) and binary transforms, yielding 133 corrupted settings. We evaluate VLMs from four families (Qwen, InternVL, Molmo, Gemma) on two complementary benchmarks: MMBench (visually grounded) and MMMU-Pro (reasoning-oriented). Our results reveal that visual severity is a weak predictor of difficulty: low-severity spatial perturbations often degrade performance more than visually severe photometric corruptions. In particular, low-severity glass_blur reduces MMBench accuracy by about 8 pp on average across models, while the largest drops arise from resampling and geometric distortions (e.g., upsample, elastic_transform), reaching up to 34 pp. Overall, our findings suggest current VLMs are semantically strong but spatially fragile, motivating the definition of novel robustness evaluation protocols and training regimes that emphasize resampling and geometric invariances.

AI.tldr: VLM-RobustBench评估视觉语言模型在49种图像失真下的鲁棒性，发现当前VLM在语义理解上强但在空间变换上脆弱，低严重度的几何失真比高严重度的光度失真影响更大。
AI.motivation: 虽然视觉语言模型在高质量数据集上表现良好，但对其在真实世界图像失真下的性能理解不足，需要系统评估模型对各种图像扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建VLM-RobustBench基准，涵盖49种增强类型（噪声、模糊、天气、数字、几何扰动），在分级严重度（低/中/高）和二元变换下评估，共133种损坏设置。评估四个VLM家族（Qwen、InternVL、Molmo、Gemma）在两个基准上：MMBench（视觉基础）和MMMU-Pro（推理导向）。
AI.result: 视觉严重度是性能下降的弱预测因子：低严重度的空间扰动通常比视觉上严重的光度损坏更降低性能。低严重度的glass_blur平均降低MMBench准确率约8个百分点，最大下降来自重采样和几何失真（如上采样、弹性变换），可达34个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在语义上强但在空间上脆弱，需要定义新的鲁棒性评估协议和训练机制，强调重采样和几何不变性。

title: Reflective Flow Sampling Enhancement
summary: The growing demand for text-to-image generation has led to rapid advances in generative modeling. Recently, text-to-image diffusion models trained with flow matching algorithms, such as FLUX, have achieved remarkable progress and emerged as strong alternatives to conventional diffusion models. At the same time, inference-time enhancement strategies have been shown to improve the generation quality and text-prompt alignment of text-to-image diffusion models. However, these techniques are mainly applicable to conventional diffusion models and usually fail to perform well on flow models. To bridge this gap, we propose Reflective Flow Sampling (RF-Sampling), a theoretically-grounded and training-free inference enhancement framework explicitly designed for flow models, especially for the CFG-distilled variants (i.e., models distilled from CFG guidance techniques), like FLUX. Departing from heuristic interpretations, we provide a formal derivation proving that RF-Sampling implicitly performs gradient ascent on the text-image alignment score. By leveraging a linear combination of textual representations and integrating them with flow inversion, RF-Sampling allows the model to explore noise spaces that are more consistent with the input prompt. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RF-Sampling consistently improves both generation quality and prompt alignment. Moreover, RF-Sampling is also the first inference enhancement method that can exhibit test-time scaling ability to some extent on FLUX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RF-Sampling，一种专门为流匹配模型设计的无需训练推理增强框架，通过理论推导证明其隐式执行文本-图像对齐分数的梯度上升，显著提升生成质量和提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前推理时增强策略主要适用于传统扩散模型，在流模型上表现不佳。特别是对于CFG蒸馏变体（如FLUX），需要专门设计的增强方法。
AI.method: 提出反射流采样（RF-Sampling），基于理论推导的无需训练推理增强框架，利用文本表示的线性组合并结合流反转，使模型探索与输入提示更一致的噪声空间。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，RF-Sampling一致提升生成质量和提示对齐，是首个在FLUX上展现一定测试时缩放能力的推理增强方法。
AI.conclusion: RF-Sampling为流模型提供了有效的推理增强方案，填补了传统增强方法在流模型上的空白，具有理论依据和实际效果。

title: KCLarity at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Encoder and Zero-Shot Approaches to Political Evasion Detection
summary: This paper describes the KCLarity team's participation in CLARITY, a shared task at SemEval 2026 on classifying ambiguity and evasion techniques in political discourse. We investigate two modelling formulations: (i) directly predicting the clarity label, and (ii) predicting the evasion label and deriving clarity through the task taxonomy hierarchy. We further explore several auxiliary training variants and evaluate decoder-only models in a zero-shot setting under the evasion-first formulation. Overall, the two formulations yield comparable performance. Among encoder-based models, RoBERTa-large achieves the strongest results on the public test set, while zero-shot GPT-5.2 generalises better on the hidden evaluation set.

AI.tldr: KCLarity团队参与SemEval 2026的CLARITY任务，研究政治话语中歧义和回避技术的分类，比较两种建模方法：直接预测清晰度标签 vs 先预测回避标签再推导清晰度，并探索辅助训练变体和零射解码器模型。
AI.motivation: 参与SemEval 2026的CLARITY共享任务，旨在开发能够识别政治话语中歧义和回避技术的模型，这对于理解政治沟通中的策略性语言使用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究两种建模方法：1) 直接预测清晰度标签；2) 先预测回避标签，然后通过任务分类层次结构推导清晰度。同时探索多种辅助训练变体，并在回避优先的框架下评估零射解码器模型。
AI.result: 两种建模方法表现相当。在编码器模型中，RoBERTa-large在公开测试集上表现最佳；而零射GPT-5.2在隐藏评估集上泛化能力更好。
AI.conclusion: 两种建模方法效果相似，但不同模型在不同数据集上表现各异：编码器模型在公开测试集上表现更好，而大型语言模型在隐藏评估集上泛化能力更强。

title: Contrastive-to-Self-Supervised: A Two-Stage Framework for Script Similarity Learning
summary: Learning similarity metrics for glyphs and writing systems faces a fundamental challenge: while individual graphemes within invented alphabets can be reliably labeled, the historical relationships between different scripts remain uncertain and contested. We propose a two-stage framework that addresses this epistemological constraint. First, we train an encoder with contrastive loss on labeled invented alphabets, establishing a teacher model with robust discriminative features. Second, we extend to historically attested scripts through teacher-student distillation, where the student learns unsupervised representations guided by the teacher's knowledge but free to discover latent cross-script similarities. The asymmetric setup enables the student to learn deformation-invariant embeddings while inheriting discriminative structure from clean examples. Our approach bridges supervised contrastive learning and unsupervised discovery, enabling both hard boundaries between distinct systems and soft similarities reflecting potential historical influences. Experiments on diverse writing systems demonstrate effective few-shot glyph recognition and meaningful script clustering without requiring ground-truth evolutionary relationships.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架解决字形和书写系统相似性度量学习问题：第一阶段在有标签人造字母表上训练对比学习编码器作为教师模型；第二阶段通过师生蒸馏扩展到历史书写系统，学生模型在教师指导下学习无监督表示
AI.motivation: 字形和书写系统相似性度量学习面临根本挑战：人造字母表中的单个字素可以可靠标注，但不同书写系统之间的历史关系不确定且存在争议。需要一种方法既能学习清晰边界，又能发现潜在的历史相似性
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）在有标签的人造字母表上使用对比损失训练编码器，建立具有鲁棒判别特征的教师模型；2）通过师生蒸馏扩展到历史书写系统，学生模型在教师知识指导下学习无监督表示，但可以自由发现跨书写系统的潜在相似性
AI.result: 在多样化书写系统上的实验表明，该方法实现了有效的少样本字形识别和有意义的书写系统聚类，无需真实进化关系作为监督信号
AI.conclusion: 该方法桥接了监督对比学习和无监督发现，既能学习不同系统间的硬边界，又能反映潜在历史影响的软相似性，解决了书写系统相似性度量学习中的认识论约束问题

title: Breaking Smooth-Motion Assumptions: A UAV Benchmark for Multi-Object Tracking in Complex and Adverse Conditions
summary: The rapid movements and agile maneuvers of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) induce significant observational challenges for multi-object tracking (MOT). However, existing UAV-perspective MOT benchmarks often lack these complexities, featuring predominantly predictable camera dynamics and linear motion patterns. To address this gap, we introduce DynUAV, a new benchmark for dynamic UAV-perspective MOT, characterized by intense ego-motion and the resulting complex apparent trajectories. The benchmark comprises 42 video sequences with over 1.7 million bounding box annotations, covering vehicles, pedestrians, and specialized industrial categories such as excavators, bulldozers and cranes. Compared to existing benchmarks, DynUAV introduces substantial challenges arising from ego-motion, including drastic scale changes and viewpoint changes, as well as motion blur. Comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art trackers on DynUAV reveal their limitations, particularly in managing the intertwined challenges of detection and association under such dynamic conditions, thereby establishing DynUAV as a rigorous benchmark. We anticipate that DynUAV will serve as a demanding testbed to spur progress in real-world UAV-perspective MOT, and we will make all resources available at link.

AI.tldr: DynUAV是一个新的动态无人机视角多目标跟踪基准，包含42个视频序列和170万+标注框，特点是剧烈的相机运动和复杂的表观轨迹，挑战现有跟踪器的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机视角多目标跟踪基准缺乏真实场景中的复杂性，如剧烈的相机运动和复杂的运动模式，无法充分评估跟踪器在动态条件下的性能。
AI.method: 创建DynUAV基准，包含42个视频序列，超过170万个边界框标注，涵盖车辆、行人以及挖掘机、推土机、起重机等工业类别，特点是强烈的自我运动和由此产生的复杂表观轨迹。
AI.result: 对最先进跟踪器的综合评估显示它们在DynUAV上存在局限性，特别是在处理由自我运动引起的尺度变化、视角变化和运动模糊等交织挑战时表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: DynUAV作为一个严格的基准，能够推动真实世界无人机视角多目标跟踪的进展，将成为该领域发展的关键测试平台。

title: DeepSight: Bridging Depth Maps and Language with a Depth-Driven Multimodal Model
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across various tasks such as image captioning and visual question answer(VQA); however, they often struggle to accurately interpret depth information inherent in visual data. In this work, we introduce DeepSight, the first dedicated depth MLLM designed to enhance three-dimensional scene understanding. Unlike conventional methods that align RGB image encodings with text, our approach takes advantage of the unique characteristics of depth images: single-channel grayscale images where the pixel values directly reflect depth cues to improve spatial reasoning. To address challenges associated with limited depth data and the inadequacy of simple channel replication, we construct a novel depth image-text pair dataset and a depth instruction dataset. Depth maps are generated from visual images using the GLPN model, and GPT-4 is employed to curate corresponding depth instructions, an approach validated by LLaVA. Additionally, we modify the ViT encoder in CLIP to incorporate local object information, thereby capturing the subtle continuous variations of depth more effectively. To evaluate the performance of our model, we develop a comprehensive depth question answer benchmark based on existing depth image datasets, which rigorously assesses understanding in typical depth map scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that DeepSight significantly enhances depth perception and downstream task performance, marking a substantial step forward in multimodal three-dimensional understanding.

AI.tldr: DeepSight是首个专门用于深度感知的多模态大语言模型，通过构建深度图像-文本对数据集和改进视觉编码器，显著提升了三维场景理解能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在图像描述和视觉问答等任务上表现优异，但往往难以准确理解视觉数据中的深度信息，限制了三维场景理解能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建新颖的深度图像-文本对数据集和深度指令数据集；2. 使用GLPN模型从视觉图像生成深度图；3. 利用GPT-4生成对应的深度指令；4. 改进CLIP中的ViT编码器以融入局部物体信息，更好地捕捉深度连续变化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DeepSight显著提升了深度感知能力和下游任务性能，在基于现有深度图像数据集构建的深度问答基准测试中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: DeepSight在多模态三维理解方面迈出了重要一步，通过专门处理深度信息的独特方法，有效解决了传统MLLM在深度感知方面的局限性。

title: Towards High-resolution and Disentangled Reference-based Sketch Colorization
summary: Sketch colorization is a critical task for automating and assisting in the creation of animations and digital illustrations. Previous research identified the primary difficulty as the distribution shift between semantically aligned training data and highly diverse test data, and focused on mitigating the artifacts caused by the distribution shift instead of fundamentally resolving the problem. In this paper, we present a framework that directly minimizes the distribution shift, thereby achieving superior quality, resolution, and controllability of colorization. We propose a dual-branch framework to explicitly model the data distributions of the training process and inference process with a semantic-aligned branch and a semantic-misaligned branch, respectively. A Gram Regularization Loss is applied across the feature maps of both branches, effectively enforcing cross-domain distribution coherence and stability. Furthermore, we adopt an anime-specific Tagger Network to extract fine-grained attributions from reference images and modulate SDXL's conditional encoders to ensure precise control, and a plugin module to enhance texture transfer. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons, alongside user studies, confirm that our method effectively overcomes the distribution shift challenge, establishing State-of-the-Art performance across both quality and controllability metrics. Ablation study reveals the influence of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解决素描上色中分布偏移问题的双分支框架，通过语义对齐和语义不对齐分支分别建模训练和推理过程的数据分布，结合Gram正则化损失实现跨域分布一致性，并采用动漫专用标签网络和插件模块提升控制精度和纹理转移效果。
AI.motivation: 素描上色是动画和数字插图创作自动化和辅助的关键任务。先前研究主要关注缓解分布偏移引起的伪影，而非从根本上解决训练数据语义对齐与测试数据高度多样化的分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出双分支框架：语义对齐分支建模训练过程数据分布，语义不对齐分支建模推理过程数据分布；采用Gram正则化损失强制跨域分布一致性和稳定性；使用动漫专用标签网络从参考图像提取细粒度属性并调制SDXL条件编码器；引入插件模块增强纹理转移。
AI.result: 定量和定性比较以及用户研究表明，该方法有效克服了分布偏移挑战，在质量和可控性指标上均达到最先进水平。消融研究揭示了各组件的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过直接最小化分布偏移，实现了素描上色在质量、分辨率和可控性方面的显著提升，为动画和数字插图创作提供了有效的自动化解决方案。

title: Cut to the Chase: Training-free Multimodal Summarization via Chain-of-Events
summary: Multimodal Summarization (MMS) aims to generate concise textual summaries by understanding and integrating information across videos, transcripts, and images. However, existing approaches still suffer from three main challenges: (1) reliance on domain-specific supervision, (2) implicit fusion with weak cross-modal grounding, and (3) flat temporal modeling without event transitions. To address these issues, we introduce **CoE**, a training-free MMS framework that performs structured reasoning through a **Chain-of-Events** guided by a Hierarchical Event Graph (HEG). The HEG encodes textual semantics into an explicit event hierarchy that scaffolds cross-modal grounding and temporal reasoning. Guided by this structure, **CoE** localizes key visual cues, models event evolution and causal transitions, and refines outputs via lightweight style adaptation for domain alignment. Extensive experiments on eight diverse datasets demonstrate that **CoE** consistently outperforms state-of-the-art video CoT baselines, achieving average gains of **+3.04 ROUGE**, **+9.51 CIDEr**, and **+1.88 BERTScore**, highlighting its robustness, interpretability, and cross-domain generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/youxiaoxing/CoE.

AI.tldr: CoE是一个无需训练的多模态摘要框架，通过事件链和分层事件图进行结构化推理，解决了现有方法在跨模态对齐、事件建模和领域泛化方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态摘要方法存在三个主要问题：依赖领域特定监督、隐式融合导致跨模态对齐弱、平坦的时间建模缺乏事件转换。需要一种更结构化、可解释且无需训练的方法来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出CoE框架，使用分层事件图（HEG）将文本语义编码为显式的事件层次结构，通过事件链指导跨模态对齐和时间推理，定位关键视觉线索，建模事件演化和因果转换，并通过轻量级风格适应进行领域对齐。
AI.result: 在八个多样化数据集上的实验表明，CoE始终优于最先进的视频CoT基线，平均提升+3.04 ROUGE、+9.51 CIDEr和+1.88 BERTScore，显示出强大的鲁棒性、可解释性和跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CoE通过结构化的事件链推理，有效解决了多模态摘要中的关键挑战，提供了一种无需训练、可解释且泛化能力强的解决方案，在多个评估指标上显著超越了现有方法。

title: GazeMoE: Perception of Gaze Target with Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Estimating human gaze target from visible images is a critical task for robots to understand human attention, yet the development of generalizable neural architectures and training paradigms remains challenging. While recent advances in pre-trained vision foundation models offer promising avenues for locating gaze targets, the integration of multi-modal cues -- including eyes, head poses, gestures, and contextual features -- demands adaptive and efficient decoding mechanisms. Inspired by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for adaptive domain expertise in large vision-language models, we propose GazeMoE, a novel end-to-end framework that selectively leverages gaze-target-related cues from a frozen foundation model through MoE modules. To address class imbalance in gaze target classification (in-frame vs. out-of-frame) and enhance robustness, GazeMoE incorporates a class-balancing auxiliary loss alongside strategic data augmentations, including region-specific cropping and photometric transformations. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our GazeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing methods on challenging gaze estimation tasks. The code and pre-trained models are released at https://huggingface.co/zdai257/GazeMoE

AI.tldr: GazeMoE：基于混合专家框架的端到端视线目标估计方法，通过选择性利用冻结基础模型中的多模态线索，结合类别平衡损失和数据增强，在视线估计任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 从可见图像中估计人类视线目标对机器人理解人类注意力至关重要，但现有方法在通用神经网络架构和训练范式方面仍有挑战。虽然预训练视觉基础模型为定位视线目标提供了有前景的途径，但整合眼睛、头部姿态、手势和上下文等多模态线索需要自适应且高效的解码机制。
AI.method: 提出GazeMoE框架，受大型视觉语言模型中混合专家（MoE）自适应领域专业知识的启发，通过MoE模块选择性利用冻结基础模型中的视线目标相关线索。为解决视线目标分类（框内vs框外）中的类别不平衡问题并增强鲁棒性，引入类别平衡辅助损失和策略性数据增强（包括区域特定裁剪和光度变换）。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GazeMoE在具有挑战性的视线估计任务上实现了最先进的性能，超越了现有方法。
AI.conclusion: GazeMoE通过混合专家框架有效整合多模态线索，结合类别平衡和数据增强策略，显著提升了视线目标估计的准确性和鲁棒性，为机器人理解人类注意力提供了有效的解决方案。

title: HiPP-Prune: Hierarchical Preference-Conditioned Structured Pruning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Pruning vision-language models (VLMs) for efficient deployment is challenging because compression can affect not only task utility but also visual grounding, often amplifying object hallucinations even at the same sparsity level. We present HiPP-Prune, a hierarchical preference-conditioned structured pruning framework that treats pruning as conditional resource allocation under multiple objectives. HiPP-Prune makes plan-level decisions: a single policy invocation outputs a global pruning blueprint by factorizing decisions into an overall sparsity budget and a layer-wise allocation, enabling queryable trade-offs via a user-specified preference vector. To account for VLM-specific failure modes, our policy state integrates a visual sensitivity signal derived from attention flow between vision tokens and language hidden states, discouraging over-pruning of vision-critical layers that facilitate cross-modal fusion. We optimize pruning plans with plan-level Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) under a multi-objective return that combines task utility, hallucination robustness (POPE), compression, and a synaptic-flow-inspired stability proxy to reduce unproductive exploration in high-sparsity regimes. Experiments on LLaVA with POPE and ScienceQA demonstrate that HiPP-Prune discovers diverse non-dominated pruning plans and provides controllable robustness--utility trade-offs under matched sparsity budgets.

AI.tldr: HiPP-Prune：一种分层偏好条件结构化剪枝框架，用于视觉语言模型，通过多目标优化实现可控的鲁棒性-效用权衡
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型剪枝面临挑战，压缩不仅影响任务效用，还会加剧对象幻觉问题。现有方法在同一稀疏度下仍可能放大幻觉，需要一种能平衡多个目标（任务性能、幻觉鲁棒性、压缩率）的剪枝框架。
AI.method: 提出分层偏好条件结构化剪枝框架，将剪枝视为多目标下的条件资源分配。框架包含：1）单次策略调用输出全局剪枝蓝图；2）决策分解为总体稀疏度预算和分层分配；3）通过用户指定偏好向量实现可查询权衡；4）策略状态集成视觉敏感性信号（基于视觉token与语言隐藏状态间的注意力流）；5）使用计划级组相对策略优化在多目标回报下优化剪枝计划。
AI.result: 在LLaVA模型上的POPE和ScienceQA实验表明，HiPP-Prune能发现多样化的非支配剪枝计划，在匹配的稀疏度预算下提供可控的鲁棒性-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: HiPP-Prune框架成功解决了视觉语言模型剪枝中的多目标平衡问题，通过分层偏好条件方法实现了对剪枝过程的精细控制，特别在减少对象幻觉方面表现出色。

title: EffectMaker: Unifying Reasoning and Generation for Customized Visual Effect Creation
summary: Visual effects (VFX) are essential for enhancing the expressiveness and creativity of video content, yet producing high-quality effects typically requires expert knowledge and costly production pipelines. Existing AIGC systems face significant challenges in VFX generation due to the scarcity of effect-specific data and the inherent difficulty of modeling supernatural or stylized effects. Moreover, these approaches often require per-effect fine-tuning, which severely limits their scalability and generalization to novel VFX. In this work, we present EffectMaker, a unified reasoning-generation framework that enables reference-based VFX customization. EffectMaker employs a multimodal large language model to interpret high-level effect semantics and reason about how they should adapt to a target subject, while a diffusion transformer leverages in-context learning to capture fine-grained visual cues from reference videos. These two components form a semantic-visual dual-path guidance mechanism that enables accurate, controllable, and effect-consistent synthesis without per-effect fine-tuning. Furthermore, we construct EffectData, the largest high-quality synthetic dataset containing 130k videos across 3k VFX categories, to improve generalization and scalability. Experiments show that EffectMaker achieves superior visual quality and effect consistency over state-of-the-art baselines, offering a scalable and flexible paradigm for customized VFX generation. Project page: https://effectmaker.github.io

AI.tldr: EffectMaker是一个统一的推理-生成框架，通过多模态大语言模型和扩散变换器的双路径引导机制，实现基于参考视频的视觉特效定制，无需针对每个特效进行微调。
AI.motivation: 当前AIGC系统在视觉特效生成方面面临重大挑战：特效特定数据稀缺、超自然或风格化效果建模困难，且现有方法通常需要针对每个特效进行微调，严重限制了其可扩展性和对新特效的泛化能力。
AI.method: EffectMaker采用统一推理-生成框架：1）使用多模态大语言模型解释高级特效语义并推理如何适应目标主体；2）使用扩散变换器通过上下文学习从参考视频中捕捉细粒度视觉线索；3）构建语义-视觉双路径引导机制；4）创建EffectData数据集（包含130k视频，覆盖3k特效类别）。
AI.result: 实验表明，EffectMaker在视觉质量和特效一致性方面优于现有最先进的基线方法，提供了一个可扩展且灵活的自定义视觉特效生成范式。
AI.conclusion: EffectMaker通过语义-视觉双路径引导机制，实现了准确、可控且特效一致性的合成，无需针对每个特效进行微调，为定制化视觉特效生成提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: DEX-AR: A Dynamic Explainability Method for Autoregressive Vision-Language Models
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become increasingly sophisticated and widely used, it becomes more and more crucial to understand their decision-making process. Traditional explainability methods, designed for classification tasks, struggle with modern autoregressive VLMs due to their complex token-by-token generation process and intricate interactions between visual and textual modalities. We present DEX-AR (Dynamic Explainability for AutoRegressive models), a novel explainability method designed to address these challenges by generating both per-token and sequence-level 2D heatmaps highlighting image regions crucial for the model's textual responses. The proposed method offers to interpret autoregressive VLMs-including varying importance of layers and generated tokens-by computing layer-wise gradients with respect to attention maps during the token-by-token generation process. DEX-AR introduces two key innovations: a dynamic head filtering mechanism that identifies attention heads focused on visual information, and a sequence-level filtering approach that aggregates per-token explanations while distinguishing between visually-grounded and purely linguistic tokens. Our evaluation on ImageNet, VQAv2, and PascalVOC, shows a consistent improvement in both perturbation-based metrics, using a novel normalized perplexity measure, as well as segmentation-based metrics.

AI.tldr: DEX-AR是一种专门为自回归视觉语言模型设计的可解释性方法，通过生成逐token和序列级别的热力图来可视化模型决策过程。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型变得越来越复杂和广泛应用，理解其决策过程变得至关重要。传统的可解释性方法主要针对分类任务设计，难以处理现代自回归VLMs的逐token生成过程以及视觉和文本模态之间的复杂交互。
AI.method: DEX-AR通过计算逐token生成过程中注意力图的层梯度来生成2D热力图，包含两个关键创新：1）动态头过滤机制识别关注视觉信息的注意力头；2）序列级过滤方法聚合逐token解释，区分视觉基础token和纯语言token。
AI.result: 在ImageNet、VQAv2和PascalVOC数据集上的评估显示，DEX-AR在基于扰动和基于分割的指标上都取得了持续改进，使用了新的归一化困惑度度量。
AI.conclusion: DEX-AR为自回归视觉语言模型提供了一种有效的可解释性方法，能够更好地理解和解释这些复杂模型的决策过程。

title: MOSIV: Multi-Object System Identification from Videos
summary: We introduce the challenging problem of multi-object system identification from videos, for which prior methods are ill-suited due to their focus on single-object scenes or discrete material classification with a fixed set of material prototypes. To address this, we propose MOSIV, a new framework that directly optimizes for continuous, per-object material parameters using a differentiable simulator guided by geometric objectives derived from video. We also present a new synthetic benchmark with contact-rich, multi-object interactions to facilitate evaluation. On this benchmark, MOSIV substantially improves grounding accuracy and long-horizon simulation fidelity over adapted baselines, establishing it as a strong baseline for this new task. Our analysis shows that object-level fine-grained supervision and geometry-aligned objectives are critical for stable optimization in these complex, multi-object settings. The source code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: MOSIV框架通过可微分模拟器直接从视频中优化连续、逐物体的材料参数，解决了多物体系统识别问题，显著提升了定位精度和长期模拟保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注单物体场景或使用固定材料原型的离散材料分类，无法有效处理多物体系统识别问题，需要新的框架来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出MOSIV框架，使用可微分模拟器直接优化连续、逐物体的材料参数，通过从视频中提取的几何目标进行指导，并创建了包含接触丰富的多物体交互的合成基准数据集。
AI.result: 在新建的基准测试中，MOSIV相比适应后的基线方法显著提高了定位精度和长期模拟保真度，成为该新任务的强基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 物体级别的细粒度监督和几何对齐的目标对于复杂多物体设置中的稳定优化至关重要，MOSIV为多物体系统识别任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: StruVis: Enhancing Reasoning-based Text-to-Image Generation via Thinking with Structured Vision
summary: Reasoning-based text-to-image (T2I) generation requires models to interpret complex prompts accurately. Existing reasoning frameworks can be broadly categorized into two types: (1) Text-Only Reasoning, which is computationally efficient but lacks access to visual context, often resulting in the omission of critical spatial and visual elements; and (2) Text-Image Interleaved Reasoning, which leverages a T2I generator to provide visual references during the reasoning process. While this approach enhances visual grounding, it incurs substantial computational costs and constrains the reasoning capacity of MLLMs to the representational limitations of the generator. To this end, we propose StruVis, a novel framework that enhances T2I generation through Thinking with Structured Vision. Instead of relying on intermediate image generation, StruVis employs text-based structured visual representations as intermediate reasoning states, thereby enabling the MLLM to effectively "perceive" visual structure within a purely text-based reasoning process. Powered by this, the reasoning potential for T2I generation of the MLLM is unlocked through structured-vision-guided reasoning. Additionally, as a generator-agnostic reasoning framework, our proposed StruVis can be seamlessly integrated with diverse T2I generators and efficiently enhance their performance in reasoning-based T2I generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StruVis achieves significant performance improvements on reasoning-based T2I benchmarks, e.g., a 4.61% gain on T2I-ReasonBench and a 4% gain on WISE.

AI.tldr: StruVis框架通过结构化视觉表示增强文本到图像生成，避免中间图像生成的计算成本，同时提升视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成的推理框架存在两个主要问题：纯文本推理缺乏视觉上下文，容易遗漏关键空间和视觉元素；文本-图像交错推理虽然增强视觉基础，但计算成本高且受限于生成器的表示能力。
AI.method: 提出StruVis框架，使用基于文本的结构化视觉表示作为中间推理状态，让多模态大语言模型在纯文本推理过程中有效"感知"视觉结构，实现结构化视觉引导的推理。
AI.result: 在推理型文本到图像基准测试中取得显著性能提升：T2I-ReasonBench上提升4.61%，WISE上提升4%。
AI.conclusion: StruVis作为一种生成器无关的推理框架，可以无缝集成到不同的文本到图像生成器中，高效提升其在基于推理的文本到图像生成任务中的性能。

title: Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Transformer
summary: Diffusion Transformers process images as fixed-length sequences of tokens produced by a static $\textit{patchify}$ operation. While effective, this design spends uniform compute on low- and high-information regions alike, ignoring that images contain regions of varying detail and that the denoising process progresses from coarse structure at early timesteps to fine detail at late timesteps. We introduce the Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Transformer (DC-DiT), which augments the DiT backbone with a learned encoder-router-decoder scaffold that adaptively compresses the 2D input into a shorter token sequence in a data-dependent manner using a chunking mechanism learned end-to-end with diffusion training. The mechanism learns to compress uniform background regions into fewer tokens and detail-rich regions into more tokens, with meaningful visual segmentations emerging without explicit supervision. Furthermore, it also learns to adapt its compression across diffusion timesteps, using fewer tokens at noisy stages and more tokens as fine details emerge. On class-conditional ImageNet $256{\times}256$, DC-DiT consistently improves FID and Inception Score over both parameter-matched and FLOP-matched DiT baselines across $4{\times}$ and $16{\times}$ compression, showing this is a promising technique with potential further applications to pixel-space, video and 3D generation. Beyond accuracy, DC-DiT is practical: it can be upcycled from pretrained DiT checkpoints with minimal post-training compute (up to $8{\times}$ fewer training steps) and composes with other dynamic computation methods to further reduce generation FLOPs.

AI.tldr: DC-DiT是一种动态分块扩散变换器，通过自适应压缩图像为可变长度token序列，根据图像区域信息密度和扩散时间步动态调整计算资源分配。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散变换器将图像处理为固定长度的token序列，对所有区域使用统一计算资源，忽略了图像中不同区域的信息密度差异以及去噪过程中从粗到细的细节演变过程。
AI.method: 在DiT骨干网络基础上增加学习型编码器-路由器-解码器支架，通过端到端学习的动态分块机制，根据数据内容自适应地将2D输入压缩为更短的token序列。该机制学习将均匀背景区域压缩为较少token，细节丰富区域分配更多token，并在不同扩散时间步自适应调整压缩程度。
AI.result: 在类别条件ImageNet 256×256上，DC-DiT在4×和16×压缩下，相比参数匹配和FLOP匹配的DiT基线，FID和Inception Score均有持续改进。该方法实用性强，可从预训练DiT检查点上进行微调，训练步骤减少达8倍，并能与其他动态计算方法结合进一步减少生成FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: DC-DiT展示了自适应token压缩在扩散模型中的有效性，是一种有前景的技术，具有应用于像素空间、视频和3D生成的潜力，能够根据内容重要性动态分配计算资源。

title: Occlusion-Aware SORT: Observing Occlusion for Robust Multi-Object Tracking
comment: The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026 (CVPR2026)
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) involves analyzing object trajectories and counting the number of objects in video sequences. However, 2D MOT faces challenges due to positional cost confusion arising from partial occlusion. To address this issue, we present the novel Occlusion-Aware SORT (OA-SORT) framework, a plug-and-play and training-free framework that includes the Occlusion-Aware Module (OAM), the Occlusion-Aware Offset (OAO), and the Bias-Aware Momentum (BAM). Specifically, OAM analyzes the occlusion status of objects, where a Gaussian Map (GM) is introduced to reduce background influence. In contrast, OAO and BAM leverage the OAM-described occlusion status to mitigate cost confusion and suppress estimation instability. Comprehensive evaluations on the DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and MOT17 datasets demonstrate the importance of occlusion handling in MOT. On the DanceTrack test set, OA-SORT achieves 63.1% and 64.2% in HOTA and IDF1, respectively. Furthermore, integrating the Occlusion-Aware framework into the four additional trackers improves HOTA and IDF1 by an average of 2.08% and 3.05%, demonstrating the reusability of the occlusion awareness.

AI.tldr: OA-SORT是一个无需训练的即插即用多目标跟踪框架，通过遮挡感知模块、偏移和动量机制解决2D MOT中的遮挡问题，在多个数据集上显著提升跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 2D多目标跟踪面临部分遮挡导致的定位成本混淆问题，现有方法在遮挡场景下性能受限，需要专门针对遮挡问题的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出OA-SORT框架，包含三个核心组件：遮挡感知模块（OAM）使用高斯图分析遮挡状态并减少背景影响；遮挡感知偏移（OAO）和偏置感知动量（BAM）利用OAM描述的遮挡状态来缓解成本混淆并抑制估计不稳定性。
AI.result: 在DanceTrack、SportsMOT和MOT17数据集上的综合评估证明了遮挡处理的重要性。在DanceTrack测试集上，OA-SORT达到63.1% HOTA和64.2% IDF1。将遮挡感知框架集成到其他四个跟踪器中，平均提升HOTA 2.08%和IDF1 3.05%。
AI.conclusion: OA-SORT框架有效解决了2D MOT中的遮挡问题，展示了遮挡感知机制的可重用性和泛化能力，为多目标跟踪中的遮挡处理提供了有效的即插即用解决方案。

title: Ensemble Learning with Sparse Hypercolumns
comment: presented at 33rd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Science (AICS 2025)
summary: Directly inspired by findings in biological vision, high-dimensional hypercolumns are feature vectors built by concatenating multi-scale activations of convolutional neural networks for a single image pixel location. Together with powerful classifiers, they can be used for image segmentation i.e. pixel classification. However, in practice, there are only very few works dedicated to the use of hypercolumns. One reason is the computational complexity of processing concatenated dense hypercolumns that grows linearly with the size $N$ of the training set.
