In this work, we address this challenge by applying stratified subsampling to the VGG16 based hypercolumns. Furthermore, we investigate the performance of ensemble learning on sparse hypercolumns. Our experiments on a brain tumor dataset show that stacking and voting ensembles deliver competitive performance, but in the extreme low-shot case of $N \leq 20$, a simple Logistic Regression classifier is the most effective method. For 10% stratified subsampling rate, our best average Dice score is 0.66 for $N=20$. This is a statistically significant improvement of 24.53% over the standard multi-scale UNet baseline ($p$-value = $[3.07e-11]$, Wilcoxon signed-rank test), which is less effective due to overfitting.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分层抽样和集成学习方法优化高维超列特征，在脑肿瘤分割任务中显著提升了小样本情况下的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 受生物视觉启发的高维超列特征在图像分割中潜力巨大，但实际应用较少，主要原因是计算复杂度随训练集规模线性增长，限制了其在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: 采用分层抽样方法对VGG16生成的超列特征进行降维，并研究集成学习（堆叠和投票集成）在稀疏超列上的性能表现，特别关注小样本情况下的分类器选择。
AI.result: 在脑肿瘤数据集上，集成学习方法表现良好，但在极端小样本情况下（N≤20），简单的逻辑回归分类器最有效。在10%分层抽样率下，N=20时的最佳平均Dice分数为0.66，相比标准多尺度UNet基线有24.53%的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层抽样和适当的分类器选择，可以有效解决超列特征的计算复杂度问题，在小样本医学图像分割任务中实现显著性能提升，特别是在极端小样本情况下，简单分类器比复杂模型更有效。

title: Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in diffusion-based video generation have achieved remarkable visual realism but still struggle to obey basic physical laws such as gravity, inertia, and collision. Generated objects often move inconsistently across frames, exhibit implausible dynamics, or violate physical constraints, limiting the realism and reliability of AI-generated videos. We address this gap by introducing Physical Simulator In-the-loop Video Generation (PSIVG), a novel framework that integrates a physical simulator into the video diffusion process. Starting from a template video generated by a pre-trained diffusion model, PSIVG reconstructs the 4D scene and foreground object meshes, initializes them within a physical simulator, and generates physically consistent trajectories. These simulated trajectories are then used to guide the video generator toward spatio-temporally physically coherent motion. To further improve texture consistency during object movement, we propose a Test-Time Texture Consistency Optimization (TTCO) technique that adapts text and feature embeddings based on pixel correspondences from the simulator. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PSIVG produces videos that better adhere to real-world physics while preserving visual quality and diversity. Project Page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/PSIVG/

AI.tldr: PSIVG框架通过在视频扩散过程中集成物理模拟器，解决AI生成视频中物体运动违反物理规律的问题，生成更符合现实物理的连贯视频。
AI.motivation: 当前基于扩散的视频生成方法虽然视觉质量显著，但经常违反重力、惯性和碰撞等基本物理定律，导致物体运动不一致、动力学不合理，限制了AI生成视频的真实性和可靠性。
AI.method: 提出PSIVG框架：1) 从预训练扩散模型生成的模板视频重建4D场景和前景物体网格；2) 在物理模拟器中初始化并生成物理一致的轨迹；3) 用模拟轨迹指导视频生成器产生时空物理连贯的运动；4) 提出测试时纹理一致性优化(TTCO)技术，基于模拟器的像素对应关系调整文本和特征嵌入以改善纹理一致性。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，PSIVG生成的视频能更好地遵循现实世界物理规律，同时保持视觉质量和多样性。
AI.conclusion: PSIVG通过将物理模拟器集成到视频生成流程中，显著提升了生成视频的物理一致性，为更真实可靠的AI视频生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: FontUse: A Data-Centric Approach to Style- and Use-Case-Conditioned In-Image Typography
summary: Recent text-to-image models can generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet controlling typography remains challenging: requested typographic appearance is often ignored or only weakly followed. We address this limitation with a data-centric approach that trains image generation models using targeted supervision derived from a structured annotation pipeline specialized for typography. Our pipeline constructs a large-scale typography-focused dataset, FontUse, consisting of about 70K images annotated with user-friendly prompts, text-region locations, and OCR-recognized strings. The annotations are automatically produced using segmentation models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The prompts explicitly combine font styles (e.g., serif, script, elegant) and use cases (e.g., wedding invitations, coffee-shop menus), enabling intuitive specification even for novice users. Fine-tuning existing generators with these annotations allows them to consistently interpret style and use-case conditions as textual prompts without architectural modification. For evaluation, we introduce a Long-CLIP-based metric that measures alignment between generated typography and requested attributes. Experiments across diverse prompts and layouts show that models trained with our pipeline produce text renderings more consistent with prompts than competitive baselines. The source code for our annotation pipeline is available at https://github.com/xiaxinz/FontUSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FontUse数据集和标注流程，通过数据驱动方法改进文本到图像模型中的排版控制能力，使模型能更好地遵循字体样式和使用场景的提示要求。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像模型在排版控制方面存在不足，经常忽略或弱化用户请求的排版样式，需要专门的数据集和训练方法来提升排版生成质量。
AI.method: 构建FontUse大规模排版数据集（约70K图像），使用分割模型和多模态大语言模型自动标注用户友好提示、文本区域位置和OCR识别字符串；通过微调现有生成模型，使其能一致地解释样式和使用场景条件。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用该流程训练的模型在多样化提示和布局下，生成的文本渲染比竞争基线更符合提示要求；引入了基于Long-CLIP的评估指标来衡量排版与请求属性的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的数据驱动方法有效提升了文本到图像模型的排版控制能力，使模型能更准确地遵循字体样式和使用场景的提示，为排版生成提供了实用解决方案。

title: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Recently, unified multimodal models (UMMs) have made remarkable progress in integrating visual understanding and generation, demonstrating strong potential for complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks. Despite their theoretical promise, a persistent capability gap exists: UMMs typically exhibit superior visual understanding but comparatively weaker generative capabilities. This discrepancy arises largely from the intrinsic decoupling between the understanding and generation processes. While a UMM can accurately interpret fine-grained visual details, it often struggles to produce semantically coherent images from complex textual prompts. To address this challenge, we explore UMMs' internal understanding capability to enhance generation quality. We propose a token-level intrinsic text-image alignment reward mechanism, GvU, enabling the UMM to act simultaneously as teacher and student: it evaluates its own outputs using the understanding branch to guide the generations accordingly. Building upon this, we design a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework, allowing UMMs to iteratively improve their generation quality through understanding-based intrinsic reward signals--without reliance on external supervision. Experimental results show that our method substantially boosts UMMs' generation, which in turn strengthens their fine-grained visual understanding, narrowing the capability gap between UMMs' visual understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为GvU的自监督强化学习框架，利用统一多模态模型自身的理解能力来提升其生成质量，从而缩小理解与生成之间的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型在视觉理解方面表现出色，但在生成能力上相对较弱，存在理解与生成过程的内在解耦问题。模型能够准确理解细粒度视觉细节，却难以从复杂文本提示生成语义连贯的图像。
AI.method: 提出GvU方法，这是一种基于token级别的内在文本-图像对齐奖励机制。让统一多模态模型同时扮演教师和学生的角色：使用理解分支评估自身输出，并据此指导生成过程。在此基础上设计了自监督强化学习框架，使模型能够通过基于理解的内在奖励信号迭代提升生成质量，无需外部监督。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了统一多模态模型的生成能力，同时反过来增强了其细粒度视觉理解能力，有效缩小了视觉理解与生成之间的能力差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用统一多模态模型内部的理解能力来指导生成过程，可以有效地弥合理解与生成之间的鸿沟，实现两者能力的协同提升。

title: GenHOI: Towards Object-Consistent Hand-Object Interaction with Temporally Balanced and Spatially Selective Object Injection
summary: Hand-Object Interaction (HOI) remains a core challenge in digital human video synthesis, where models must generate physically plausible contact and preserve object identity across frames. Although recent HOI reenactment approaches have achieved progress, they are typically trained and evaluated in-domain and fail to generalize to complex, in-the-wild scenarios. In contrast, all-in-one video editing models exhibit broader robustness but still struggle with HOI-specific issues such as inconsistent object appearance. In this paper, we present GenHOI, a lightweight augmentation to pretrained video generation models that injects reference-object information in a temporally balanced and spatially selective manner. For temporal balancing, we propose Head-Sliding RoPE, which assigns head-specific temporal offsets to reference tokens, distributing their influence evenly across frames and mitigating the temporal decay of 3D RoPE to improve long-range object consistency. For spatial selectivity, we design a two-level spatial attention gate that concentrates object-conditioned attention on HOI regions and adaptively scales its strength, preserving background realism while enhancing interaction fidelity. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on unseen, in-the-wild scenes demonstrate that GenHOI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art HOI reenactment and all-in-one video editing methods. Project page: https://xuanhuang0.github.io/GenHOI/

AI.tldr: GenHOI是一个轻量级增强模块，用于提升预训练视频生成模型在复杂手-物体交互场景中的表现，通过时间平衡和空间选择性机制解决物体一致性保持问题。
AI.motivation: 当前手-物体交互(HOI)重演方法通常在特定领域训练和评估，难以泛化到复杂的真实场景；而通用视频编辑模型虽然鲁棒性更强，但在HOI特定问题上（如物体外观不一致）仍有不足。
AI.method: 提出GenHOI框架：1) 时间平衡机制：采用Head-Sliding RoPE技术，为参考标记分配头部特定的时间偏移，均匀分布其影响并缓解3D RoPE的时间衰减；2) 空间选择性机制：设计两级空间注意力门，将物体条件注意力集中在HOI区域，并自适应调整强度。
AI.result: 在未见过的真实场景中进行广泛定性和定量评估，GenHOI在HOI重演和通用视频编辑任务上均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: GenHOI通过轻量级增强有效提升了预训练视频生成模型在复杂手-物体交互场景中的性能，解决了物体一致性和交互真实性问题。

title: Do Foundation Models Know Geometry? Probing Frozen Features for Continuous Physical Measurement
summary: Vision-language models encode continuous geometry that their text pathway fails to express: a 6,000-parameter linear probe extracts hand joint angles at 6.1 degrees MAE from frozen features, while the best text output achieves only 20.0 degrees -- a 3.3x bottleneck. LoRA fine-tuning (r=16, 2,000 images) narrows this gap to 6.5 degrees, providing evidence for a pathway-training deficit rather than a representational one. Training objective determines accuracy more than architecture: five encoders spanning self-supervised, contrastive, and hybrid paradigms converge to statistically equivalent accuracy (R^2 approximately 0.55, TOST-equivalent at delta=0.03) despite sharing as little as CKA=0.41 representational similarity -- functional convergence without representational convergence. Autoregressive generation damages geometric fidelity, but the damage originates in the generation process, not in language alignment: Qwen2.5-VL's LLM layers actually improve probe accuracy over its raw vision encoder. Layer-wise analysis reveals a universal mid-network accuracy peak across all architectures, with attention heads in layers 18-22 carrying disproportionate geometric signal. These findings enable a single frozen backbone to function as a multi-task geometric sensor through lightweight probes, without fine-tuning or text generation.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型在几何表示上存在瓶颈：线性探针能从冻结特征中提取手部关节角度（6.1度MAE），而文本输出只能达到20.0度（3.3倍差距）。训练目标比架构更重要，五种编码器在功能上收敛但表示不收敛。自回归生成损害几何保真度，但损伤源于生成过程而非语言对齐。
AI.motivation: 研究视觉语言模型中视觉通路和文本通路在几何信息表达上的差异，探索模型内部几何表示的瓶颈机制，以及如何在不微调或文本生成的情况下利用冻结骨干网络作为多任务几何传感器。
AI.method: 使用6,000参数的线性探针从冻结的视觉语言模型特征中提取手部关节角度；比较不同训练目标（自监督、对比、混合）的五种编码器；分析LoRA微调（r=16，2,000图像）对几何表示的影响；进行层间分析，识别携带几何信号的关键注意力头位置。
AI.result: 线性探针从冻结特征中提取手部关节角度达到6.1度MAE，而最佳文本输出仅20.0度（3.3倍瓶颈）。LoRA微调将差距缩小到6.5度。五种编码器在功能上收敛（R^2约0.55），但表示相似度低至CKA=0.41。发现中间层（18-22层）的注意力头携带不成比例的几何信号，Qwen2.5-VL的LLM层实际上提高了探针精度。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在通路训练缺陷而非表示缺陷，训练目标比架构对几何精度影响更大。通过轻量级探针可以利用冻结骨干网络作为多任务几何传感器，无需微调或文本生成。自回归生成过程本身损害几何保真度，而非语言对齐问题。

title: Devil is in Narrow Policy: Unleashing Exploration in Driving VLA Models
summary: We identify a fundamental Narrow Policy limitation undermining the performance of autonomous VLA models, where driving Imitation Learning (IL) tends to collapse exploration and limit the potential of subsequent Reinforcement Learning (RL) stages, which often saturate prematurely due to insufficient feedback diversity. Thereby, we propose Curious-VLA, a framework that alleviates the exploit-explore dilemma through a two-stage design. During IL, we introduce a Feasible Trajectory Expansion (FTE) strategy to generate multiple physically valid trajectories and a step-wise normalized trajectory representation to adapt this diverse data. In the RL stage, we present Adaptive Diversity-Aware Sampling (ADAS) that prioritizes high-diversity samples and introduce Spanning Driving Reward (SDR) with a focal style weighting to amplify reward's value span for improving sensitivity to driving quality. On the Navsim benchmark, Curious-VLA achieves SoTA results (PDMS 90.3, EPDMS 85.4) and a Best-of-N PDMS of 94.8, demonstrating its effectiveness in unlocking the exploratory potential of VLA models. Code: https://github.com/Mashiroln/curious_vla.git.

AI.tldr: Curious-VLA通过两阶段设计解决VLA模型的窄策略限制：IL阶段使用可行轨迹扩展和归一化轨迹表示增加数据多样性，RL阶段采用自适应多样性感知采样和跨度驾驶奖励来提升探索能力和驾驶质量敏感性，在Navsim基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 识别自动驾驶VLA模型存在窄策略限制问题：模仿学习倾向于限制探索，导致后续强化学习阶段因反馈多样性不足而过早饱和，从而影响模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Curious-VLA两阶段框架：1) IL阶段：引入可行轨迹扩展策略生成多个物理有效轨迹，使用逐步归一化轨迹表示适应多样化数据；2) RL阶段：提出自适应多样性感知采样优先选择高多样性样本，引入跨度驾驶奖励和焦点风格加权来扩大奖励值跨度，提升对驾驶质量的敏感性。
AI.result: 在Navsim基准测试中，Curious-VLA取得SOTA结果：PDMS 90.3，EPDMS 85.4，Best-of-N PDMS达到94.8，证明该框架能有效释放VLA模型的探索潜力。
AI.conclusion: Curious-VLA通过缓解利用-探索困境，成功解决了VLA模型的窄策略限制问题，显著提升了自动驾驶模型的性能，代码已开源。

title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language-Model for Surgical Reasoning
summary: Surgeons don't just see -- they interpret. When an expert observes a surgical scene, they understand not only what instrument is being used, but why it was chosen, what risk it poses, and what comes next. Current surgical AI cannot answer such questions, largely because training data that explicitly encodes surgical reasoning is immensely difficult to annotate at scale. Yet surgical video lectures already contain exactly this -- explanations of intent, rationale, and anticipation, narrated by experts for the purpose of teaching. Though inherently noisy and unstructured, these narrations encode the reasoning that surgical AI currently lacks. We introduce SUREON, a large-scale video QA dataset that systematically harvests this training signal from surgical academic videos. SUREON defines 12 question categories covering safety assessment, decision rationale, and forecasting, and uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract and structure supervision at scale. Across 134.7K clips and 170 procedure types, SUREON yields 206.8k QA pairs and an expert-validated benchmark of 354 examples. To evaluate the extent to which this supervision translates to surgical reasoning ability, we introduce two models: SureonVLM, a vision-language model adapted through supervised fine-tuning, and SureonVLM-R1, a reasoning model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. Both models can answer complex questions about surgery and substantially outperform larger general-domain models, exceeding 84% accuracy on the SUREON benchmark while outperforming general-domain models on standard surgical perception tasks. Qualitative analysis of SureonVLM-R1 reveals explicit reasoning behavior, such as inferring operative intent from visual context.

AI.tldr: SUREON是一个从手术教学视频中提取专家推理信息的大规模视频问答数据集，包含12个问题类别，涵盖安全性评估、决策理据和预测，用于训练具有手术推理能力的人工智能模型。
AI.motivation: 当前手术AI缺乏理解手术意图、理据和风险的能力，因为大规模标注包含手术推理的训练数据非常困难。然而，手术教学视频中专家讲解的内容正好包含了这些推理信息，虽然这些叙述是嘈杂和非结构化的。
AI.method: 通过多智能体管道从手术学术视频中大规模提取和结构化监督信息，创建了包含12个问题类别的SUREON数据集，包含134.7K个视频片段、170种手术类型和206.8k个问答对。开发了SureonVLM（监督微调的视觉语言模型）和SureonVLM-R1（使用Group Relative Policy Optimization训练的逻辑推理模型）。
AI.result: 两个模型都能回答复杂的手术问题，在SUREON基准测试中准确率超过84%，同时在标准手术感知任务上优于更大的通用领域模型。SureonVLM-R1展现出明确的推理行为，如从视觉上下文中推断手术意图。
AI.conclusion: 从手术教学视频中提取的监督信号可以有效训练具有手术推理能力的AI模型，填补了当前手术AI在理解手术意图、理据和风险方面的能力空白。

title: Lyapunov Probes for Hallucination Detection in Large Foundation Models
summary: We address hallucination detection in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by framing the problem through the lens of dynamical systems stability theory. Rather than treating hallucination as a straightforward classification task, we conceptualize (M)LLMs as dynamical systems, where factual knowledge is represented by stable equilibrium points within the representation space. Our main insight is that hallucinations tend to arise at the boundaries of knowledge-transition regions separating stable and unstable zones. To capture this phenomenon, we propose Lyapunov Probes: lightweight networks trained with derivative-based stability constraints that enforce a monotonic decay in confidence under input perturbations. By performing systematic perturbation analysis and applying a two-stage training process, these probes reliably distinguish between stable factual regions and unstable, hallucination-prone regions. Experiments on diverse datasets and models demonstrate consistent improvements over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Lyapunov Probes方法，将LLMs/MLLMs视为动力系统，通过稳定性理论检测幻觉，在稳定事实区域和不稳定幻觉区域边界进行区分
AI.motivation: 传统方法将幻觉检测视为分类任务，但作者认为应从动力系统稳定性理论角度理解，将事实知识视为表示空间中的稳定平衡点，幻觉发生在知识过渡区域的边界
AI.method: 提出Lyapunov Probes：轻量级网络，通过基于导数的稳定性约束训练，在输入扰动下强制置信度单调衰减；采用系统扰动分析和两阶段训练过程
AI.result: 在多样化数据集和模型上的实验表明，该方法相比现有基线有持续改进
AI.conclusion: 通过动力系统稳定性理论框架理解幻觉检测，Lyapunov Probes能可靠区分稳定事实区域和不稳定幻觉区域，为LLMs/MLLMs的幻觉检测提供了新视角

title: FedARKS: Federated Aggregation via Robust and Discriminative Knowledge Selection and Integration for Person Re-identification
summary: The application of federated domain generalization in person re-identification (FedDG-ReID) aims to enhance the model's generalization ability in unseen domains while protecting client data privacy. However, existing mainstream methods typically rely on global feature representations and simple averaging operations for model aggregation, leading to two limitations in domain generalization: (1) Using only global features makes it difficult to capture subtle, domain-invariant local details (such as accessories or textures); (2) Uniform parameter averaging treats all clients as equivalent, ignoring their differences in robust feature extraction capabilities, thereby diluting the contributions of high quality clients. To address these issues, we propose a novel federated learning framework, Federated Aggregation via Robust and Discriminative Knowledge Selection and Integration (FedARKS), comprising two mechanisms: RK (Robust Knowledge) and KS (Knowledge Selection).

AI.tldr: FedARKS框架通过鲁棒知识提取和知识选择机制，解决联邦域泛化行人重识别中全局特征不足和参数平均忽略客户端差异的问题
AI.motivation: 现有联邦域泛化行人重识别方法依赖全局特征表示和简单参数平均，存在两个局限：1) 仅用全局特征难以捕捉域不变的局部细节；2) 统一参数平均忽略客户端在鲁棒特征提取能力上的差异，稀释高质量客户端的贡献
AI.method: 提出FedARKS框架，包含两个机制：RK（鲁棒知识）机制提取域不变局部特征，KS（知识选择）机制根据客户端特征提取能力差异进行选择性聚合
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确说明具体实验结果，但方法旨在提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力，同时保护客户端数据隐私
AI.conclusion: FedARKS框架通过鲁棒知识提取和差异化知识选择，有效解决了联邦域泛化行人重识别中的特征表示和聚合优化问题

title: Cross-Resolution Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation
summary: Diffusion distillation is central to accelerating image and video generation, yet existing methods are fundamentally limited by the denoising process, where step reduction has largely saturated. Partial timestep low-resolution generation can further accelerate inference, but it suffers noticeable quality degradation due to cross-resolution distribution gaps. We propose Cross-Resolution Distribution Matching Distillation (RMD), a novel distillation framework that bridges cross-resolution distribution gaps for high-fidelity, few-step multi-resolution cascaded inference. Specifically, RMD divides the timestep intervals for each resolution using logarithmic signal-to-noise ratio (logSNR) curves, and introduces logSNR-based mapping to compensate for resolution-induced shifts. Distribution matching is conducted along resolution trajectories to reduce the gap between low-resolution generator distributions and the teacher's high-resolution distribution. In addition, a predicted-noise re-injection mechanism is incorporated during upsampling to stabilize training and improve synthesis quality. Quantitative and qualitative results show that RMD preserves high-fidelity generation while accelerating inference across various backbones. Notably, RMD achieves up to 33.4X speedup on SDXL and 25.6X on Wan2.1-14B, while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出跨分辨率分布匹配蒸馏(RMD)框架，通过logSNR曲线划分时间步、跨分辨率分布匹配和噪声重注入机制，实现高保真、少步数的多分辨率级联推理加速
AI.motivation: 现有扩散蒸馏方法受限于去噪过程，时间步减少已基本饱和；部分时间步低分辨率生成虽然能加速推理，但存在跨分辨率分布差距导致质量下降的问题
AI.method: 1) 使用对数信噪比(logSNR)曲线为每个分辨率划分时间步区间；2) 引入基于logSNR的映射补偿分辨率引起的偏移；3) 沿分辨率轨迹进行分布匹配，缩小低分辨率生成器分布与教师高分辨率分布之间的差距；4) 在上采样过程中加入预测噪声重注入机制以稳定训练并提升合成质量
AI.result: RMD在保持高保真生成的同时显著加速推理：SDXL上实现33.4倍加速，Wan2.1-14B上实现25.6倍加速，同时保持高视觉保真度
AI.conclusion: RMD通过桥接跨分辨率分布差距，为高保真、少步数的多分辨率级联推理提供了有效的蒸馏框架，解决了现有方法在加速和质量之间的权衡问题

title: Spatial Colour Mixing Illusions as a Perception Stress Test for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong benchmark results, yet can exhibit systematic perceptual weaknesses: structured, large changes to pixel values can cause confident yet nonsensical predictions, even when the underlying scene remains easily recognizable to humans. We study this gap using Spatial Colour Mixing, a programmatic family of colour distortions that overlays structured patterns (in both RGB and Ostwald colour systems) onto natural images. We introduce a framework of eight spatial colour mixing variants and evaluate nine VLMs across three model families on four datasets. Across models and datasets, accuracy degrades sharply with increasing distortion, and scaling the language model does not reliably mitigate the failure. In a human study with 61 participants on an animal recognition dataset, humans substantially outperform VLMs under the same distortions. Finally, we show that a simple human-inspired preprocessing step recovers a meaningful portion of performance for several distortion types, motivating perception-aware preprocessing and tool-use as practical strategies for improving VLM robustness.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了视觉语言模型在结构化颜色扭曲下的感知弱点，发现即使场景对人类仍可识别，VLM的准确率也会急剧下降，而人类表现远优于VLM，通过人类启发的预处理可以部分恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在基准测试中表现良好，但它们存在系统性的感知弱点：像素值的结构化大幅变化可能导致模型做出自信但无意义的预测，即使底层场景对人类来说仍然容易识别。研究者希望探索这种人类与模型之间的感知差距。
AI.method: 使用空间颜色混合方法，这是一个程序化的颜色扭曲家族，在自然图像上叠加结构化模式（包括RGB和Ostwald颜色系统）。研究者引入了8种空间颜色混合变体，评估了3个模型家族的9个VLM在4个数据集上的表现。同时进行了包含61名参与者的人类研究，比较人类和VLM在相同扭曲下的表现。最后测试了简单的人类启发预处理步骤的效果。
AI.result: 随着扭曲程度的增加，所有模型和数据集上的准确率都急剧下降。扩大语言模型规模并不能可靠地缓解这种失败。在人类研究中，人类在相同扭曲下显著优于VLM。简单的人类启发预处理步骤能够为几种扭曲类型恢复相当一部分性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在系统性的感知弱点，对结构化颜色扭曲特别敏感。人类感知能力远优于当前VLM。基于感知的预处理和工具使用是提高VLM鲁棒性的实用策略。

title: FreeOcc: Training-free Panoptic Occupancy Prediction via Foundation Models
summary: Semantic and panoptic occupancy prediction for road scene analysis provides a dense 3D representation of the ego vehicle's surroundings. Current camera-only approaches typically rely on costly dense 3D supervision or require training models on data from the target domain, limiting deployment in unseen environments. We propose FreeOcc, a training-free pipeline that leverages pretrained foundation models to recover both semantics and geometry from multi-view images. FreeOcc extracts per-view panoptic priors with a promptable foundation segmentation model and prompt-to-taxonomy rules, and reconstructs metric 3D points with a reconstruction foundation model. Depth- and confidence- aware filtering lifts reliable labels into 3D, which are fused over time and voxelized with a deterministic refinement stack. For panoptic occupancy, instances are recovered by fitting and merging robust current-view 3D box candidates, enabling instance-aware occupancy without any learned 3D model. On Occ3D-nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves 16.9 mIoU and 16.5 RayIoU train-free, on par with state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods. When employed as a pseudo-label generation pipeline for training downstream models, it achieves 21.1 RayIoU, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art weakly supervised baseline. Furthermore, FreeOcc sets new baselines for both train-free and weakly supervised panoptic occupancy prediction, achieving 3.1 RayPQ and 3.9 RayPQ, respectively. These results highlight foundation-model-driven perception as a practical route to training-free 3D scene understanding.

AI.tldr: FreeOcc提出了一种无需训练的3D场景理解方法，利用预训练基础模型从多视角图像中恢复语义和几何信息，实现道路场景的语义和全景占用预测。
AI.motivation: 当前基于相机的3D场景理解方法通常需要昂贵的密集3D监督或需要针对目标域数据进行训练，这限制了在未见环境中的部署。需要一种无需训练的方法来实现跨域泛化。
AI.method: 1) 使用可提示的基础分割模型提取每视角的全景先验；2) 使用重建基础模型恢复度量3D点；3) 通过深度和置信度感知的过滤将可靠标签提升到3D空间；4) 随时间融合并使用确定性细化堆栈进行体素化；5) 通过拟合和合并当前视角的3D框候选来恢复实例。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，FreeOcc无需训练达到16.9 mIoU和16.5 RayIoU，与最先进的弱监督方法相当。作为伪标签生成管道训练下游模型时，达到21.1 RayIoU，超过之前的弱监督基线。在全景占用预测方面，分别达到3.1和3.9 RayPQ。
AI.conclusion: 基于基础模型的感知是实现无需训练的3D场景理解的实用途径，FreeOcc为无需训练和弱监督的全景占用预测设定了新的基线。

title: Towards Motion Turing Test: Evaluating Human-Likeness in Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in motion generation and control, exhibiting movements that appear increasingly natural and human-like. Inspired by the Turing Test, we propose the Motion Turing Test, a framework that evaluates whether human observers can discriminate between humanoid robot and human poses using only kinematic information. To facilitate this evaluation, we present the Human-Humanoid Motion (HHMotion) dataset, which consists of 1,000 motion sequences spanning 15 action categories, performed by 11 humanoid models and 10 human subjects. All motion sequences are converted into SMPL-X representations to eliminate the influence of visual appearance. We recruited 30 annotators to rate the human-likeness of each pose on a 0-5 scale, resulting in over 500 hours of annotation. Analysis of the collected data reveals that humanoid motions still exhibit noticeable deviations from human movements, particularly in dynamic actions such as jumping, boxing, and running. Building on HHMotion, we formulate a human-likeness evaluation task that aims to automatically predict human-likeness scores from motion data. Despite recent progress in multimodal large language models, we find that they remain inadequate for assessing motion human-likeness. To address this, we propose a simple baseline model and demonstrate that it outperforms several contemporary LLM-based methods. The dataset, code, and benchmark will be publicly released to support future research in the community.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Motion Turing Test框架和HHMotion数据集，用于评估人形机器人动作与人类动作的相似度，并建立了自动评估模型。
AI.motivation: 受图灵测试启发，研究者希望评估人形机器人动作与人类动作的相似程度，但目前缺乏系统性的评估框架和数据集。
AI.method: 提出了Motion Turing Test框架，创建了包含1000个动作序列的HHMotion数据集，将动作转换为SMPL-X表示以消除视觉外观影响，并招募30名标注者对动作的人类相似度进行评分。
AI.result: 分析发现人形机器人动作与人类动作仍存在明显差异，特别是在跳跃、拳击、跑步等动态动作中。提出的基线模型在预测动作人类相似度评分方面优于现有的多模态大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 人形机器人动作与人类动作仍有差距，需要更有效的评估方法。提出的Motion Turing Test框架、HHMotion数据集和基线模型为相关研究提供了基础，数据集和代码将公开以支持社区研究。

title: SpaCRD: Multimodal Deep Fusion of Histology and Spatial Transcriptomics for Cancer Region Detection
summary: Accurate detection of cancer tissue regions (CTR) enables deeper analysis of the tumor microenvironment and offers crucial insights into treatment response. Traditional CTR detection methods, which typically rely on the rich cellular morphology in histology images, are susceptible to a high rate of false positives due to morphological similarities across different tissue regions. The groundbreaking advances in spatial transcriptomics (ST) provide detailed cellular phenotypes and spatial localization information, offering new opportunities for more accurate cancer region detection. However, current methods are unable to effectively integrate histology images with ST data, especially in the context of cross-sample and cross-platform/batch settings for accomplishing the CTR detection. To address this challenge, we propose SpaCRD, a transfer learning-based method that deeply integrates histology images and ST data to enable reliable CTR detection across diverse samples, platforms, and batches. Once trained on source data, SpaCRD can be readily generalized to accurately detect cancerous regions across samples from different platforms and batches. The core of SpaCRD is a category-regularized variational reconstruction-guided bidirectional cross-attention fusion network, which enables the model to adaptively capture latent co-expression patterns between histological features and gene expression from multiple perspectives. Extensive benchmark analysis on 23 matched histology-ST datasets spanning various disease types, platforms, and batches demonstrates that SpaCRD consistently outperforms existing eight state-of-the-art methods in CTR detection.

AI.tldr: SpaCRD：一种基于迁移学习的空间转录组学与组织学图像融合方法，用于跨样本、跨平台的癌症组织区域检测
AI.motivation: 传统基于组织学图像的癌症区域检测方法由于不同组织区域间的形态相似性容易产生高假阳性率。空间转录组学提供了详细的细胞表型和空间定位信息，为更准确的癌症区域检测提供了新机会，但现有方法无法有效整合组织学图像与ST数据，特别是在跨样本、跨平台/批次的CTR检测场景中。
AI.method: 提出SpaCRD方法，采用基于迁移学习的框架，核心是类别正则化变分重建引导的双向交叉注意力融合网络。该网络能够从多个角度自适应地捕捉组织学特征与基因表达之间的潜在共表达模式，实现组织学图像与ST数据的深度整合。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种疾病类型、平台和批次的23个匹配的组织学-ST数据集上进行基准测试，SpaCRD在CTR检测任务中持续优于现有的8种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SpaCRD能够有效整合组织学图像与空间转录组学数据，实现跨样本、跨平台和批次的可靠癌症组织区域检测，为肿瘤微环境分析和治疗反应评估提供了重要工具。

title: Adaptive Language-Aware Image Reflection Removal Network
summary: Existing image reflection removal methods struggle to handle complex reflections. Accurate language descriptions can help the model understand the image content to remove complex reflections. However, due to blurred and distorted interferences in reflected images, machine-generated language descriptions of the image content are often inaccurate, which harms the performance of language-guided reflection removal. To address this, we propose the Adaptive Language-Aware Network (ALANet) to remove reflections even with inaccurate language inputs. Specifically, ALANet integrates both filtering and optimization strategies. The filtering strategy reduces the negative effects of language while preserving its benefits, whereas the optimization strategy enhances the alignment between language and visual features. ALANet also utilizes language cues to decouple specific layer content from feature maps, improving its ability to handle complex reflections. To evaluate the model's performance under complex reflections and varying levels of language accuracy, we introduce the Complex Reflection and Language Accuracy Variance (CRLAV) dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that ALANet surpasses state-of-the-art methods for image reflection removal. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/fashyon/ALANet.

AI.tldr: ALANet通过自适应语言感知网络处理复杂反射去除问题，即使在语言描述不准确的情况下也能有效工作，结合过滤和优化策略，并引入CRLAV数据集进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有图像反射去除方法难以处理复杂反射，而语言描述可以帮助模型理解图像内容。但由于反射图像中的模糊和扭曲干扰，机器生成的语言描述往往不准确，这会损害语言引导的反射去除性能。
AI.method: 提出自适应语言感知网络（ALANet），集成过滤和优化策略：过滤策略减少语言的负面影响同时保留其优势；优化策略增强语言和视觉特征的对齐。ALANet还利用语言线索从特征图中解耦特定层内容，提高处理复杂反射的能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明ALANet在图像反射去除任务上超越了现有最先进方法。为了评估模型在复杂反射和不同语言准确度下的性能，引入了复杂反射和语言准确度变化（CRLAV）数据集。
AI.conclusion: ALANet能够有效处理复杂反射去除问题，即使在语言输入不准确的情况下也能保持良好性能，通过自适应语言感知机制提高了反射去除的鲁棒性和效果。

title: Point-Supervised Skeleton-Based Human Action Segmentation
summary: Skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a fundamental yet challenging task, playing a crucial role in enabling intelligent systems to perceive and respond to human activities. While fully-supervised methods achieve satisfactory performance, they require costly frame-level annotations and are sensitive to ambiguous action boundaries. To address these issues, we introduce a point-supervised framework for skeleton-based action segmentation, where only a single frame per action segment is labeled. We leverage multimodal skeleton data, including joint, bone, and motion information, encoded via a pretrained unified model to extract rich feature representations. To generate reliable pseudo-labels, we propose a novel prototype similarity method and integrate it with two existing methods: energy function and constrained K-Medoids clustering. Multimodal pseudo-label integration is proposed to enhance the reliability of the pseudo-label and guide the model training. We establish new benchmarks on PKU-MMD (X-Sub and X-View), MCFS-22, and MCFS-130, and implement baselines for point-supervised skeleton-based human action segmentation. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves competitive performance, even surpassing some fully-supervised methods while significantly reducing annotation effort.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于骨骼时序动作分割的点监督框架，仅需每个动作片段标注一帧，通过多模态骨骼数据、原型相似性和伪标签集成方法，在显著减少标注成本的同时达到与全监督方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 全监督的骨骼时序动作分割方法需要昂贵的逐帧标注，且对模糊的动作边界敏感。为降低标注成本并提高模型鲁棒性，需要开发只需稀疏标注的点监督方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练统一模型编码多模态骨骼数据（关节、骨骼、运动信息）；2) 提出原型相似性方法，并与能量函数和约束K-Medoids聚类集成生成可靠伪标签；3) 通过多模态伪标签集成增强伪标签可靠性并指导模型训练。
AI.result: 在PKU-MMD (X-Sub和X-View)、MCFS-22和MCFS-130数据集上建立了新的点监督基准，实验表明该方法达到竞争性性能，甚至超越某些全监督方法，同时显著减少标注工作量。
AI.conclusion: 提出的点监督框架通过多模态特征提取和创新的伪标签生成策略，在骨骼时序动作分割任务中实现了标注效率与性能的良好平衡，为低成本智能系统感知人类活动提供了有效解决方案。

title: EntON: Eigenentropy-Optimized Neighborhood Densification in 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Submitted to ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing on 20 February 2026
summary: We present a novel Eigenentropy-optimized neighboorhood densification strategy EntON in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for geometrically accurate and high-quality rendered 3D reconstruction. While standard 3DGS produces Gaussians whose centers and surfaces are poorly aligned with the underlying object geometry, surface-focused reconstruction methods frequently sacrifice photometric accuracy. In contrast to the conventional densification strategy, which relies on the magnitude of the view-space position gradient, our approach introduces a geometry-aware strategy to guide adaptive splitting and pruning. Specifically, we compute the 3D shape feature Eigenentropy from the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix in the k-nearest neighborhood of each Gaussian center, which quantifies the local structural order. These Eigenentropy values are integrated into an alternating optimization framework: During the optimization process, the algorithm alternates between (i) standard gradient-based densification, which refines regions via view-space gradients, and (ii) Eigenentropy-aware densification, which preferentially densifies Gaussians in low-Eigenentropy (ordered, flat) neighborhoods to better capture fine geometric details on the object surface, and prunes those in high-Eigenentropy (disordered, spherical) regions. We provide quantitative and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark datasets: small-scale DTU dataset and large-scale TUM2TWIN dataset, covering man-made objects and urban scenes. Experiments demonstrate that our Eigenentropy-aware alternating densification strategy improves geometric accuracy by up to 33% and rendering quality by up to 7%, while reducing the number of Gaussians by up to 50% and training time by up to 23%. Overall, EnTON achieves a favorable balance between geometric accuracy, rendering quality and efficiency by avoiding unnecessary scene expansion.

AI.tldr: 提出EntON方法，通过特征熵优化的邻域密度化策略改进3D高斯溅射，在保持渲染质量的同时提升几何精度并减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS产生的高斯中心与物体几何表面对齐不佳，而专注于表面的重建方法常牺牲光度精度。需要一种既能保持渲染质量又能提升几何精度的方法。
AI.method: 引入基于特征熵的几何感知密度化策略。计算每个高斯中心k近邻协方差矩阵特征值的特征熵，量化局部结构有序度。在交替优化框架中结合标准梯度密度化和特征熵感知密度化，优先在低特征熵（有序、平坦）区域细化高斯，在高特征熵（无序、球形）区域修剪高斯。
AI.result: 在DTU和TUM2TWIN数据集上评估，几何精度提升达33%，渲染质量提升达7%，高斯数量减少达50%，训练时间减少达23%。
AI.conclusion: EntON通过特征熵感知的交替密度化策略，在避免不必要场景扩展的同时，实现了几何精度、渲染质量和效率之间的良好平衡。

title: NOVA: Next-step Open-Vocabulary Autoregression for 3D Multi-Object Tracking in Autonomous Driving
comment: Code will be available at https://github.com/xifen523/NOVA
summary: Generalizing across unknown targets is critical for open-world perception, yet existing 3D Multi-Object Tracking (3D MOT) pipelines remain limited by closed-set assumptions and ``semantic-blind'' heuristics. To address this, we propose Next-step Open-Vocabulary Autoregression (NOVA), an innovative paradigm that shifts 3D tracking from traditional fragmented distance-based matching toward generative spatio-temporal semantic modeling. NOVA reformulates 3D trajectories as structured spatio-temporal semantic sequences, enabling the simultaneous encoding of physical motion continuity and deep linguistic priors. By leveraging the autoregressive capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we transform the tracking task into a principled process of next-step sequence completion. This mechanism allows the model to explicitly utilize the hierarchical structure of language space to resolve fine-grained semantic ambiguities and maintain identity consistency across complex long-range sequences through high-level commonsense reasoning. Extensive experiments on nuScenes, V2X-Seq-SPD, and KITTI demonstrate the superior performance of NOVA. Notably, on the nuScenes dataset, NOVA achieves an AMOTA of 22.41% for Novel categories, yielding a significant 20.21% absolute improvement over the baseline. These gains are realized through a compact 0.5B autoregressive model. Code will be available at https://github.com/xifen523/NOVA.

AI.tldr: NOVA提出了一种新的开放词汇3D多目标跟踪范式，通过将轨迹重构为结构化时空语义序列，利用大语言模型的自回归能力实现基于语义的跟踪，显著提升了未知类别目标的跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D多目标跟踪方法受限于闭集假设和"语义盲"启发式方法，无法有效泛化到未知目标类别。需要一种能够处理开放世界感知、利用语义信息进行跟踪的新方法。
AI.method: 将3D轨迹重构为结构化时空语义序列，利用大语言模型的自回归能力，将跟踪任务转化为基于原则的下一步序列补全过程。通过语言空间的层次结构解决细粒度语义模糊性，利用常识推理保持复杂长序列中的身份一致性。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、V2X-Seq-SPD和KITTI数据集上表现出优越性能。在nuScenes数据集上，NOVA在Novel类别上达到22.41%的AMOTA，相比基线有20.21%的绝对提升，仅使用0.5B参数的自回归模型实现。
AI.conclusion: NOVA通过将3D跟踪从传统的基于距离的碎片化匹配转向生成式时空语义建模，成功解决了开放词汇3D跟踪问题，为开放世界感知提供了新的有效范式。

title: ODD-SEC: Onboard Drone Detection with a Spinning Event Camera
summary: The rapid proliferation of drones requires balancing innovation with regulation. To address security and privacy concerns, techniques for drone detection have attracted significant attention.Passive solutions, such as frame camera-based systems, offer versatility and energy efficiency under typical conditions but are fundamentally constrained by their operational principles in scenarios involving fast-moving targets or adverse illumination.Inspired by biological vision, event cameras asynchronously detect per-pixel brightness changes, offering high dynamic range and microsecond-level responsiveness that make them uniquely suited for drone detection in conditions beyond the reach of conventional frame-based cameras.However, the design of most existing event-based solutions assumes a static camera, greatly limiting their applicability to moving carriers--such as quadrupedal robots or unmanned ground vehicles--during field operations.In this paper, we introduce a real-time drone detection system designed for deployment on moving carriers. The system utilizes a spinning event-based camera, providing a 360° horizontal field of view and enabling bearing estimation of detected drones. A key contribution is a novel image-like event representation that operates without motion compensation, coupled with a lightweight neural network architecture for efficient spatiotemporal learning. Implemented on an onboard Jetson Orin NX, the system can operate in real time. Outdoor experimental results validate reliable detection with a mean angular error below 2° under challenging conditions, underscoring its suitability for real-world surveillance applications. We will open-source our complete pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于移动载体的实时无人机检测系统，使用旋转事件相机实现360°水平视野，无需运动补偿，在Jetson Orin NX上实时运行，平均角度误差小于2°。
AI.motivation: 无人机快速普及需要平衡创新与监管，现有被动检测方案（如帧相机）在快速移动目标或恶劣光照条件下受限。事件相机具有高动态范围和微秒级响应，但现有方案假设相机静止，限制了在移动载体（如四足机器人、无人地面车辆）上的应用。
AI.method: 采用旋转事件相机提供360°水平视野，提出无需运动补偿的新型图像式事件表示方法，结合轻量级神经网络架构进行高效时空学习，在Jetson Orin NX上实现实时运行。
AI.result: 室外实验验证了系统在挑战性条件下的可靠检测能力，平均角度误差低于2°，适合实际监控应用，系统将开源以支持未来研究。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功解决了移动载体上的无人机检测问题，通过旋转事件相机和无需运动补偿的表示方法，实现了实时、高精度的检测，为实际监控应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Spectral and Trajectory Regularization for Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion transformer (DiT) architectures show great potential for real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, their computationally expensive iterative sampling necessitates one-step distillation. Existing one-step distillation methods struggle with Real-ISR on DiT. They suffer from fundamental trajectory mismatch and generate severe grid-like periodic artifacts. To tackle these challenges, we propose StrSR, a novel one-step adversarial distillation framework featuring spectral and trajectory regularization. Specifically, we propose an asymmetric discriminative distillation architecture to bridge the trajectory gap. Additionally, we design a frequency distribution matching strategy to effectively suppress DiT-specific periodic artifacts caused by high-frequency spectral leakage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StrSR achieves state-of-the-art performance in Real-ISR, across both quantitative metrics and visual perception. The code and models will be released at https://github.com/jkwang28/StrSR .

AI.tldr: StrSR提出了一种针对扩散变换器（DiT）的一步对抗蒸馏框架，通过谱和轨迹正则化解决Real-ISR中的轨迹失配和周期性伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器（DiT）在真实图像超分辨率（Real-ISR）中表现出潜力，但其迭代采样计算成本高，需要一步蒸馏。现有的一步蒸馏方法在DiT上存在轨迹失配和严重网格状周期性伪影的问题。
AI.method: 提出了StrSR框架，包含：1）非对称判别蒸馏架构来弥合轨迹差距；2）频率分布匹配策略来抑制DiT特有的高频谱泄漏引起的周期性伪影。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，StrSR在Real-ISR任务中实现了最先进的性能，在定量指标和视觉感知方面都表现出色。
AI.conclusion: StrSR通过谱和轨迹正则化有效解决了DiT在Real-ISR中的一步蒸馏问题，显著提升了性能并减少了伪影。

title: Can we Trust Unreliable Voxels? Exploring 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction under Label Noise
comment: The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/mylwx/OccNL
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is a cornerstone of robotic perception, yet real-world voxel annotations are inherently corrupted by structural artifacts and dynamic trailing effects. This raises a critical but underexplored question: can autonomous systems safely rely on such unreliable occupancy supervision? To systematically investigate this issue, we establish OccNL, the first benchmark dedicated to 3D occupancy under occupancy-asymmetric and dynamic trailing noise. Our analysis reveals a fundamental domain gap: state-of-the-art 2D label noise learning strategies collapse catastrophically in sparse 3D voxel spaces, exposing a critical vulnerability in existing paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose DPR-Occ, a principled label noise-robust framework that constructs reliable supervision through dual-source partial label reasoning. By synergizing temporal model memory with representation-level structural affinity, DPR-Occ dynamically expands and prunes candidate label sets to preserve true semantics while suppressing noise propagation. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that DPR-Occ prevents geometric and semantic collapse under extreme corruption. Notably, even at 90% label noise, our method achieves significant performance gains (up to 2.57% mIoU and 13.91% IoU) over existing label noise learning baselines adapted to the 3D occupancy prediction task. By bridging label noise learning and 3D perception, OccNL and DPR-Occ provide a reliable foundation for safety-critical robotic perception in dynamic environments. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/mylwx/OccNL.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对3D语义占据预测中标签噪声问题，建立了首个面向占据不对称和动态拖尾噪声的基准OccNL，并提出DPR-Occ框架，通过双源部分标签推理在极端噪声下保持性能稳定。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的体素标注存在结构伪影和动态拖尾效应等固有噪声，这引发了一个关键但未被充分探索的问题：自动驾驶系统能否安全依赖这种不可靠的占据监督？需要系统研究3D占据预测中的标签噪声问题。
AI.method: 提出DPR-Occ框架，通过双源部分标签推理构建可靠监督：结合时间模型记忆和表示层结构亲和性，动态扩展和修剪候选标签集，在保留真实语义的同时抑制噪声传播。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI上的实验表明，DPR-Occ在极端噪声下防止了几何和语义崩溃。即使在90%标签噪声下，相比现有标签噪声学习方法，该方法仍能获得显著性能提升（最高2.57% mIoU和13.91% IoU）。
AI.conclusion: 通过桥接标签噪声学习和3D感知，OccNL基准和DPR-Occ框架为动态环境中安全关键的机器人感知提供了可靠基础，揭示了现有范式在稀疏3D体素空间中的关键脆弱性。

title: Attribute Distribution Modeling and Semantic-Visual Alignment for Generative Zero-shot Learning
summary: Generative zero-shot learning (ZSL) synthesizes features for unseen classes, leveraging semantic conditions to transfer knowledge from seen classes. However, it also introduces two intrinsic challenges: (1) class-level attributes fails to capture instance-specific visual appearances due to substantial intra-class variability, thus causing the class-instance gap; (2) the substantial mismatch between semantic and visual feature distributions, manifested in inter-class correlations, gives rise to the semantic-visual domain gap. To address these challenges, we propose an Attribute Distribution Modeling and Semantic-Visual Alignment (ADiVA) approach, jointly modeling attribute distributions and performing explicit semantic-visual alignment. Specifically, our ADiVA consists of two modules: an Attribute Distribution Modeling (ADM) module that learns a transferable attribute distribution for each class and samples instance-level attributes for unseen classes, and a Visual-Guided Alignment (VGA) module that refines semantic representations to better reflect visual structures. Experiments on three widely used benchmark datasets demonstrate that ADiVA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods (e.g., achieving gains of 4.7% and 6.1% on AWA2 and SUN, respectively). Moreover, our approach can serve as a plugin to enhance existing generative ZSL methods.

AI.tldr: ADiVA方法通过属性分布建模和语义-视觉对齐，解决了生成式零样本学习中类-实例差距和语义-视觉域差距两大挑战，在多个基准数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式零样本学习虽然能合成未见类特征，但面临两个内在挑战：1）类级属性无法捕捉实例特定的视觉外观（类-实例差距）；2）语义与视觉特征分布不匹配（语义-视觉域差距）。
AI.method: 提出ADiVA方法，包含两个模块：属性分布建模（ADM）模块学习每个类的可转移属性分布并采样实例级属性；视觉引导对齐（VGA）模块细化语义表示以更好反映视觉结构。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的基准数据集上，ADiVA显著优于最先进方法（在AWA2和SUN数据集上分别获得4.7%和6.1%的提升），且可作为插件增强现有生成式ZSL方法。
AI.conclusion: ADiVA通过联合建模属性分布和执行显式语义-视觉对齐，有效解决了生成式零样本学习中的类-实例差距和语义-视觉域差距问题，取得了显著性能提升。

title: FlowMotion: Training-Free Flow Guidance for Video Motion Transfer
summary: Video motion transfer aims to generate a target video that inherits motion patterns from a source video while rendering new scenes. Existing training-free approaches focus on constructing motion guidance based on the intermediate outputs of pre-trained T2V models, which results in heavy computational overhead and limited flexibility. In this paper, we present FlowMotion, a novel training-free framework that enables efficient and flexible motion transfer by directly leveraging the predicted outputs of flow-based T2V models. Our key insight is that early latent predictions inherently encode rich temporal information. Motivated by this, we propose flow guidance, which extracts motion representations based on latent predictions to align motion patterns between source and generated videos. We further introduce a velocity regularization strategy to stabilize optimization and ensure smooth motion evolution. By operating purely on model predictions, FlowMotion achieves superior time and resource efficiency as well as competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: FlowMotion：基于流预测的无训练视频运动迁移框架，通过提取潜在预测中的运动表示实现高效灵活的运动对齐
AI.motivation: 现有无训练方法依赖T2V模型中间输出构建运动指导，计算开销大且灵活性有限。需要更高效灵活的运动迁移方法。
AI.method: 提出FlowMotion框架：1）利用流基T2V模型的预测输出直接提取运动表示；2）基于早期潜在预测编码的时间信息设计流指导；3）引入速度正则化策略稳定优化并确保平滑运动演化
AI.result: FlowMotion在时间和资源效率上表现优异，与最先进方法相比具有竞争力，实现了高效灵活的运动迁移
AI.conclusion: 通过直接利用模型预测而非中间输出，FlowMotion实现了高效、灵活且性能优异的无训练视频运动迁移框架

title: Latent Transfer Attack: Adversarial Examples via Generative Latent Spaces
summary: Adversarial attacks are a central tool for probing the robustness of modern vision models, yet most methods optimize perturbations directly in pixel space under $\ell_\infty$ or $\ell_2$ constraints. While effective in white-box settings, pixel-space optimization often produces high-frequency, texture-like noise that is brittle to common preprocessing (e.g., resizing and cropping) and transfers poorly across architectures. We propose $\textbf{LTA}$ ($\textbf{L}$atent $\textbf{T}$ransfer $\textbf{A}$ttack), a transfer-based attack that instead optimizes perturbations in the latent space of a pretrained Stable Diffusion VAE. Given a clean image, we encode it into a latent code and optimize the latent representation to maximize a surrogate classifier loss, while softly enforcing a pixel-space $\ell_\infty$ budget after decoding. To improve robustness to resolution mismatch and standard input pipelines, we incorporate Expectation Over Transformations (EOT) via randomized resizing, interpolation, and cropping, and apply periodic latent Gaussian smoothing to suppress emerging artifacts and stabilize optimization. Across a suite of CNN and vision-transformer targets, LTA achieves strong transfer attack success while producing spatially coherent, predominantly low-frequency perturbations that differ qualitatively from pixel-space baselines and occupy a distinct point in the transfer-quality trade-off. Our results highlight pretrained generative latent spaces as an effective and structured domain for adversarial optimization, bridging robustness evaluation with modern generative priors.

AI.tldr: LTA是一种基于潜在空间的对抗攻击方法，在Stable Diffusion VAE的潜在空间中优化扰动，通过EOT和潜在高斯平滑提高鲁棒性，产生空间相干、低频的扰动，在多种目标模型上实现强迁移攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 传统像素空间对抗攻击存在局限性：产生高频纹理噪声，对预处理（如调整大小、裁剪）脆弱，跨架构迁移效果差。需要一种更鲁棒、迁移性更好的攻击方法。
AI.method: LTA在预训练的Stable Diffusion VAE潜在空间中优化扰动：1）将干净图像编码为潜在代码；2）优化潜在表示以最大化代理分类器损失；3）解码后软性强制执行像素空间ℓ∞约束；4）通过随机调整大小、插值和裁剪的EOT提高鲁棒性；5）应用周期性潜在高斯平滑抑制伪影并稳定优化。
AI.result: 在CNN和视觉Transformer目标模型套件上，LTA实现了强迁移攻击成功率，产生空间相干、主要为低频的扰动，与像素空间基线在质量上有显著差异，在迁移-质量权衡中占据独特位置。
AI.conclusion: 预训练生成潜在空间是对抗优化的有效结构化领域，将鲁棒性评估与现代生成先验联系起来，为对抗攻击提供了新视角。

title: WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models have shown strong potential for unified world simulation, but the iterative denoising remains too costly for interactive use and long-horizon rollouts. While feature caching can accelerate inference without training, we find that policies designed for single-modal diffusion transfer poorly to world models due to two world-model-specific obstacles: \emph{token heterogeneity} from multi-modal coupling and spatial variation, and \emph{non-uniform temporal dynamics} where a small set of hard tokens drives error growth, making uniform skipping either unstable or overly conservative. We propose \textbf{WorldCache}, a caching framework tailored to diffusion world models. We introduce \textit{Curvature-guided Heterogeneous Token Prediction}, which uses a physics-grounded curvature score to estimate token predictability and applies a Hermite-guided damped predictor for chaotic tokens with abrupt direction changes. We also design \textit{Chaotic-prioritized Adaptive Skipping}, which accumulates a curvature-normalized, dimensionless drift signal and recomputes only when bottleneck tokens begin to drift. Experiments on diffusion world models show that WorldCache delivers up to \textbf{3.7$\times$} end-to-end speedups while maintaining \textbf{98\%} rollout quality, demonstrating the vast advantages and practicality of WorldCache in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code is released in https://github.com/FofGofx/WorldCache.

AI.tldr: WorldCache：针对扩散世界模型的缓存框架，通过曲率引导的异质令牌预测和混沌优先自适应跳过，实现3.7倍加速同时保持98%的推演质量
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的世界模型在统一世界模拟方面表现出强大潜力，但迭代去噪过程计算成本过高，难以支持交互式使用和长时域推演。现有特征缓存方法虽然能加速推理，但为单模态扩散设计的策略无法有效应用于世界模型，主要面临两个特定障碍：多模态耦合和空间变化导致的令牌异质性，以及非均匀时间动态性（少量困难令牌驱动误差增长）
AI.method: 提出WorldCache框架，包含两个核心技术：1）曲率引导的异质令牌预测：使用基于物理的曲率分数估计令牌可预测性，对具有突变方向变化的混沌令牌应用Hermite引导的阻尼预测器；2）混沌优先自适应跳过：累积曲率归一化的无量纲漂移信号，仅在瓶颈令牌开始漂移时重新计算
AI.result: 在扩散世界模型上的实验表明，WorldCache实现了高达3.7倍的端到端加速，同时保持98%的推演质量，在资源受限场景中展现出显著优势和实用性
AI.conclusion: WorldCache是针对扩散世界模型的有效缓存框架，通过解决令牌异质性和非均匀时间动态性问题，显著提升了推理效率，为资源受限环境下的世界模型应用提供了实用解决方案

title: LATO: 3D Mesh Flow Matching with Structured TOpology Preserving LAtents
summary: In this paper, we introduce LATO, a novel topology-preserving latent representation that enables scalable, flow matching-based synthesis of explicit 3D meshes. LATO represents a mesh as a Vertex Displacement Field (VDF) anchored on surface, incorporating a sparse voxel Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to compress this explicit signal into a structured, topology-aware voxel latent. To decapsulate the mesh, the VAE decoder progressively subdivides and prunes latent voxels to instantiate precise vertex locations. In the end, a dedicated connection head queries the voxel latent to predict edge connectivity between vertex pairs directly, allowing mesh topology to be recovered without isosurface extraction or heuristic meshing. For generative modeling, LATO adopts a two-stage flow matching process, first synthesizing the structure voxels and subsequently refining the voxel-wise topology features. Compared to prior isosurface/triangle-based diffusion models and autoregressive generation approaches, LATO generates meshes with complex geometry, well-formed topology while being highly efficient in inference.

AI.tldr: LATO是一种新颖的拓扑保持潜在表示方法，通过顶点位移场和稀疏体素VAE实现可扩展的流匹配3D网格生成，无需等值面提取或启发式网格化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于等值面/三角形的扩散模型和自回归生成方法在生成复杂几何形状和良好拓扑结构方面存在效率问题，需要一种更高效的显式3D网格生成方法。
AI.method: LATO使用顶点位移场表示网格，通过稀疏体素VAE压缩为结构化体素潜在表示，采用两阶段流匹配过程：首先生成结构体素，然后细化体素级拓扑特征，通过连接头直接预测顶点对之间的边连接性。
AI.result: LATO能够生成具有复杂几何形状和良好拓扑结构的网格，在推理效率方面显著优于先前的等值面/三角形扩散模型和自回归生成方法。
AI.conclusion: LATO提供了一种新颖的拓扑感知潜在表示和生成框架，实现了高效、高质量的显式3D网格合成，为3D内容生成提供了新的技术路径。

title: Computer vision-based estimation of invertebrate biomass
summary: The ability to estimate invertebrate biomass using only images could help scaling up quantitative biodiversity monitoring efforts. Computer vision-based methods have the potential to omit the manual, time-consuming, and destructive process of dry weighing specimens. We present two approaches for dry mass estimation that do not require additional manual effort apart from imaging the specimens: fitting a linear model with novel predictors, automatically calculated by an imaging device, and training a family of end-to-end deep neural networks for the task, using single-view, multi-view, and metadata-aware architectures. We propose using area and sinking speed as predictors. These can be calculated with BIODISCOVER, which is a dual-camera system that captures image sequences of specimens sinking in an ethanol column. For this study, we collected a large dataset of dry mass measurement and image sequence pairs to train and evaluate models. We show that our methods can estimate specimen dry mass even with complex and visually diverse specimen morphologies. Combined with automatic taxonomic classification, our approach is an accurate method for group-level dry mass estimation, with a median percentage error of 10-20% for individuals. We highlight the importance of choosing appropriate evaluation metrics, and encourage using both percentage errors and absolute errors as metrics, because they measure different properties. We also explore different optimization losses, data augmentation methods, and model architectures for training deep-learning models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出两种基于计算机视觉的方法，通过图像自动估算无脊椎动物干重，无需传统破坏性称重过程，使用面积和沉降速度等新预测因子，结合深度学习模型实现10-20%的中位误差率。
AI.motivation: 传统无脊椎动物生物量测量需要手动、耗时且破坏性的干重称量过程，限制了生物多样性监测的规模化。本研究旨在开发仅通过图像就能估算干重的方法，提高监测效率并减少对标本的破坏。
AI.method: 提出两种方法：1）使用成像设备自动计算的新预测因子（面积和沉降速度）拟合线性模型；2）训练端到端深度神经网络家族，包括单视角、多视角和元数据感知架构。使用BIODISCOVER双相机系统捕获标本在乙醇柱中沉降的图像序列，收集大量干重测量和图像序列配对数据集。
AI.result: 方法能够估算形态复杂多样的标本干重，结合自动分类可实现群体水平的准确干重估算，个体估算中位百分比误差为10-20%。研究强调了选择适当评估指标的重要性，建议同时使用百分比误差和绝对误差。
AI.conclusion: 基于计算机视觉的干重估算方法能够替代传统破坏性称重过程，为规模化生物多样性监测提供高效解决方案。研究还探索了不同的优化损失函数、数据增强方法和模型架构，为深度学习模型训练提供了参考。

title: MoEMambaMIL: Structure-Aware Selective State Space Modeling for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis is challenging due to the gigapixel scale of slides and their inherent hierarchical multi-resolution structure. Existing multiple instance learning (MIL) approaches often model WSIs as unordered collections of patches, which limits their ability to capture structured dependencies between global tissue organization and local cellular patterns. Although recent State Space Models (SSMs) enable efficient modeling of long sequences, how to structure WSI tokens to fully exploit their spatial hierarchy remains an open problem.We propose MoEMambaMIL, a structure-aware SSM framework for WSI analysis that integrates region-nested selective scanning with mixture-of-experts (MoE) modeling. Leveraging multi-resolution preprocessing, MoEMambaMIL organizes patch tokens into region-aware sequences that preserve spatial containment across resolutions. On top of this structured sequence, we decouple resolution-aware encoding and region-adaptive contextual modeling via a combination of static, resolution-specific experts and dynamic sparse experts with learned routing. This design enables efficient long-sequence modeling while promoting expert specialization across heterogeneous diagnostic patterns. Experiments demonstrate that MoEMambaMIL achieves the best performance across 9 downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: MoEMambaMIL：一种用于全切片图像分析的结构感知状态空间模型框架，通过区域嵌套选择性扫描和混合专家建模，在多分辨率下组织补丁标记以保留空间层次结构，在9个下游任务中取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多实例学习方法将WSI视为无序补丁集合，限制了捕捉全局组织与局部模式间结构化依赖的能力。状态空间模型虽能高效建模长序列，但如何结构化WSI标记以充分利用其空间层次结构仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 提出MoEMambaMIL框架：1）多分辨率预处理，将补丁标记组织为保留跨分辨率空间包含关系的区域感知序列；2）通过静态分辨率特定专家和动态稀疏专家的组合，实现分辨率感知编码和区域自适应上下文建模；3）集成区域嵌套选择性扫描与混合专家建模。
AI.result: 实验表明MoEMambaMIL在9个下游任务中取得了最佳性能，证明了该框架在高效长序列建模和跨异构诊断模式专家专业化方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: MoEMambaMIL通过结构化序列组织和混合专家建模，有效解决了WSI分析中的空间层次结构建模问题，为全切片图像分析提供了新的高效框架。

title: CHMv2: Improvements in Global Canopy Height Mapping using DINOv3
summary: Accurate canopy height information is essential for quantifying forest carbon, monitoring restoration and degradation, and assessing habitat structure, yet high-fidelity measurements from airborne laser scanning (ALS) remain unevenly available globally. Here we present CHMv2, a global, meter-resolution canopy height map derived from high-resolution optical satellite imagery using a depth-estimation model built on DINOv3 and trained against ALS canopy height models. Compared to existing products, CHMv2 substantially improves accuracy, reduces bias in tall forests, and better preserves fine-scale structure such as canopy edges and gaps. These gains are enabled by a large expansion of geographically diverse training data, automated data curation and registration, and a loss formulation and data sampling strategy tailored to canopy height distributions. We validate CHMv2 against independent ALS test sets and against tens of millions of GEDI and ICESat-2 observations, demonstrating consistent performance across major forest biomes.

AI.tldr: CHMv2是一个基于高分辨率光学卫星影像和深度估计模型的全球米级分辨率冠层高度图，相比现有产品在精度、偏差和细节保持方面有显著提升
AI.motivation: 虽然冠层高度信息对于森林碳量化、恢复监测和栖息地评估至关重要，但全球范围内高精度的机载激光扫描测量数据分布不均，需要更广泛可用的替代方案
AI.method: 使用基于DINOv3构建的深度估计模型，从高分辨率光学卫星影像中推导冠层高度；通过大规模地理多样性训练数据、自动化数据管理和配准、针对冠层高度分布定制的损失函数和数据采样策略来实现
AI.result: CHMv2相比现有产品显著提高了精度，减少了高森林的偏差，更好地保持了冠层边缘和空隙等精细结构；在主要森林生物群落中表现出稳定的性能
AI.conclusion: CHMv2为全球森林监测提供了高质量、高分辨率的冠层高度数据，解决了现有数据可用性不均的问题，为森林碳核算和生态系统评估提供了重要工具

title: Solving Jigsaw Puzzles in the Wild: Human-Guided Reconstruction of Cultural Heritage Fragments
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 2025 IEEE 35th International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP). This is the author-accepted version of the paper. The final version is available via IEEE Xplore: https://doi.org/10.1109/MLSP62443.2025.11204324
summary: Reassembling real-world archaeological artifacts from fragmented pieces poses significant challenges due to erosion, missing regions, irregular shapes, and large-scale ambiguity. Traditional jigsaw puzzle solvers, often designed for clean synthetic scenarios, struggle under these conditions, especially when the number of fragments grows into the thousands, as in the RePAIR benchmark. In this paper, we propose a human-in-the-loop (HIL) puzzle solving framework designed to address the complexity and scale of real-world cultural heritage reconstruction. Our approach integrates an automatic relaxation-labeling solver with interactive human guidance, allowing users to iteratively lock verified placements, correct errors, and guide the system toward semantically and geometrically coherent assemblies. We introduce two complementary interaction strategies, Iterative Anchoring and Continuous Interactive Refinement, which support scalable reconstruction across varying levels of ambiguity and puzzle size. Experiments on several RePAIR groups demonstrate that our hybrid approach substantially outperforms both fully automatic and manual baselines in accuracy and efficiency, offering a practical solution for large-scale expert-in-the-loop artifact reassembly.

AI.tldr: 提出一种人机协同的考古碎片重组框架，通过交互式引导解决大规模真实文物碎片重建中的复杂性和规模问题
AI.motivation: 真实考古文物碎片重组面临侵蚀、缺失区域、不规则形状和大规模模糊性等挑战，传统拼图算法在RePAIR基准测试中处理数千碎片时表现不佳
AI.method: 提出人机协同拼图求解框架，将自动松弛标记求解器与交互式人工引导相结合，用户可迭代锁定已验证位置、纠正错误并引导系统实现语义和几何一致的组装，引入迭代锚定和连续交互优化两种互补交互策略
AI.result: 在多个RePAIR数据集上的实验表明，该混合方法在准确性和效率上显著优于全自动和手动基线方法
AI.conclusion: 为大规模专家参与式文物重组提供了实用解决方案

title: DiffInf: Influence-Guided Diffusion for Supervision Alignment in Facial Attribute Learning
summary: Facial attribute classification relies on large-scale annotated datasets in which many traits, such as age and expression, are inherently ambiguous and continuous but are discretized into categorical labels. Annotation inconsistencies arise from subjectivity and visual confounders such as pose, illumination, expression, and demographic variation, creating mismatch between images and assigned labels. These inconsistencies introduce supervision errors that impair representation learning and degrade downstream prediction. We introduce DiffInf, a self-influence--guided diffusion framework for mitigating annotation inconsistencies in facial attribute learning. We first train a baseline classifier and compute sample-wise self-influence scores using a practical first-order approximation to identify training instances that disproportionately destabilize optimization. Instead of discarding these influential samples, we apply targeted generative correction via a latent diffusion autoencoder to better align visual content with assigned labels while preserving identity and realism. To enable differentiable guidance during correction, we train a lightweight predictor of high-influence membership and use it as a surrogate influence regularizer. The edited samples replace the originals, yielding an influence-refined dataset of unchanged size. Across multi-class facial attribute classification, DiffInf consistently improves generalization compared with standard noisy-label training, robust optimization baselines, and influence-based filtering. Our results demonstrate that repairing influential annotation inconsistencies at the image level enhances downstream facial attribute classification without sacrificing distributional coverage.

AI.tldr: DiffInf：一种基于自影响引导扩散的框架，用于缓解面部属性学习中的标注不一致问题，通过生成式修正而非丢弃样本来改善分类性能。
AI.motivation: 面部属性分类依赖于大规模标注数据集，但许多属性（如年龄、表情）本质上是模糊且连续的，却被离散化为分类标签。标注不一致源于主观性和视觉混淆因素（姿态、光照、表情、人口统计变异），导致图像与标签不匹配，这些监督误差会损害表示学习并降低下游预测性能。
AI.method: 首先训练基线分类器，使用一阶近似计算样本级自影响分数，识别对优化过程有过度影响的训练实例。然后通过潜在扩散自编码器对这些高影响样本进行有针对性的生成式修正，使视觉内容与标签更好对齐，同时保持身份和真实感。训练轻量级高影响成员预测器作为替代影响正则化器，在修正过程中提供可微分指导。编辑后的样本替换原始样本，生成大小不变的影响精炼数据集。
AI.result: 在多类面部属性分类任务中，DiffInf相比标准噪声标签训练、鲁棒优化基线和基于影响的过滤方法，始终能改善泛化性能。结果表明，在图像层面修复有影响的标注不一致，可以在不牺牲分布覆盖的情况下增强下游面部属性分类。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成式修正而非丢弃样本来处理标注不一致问题，能够有效提升面部属性分类性能，同时保持数据集的完整性和分布覆盖。

title: Locating and Editing Figure-Ground Organization in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers must resolve figure-ground organization by choosing between completions driven by local geometric evidence and those favored by global organizational priors, giving rise to a characteristic perceptual ambiguity. We aim to locate where the canonical Gestalt prior convexity is realized within the internal components of BEiT. Using a controlled perceptual conflict based on synthetic shapes of darts, we systematically mask regions that equally admit either a concave completion or a convex completion. We show that BEiT reliably favors convex completion under this competition. Projecting internal activations into the model's discrete visual codebook space via logit attribution reveals that this preference is governed by identifiable functional units within transformer substructures. Specifically, we find that figure-ground organization is ambiguous through early and intermediate layers and resolves abruptly in later layers. By decomposing the direct effect of attention heads, we identify head L0H9 acting as an early seed, introducing a weak bias toward convexity. Downscaling this single attention head shifts the distributional mass of the perceptual conflict across a continuous decision boundary, allowing concave evidence to guide completion.

AI.tldr: 研究通过合成飞镖形状的感知冲突实验，发现BEiT视觉Transformer在局部几何证据与全局组织先验的竞争中倾向于凸性补全，并识别出特定注意力头L0H9作为早期种子驱动这一偏好
AI.motivation: 研究旨在定位经典格式塔先验（凸性）在BEiT模型内部组件中的实现位置，通过控制感知冲突来理解视觉Transformer如何解决图形-背景组织中的歧义
AI.method: 使用合成飞镖形状创建感知冲突，系统性地掩蔽既可接受凹性补全也可接受凸性补全的区域；通过logit归因将内部激活投影到离散视觉词表空间，分析Transformer子结构中的功能单元；分解注意力头的直接影响
AI.result: BEiT在感知冲突中可靠地偏好凸性补全；图形-背景组织在早期和中间层保持歧义，在后期层突然解决；识别出注意力头L0H9作为早期种子引入对凸性的弱偏好；下调该注意力头可使感知冲突的分布质量跨越连续决策边界，允许凹性证据引导补全
AI.conclusion: 格式塔先验凸性在BEiT模型中有明确的实现位置，由特定功能单元（如注意力头L0H9）驱动，这些单元在图形-背景组织的决策过程中扮演关键角色，可通过调控单个注意力头改变模型的感知偏好

title: Non-invasive Growth Monitoring of Small Freshwater Fish in Home Aquariums via Stereo Vision
summary: Monitoring fish growth behavior provides relevant information about fish health in aquaculture and home aquariums. Yet, monitoring fish sizes poses different challenges, as fish are small and subject to strong refractive distortions in aquarium environments. Image-based measurement offers a practical, non-invasive alternative that allows frequent monitoring without disturbing the fish. In this paper, we propose a non-invasive refraction-aware stereo vision method to estimate fish length in aquariums. Our approach uses a YOLOv11-Pose network to detect fish and predict anatomical keypoints on the fish in each stereo image. A refraction-aware epipolar constraint accounting for the air-glass-water interfaces enables robust matching, and unreliable detections are removed using a learned quality score. A subsequent refraction-aware 3D triangulation recovers 3D keypoints, from which fish length is measured. We validate our approach on a new stereo dataset of endangered Sulawesi ricefish captured under aquarium-like conditions and demonstrate that filtering low-quality detections is essential for accurate length estimation. The proposed system offers a simple and practical solution for non-invasive growth monitoring and can be easily applied in home aquariums.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于折射感知立体视觉的非侵入式鱼类长度测量方法，用于水族箱环境下的鱼类生长监测
AI.motivation: 水族箱环境中鱼类生长监测对了解鱼类健康很重要，但传统方法面临挑战：鱼类体型小且受空气-玻璃-水界面折射效应影响严重，需要非侵入式解决方案
AI.method: 使用YOLOv11-Pose网络检测鱼类并预测解剖关键点，通过折射感知的极线约束进行鲁棒匹配，利用学习质量分数过滤不可靠检测，最后进行折射感知的3D三角测量恢复关键点并计算鱼长
AI.result: 在濒危苏拉威西米鱼的新立体数据集上验证，证明过滤低质量检测对准确长度估计至关重要，系统为家庭水族箱提供简单实用的非侵入式生长监测方案
AI.conclusion: 提出的折射感知立体视觉方法为水族箱环境下的鱼类长度测量提供了有效解决方案，特别适合家庭水族箱的非侵入式生长监测应用

title: What if? Emulative Simulation with World Models for Situated Reasoning
summary: Situated reasoning often relies on active exploration, yet in many real-world scenarios such exploration is infeasible due to physical constraints of robots or safety concerns of visually impaired users. Given only a limited observation, can an agent mentally simulate a future trajectory toward a target situation and answer spatial what-if questions? We introduce WanderDream, the first large-scale dataset designed for the emulative simulation of mental exploration, enabling models to reason without active exploration. WanderDream-Gen comprises 15.8K panoramic videos across 1,088 real scenes from HM3D, ScanNet++, and real-world captures, depicting imagined trajectories from current viewpoints to target situations. WanderDream-QA contains 158K question-answer pairs, covering starting states, paths, and end states along each trajectory to comprehensively evaluate exploration-based reasoning. Extensive experiments with world models and MLLMs demonstrate (1) that mental exploration is essential for situated reasoning, (2) that world models achieve compelling performance on WanderDream-Gen, (3) that imagination substantially facilitates reasoning on WanderDream-QA, and (4) that WanderDream data exhibit remarkable transferability to real-world scenarios. The source code and all data will be released.

AI.tldr: WanderDream是首个用于心理探索模拟的大规模数据集，包含全景视频和问答对，使模型能够在无需实际探索的情况下进行空间推理
AI.motivation: 在现实场景中，由于机器人物理限制或视障用户安全考虑，主动探索往往不可行。需要让智能体仅凭有限观察就能心理模拟未来轨迹并回答空间假设问题
AI.method: 构建WanderDream数据集：WanderDream-Gen包含15.8K个全景视频，覆盖1,088个真实场景；WanderDream-QA包含158K个问答对，涵盖轨迹的起始状态、路径和结束状态
AI.result: 实验表明：(1)心理探索对情境推理至关重要；(2)世界模型在WanderDream-Gen上表现优异；(3)想象力显著促进WanderDream-QA的推理；(4)数据在真实场景中具有良好迁移性
AI.conclusion: WanderDream为无需主动探索的心理模拟提供了首个大规模数据集，证明了心理探索对空间推理的重要性，并展示了世界模型和想象力在解决这类问题中的有效性

title: CaTok: Taming Mean Flows for One-Dimensional Causal Image Tokenization
comment: Project website is available in https://sharelab-sii.github.io/catok-web
summary: Autoregressive (AR) language models rely on causal tokenization, but extending this paradigm to vision remains non-trivial. Current visual tokenizers either flatten 2D patches into non-causal sequences or enforce heuristic orderings that misalign with the "next-token prediction" pattern. Recent diffusion autoencoders similarly fall short: conditioning the decoder on all tokens lacks causality, while applying nested dropout mechanism introduces imbalance. To address these challenges, we present CaTok, a 1D causal image tokenizer with a MeanFlow decoder. By selecting tokens over time intervals and binding them to the MeanFlow objective, as illustrated in Fig. 1, CaTok learns causal 1D representations that support both fast one-step generation and high-fidelity multi-step sampling, while naturally capturing diverse visual concepts across token intervals. To further stabilize and accelerate training, we propose a straightforward regularization REPA-A, which aligns encoder features with Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Experiments demonstrate that CaTok achieves state-of-the-art results on ImageNet reconstruction, reaching 0.75 FID, 22.53 PSNR and 0.674 SSIM with fewer training epochs, and the AR model attains performance comparable to leading approaches.

AI.tldr: CaTok是一种1D因果图像分词器，通过MeanFlow解码器和时间间隔选择机制，解决了视觉AR模型中因果表示学习的挑战，在ImageNet重建上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉分词器存在两个主要问题：1）将2D图像块展平为非因果序列，或使用启发式排序与"下一token预测"模式不匹配；2）扩散自编码器要么缺乏因果性，要么引入不平衡。需要一种能支持因果1D表示并兼容AR语言模型范式的视觉分词器。
AI.method: 提出CaTok：1）通过时间间隔选择token并绑定到MeanFlow目标，学习因果1D表示；2）支持快速一步生成和高保真多步采样；3）提出REPA-A正则化，将编码器特征与视觉基础模型对齐，稳定和加速训练。
AI.result: 在ImageNet重建上达到SOTA：FID 0.75，PSNR 22.53，SSIM 0.674，且训练轮次更少。AR模型性能与领先方法相当。
AI.conclusion: CaTok成功解决了视觉因果表示学习的挑战，提供了一种有效的1D因果图像分词方案，支持高效的图像生成和重建，为视觉AR模型的发展提供了重要基础。

title: Pinterest Canvas: Large-Scale Image Generation at Pinterest
summary: While recent image generation models demonstrate a remarkable ability to handle a wide variety of image generation tasks, this flexibility makes them hard to control via prompting or simple inference adaptation alone, rendering them unsuitable for use cases with strict product requirements. In this paper, we introduce Pinterest Canvas, our large-scale image generation system built to support image editing and enhancement use cases at Pinterest. Canvas is first trained on a diverse, multimodal dataset to produce a foundational diffusion model with broad image-editing capabilities. However, rather than relying on one generic model to handle every downstream task, we instead rapidly fine-tune variants of this base model on task-specific datasets, producing specialized models for individual use cases. We describe key components of Canvas and summarize our best practices for dataset curation, training, and inference. We also showcase task-specific variants through case studies on background enhancement and aspect-ratio outpainting, highlighting how we tackle their specific product requirements. Online A/B experiments demonstrate that our enhanced images receive a significant 18.0% and 12.5% engagement lift, respectively, and comparisons with human raters further validate that our models outperform third-party models on these tasks. Finally, we showcase other Canvas variants, including multi-image scene synthesis and image-to-video generation, demonstrating that our approach can generalize to a wide variety of potential downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: Pinterest开发了Canvas大规模图像生成系统，通过基础扩散模型+任务特定微调的方法，支持图像编辑和增强用例，在背景增强和宽高比外绘等任务上取得显著效果提升。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型虽然灵活但难以通过提示或简单推理适配进行精确控制，不适合有严格产品要求的用例。Pinterest需要专门支持图像编辑和增强任务的系统。
AI.method: 首先在多样化多模态数据集上训练基础扩散模型，然后针对具体下游任务快速微调，生成专门化模型。介绍了数据集管理、训练和推理的最佳实践。
AI.result: 在线A/B实验显示增强图像分别获得18.0%和12.5%的参与度提升；人工评估表明模型在这些任务上优于第三方模型。系统还可推广到多图像场景合成和图像到视频生成等任务。
AI.conclusion: Canvas系统通过基础模型+任务特定微调的方法，有效解决了产品化图像生成的需求，在多个图像编辑任务上表现出色，并展示了良好的泛化能力。

title: Training Flow Matching: The Role of Weighting and Parameterization
summary: We study the training objectives of denoising-based generative models, with a particular focus on loss weighting and output parameterization, including noise-, clean image-, and velocity-based formulations. Through a systematic numerical study, we analyze how these training choices interact with the intrinsic dimensionality of the data manifold, model architecture, and dataset size. Our experiments span synthetic datasets with controlled geometry as well as image data, and compare training objectives using quantitative metrics for denoising accuracy (PSNR across noise levels) and generative quality (FID). Rather than proposing a new method, our goal is to disentangle the various factors that matter when training a flow matching model, in order to provide practical insights on design choices.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了去噪生成模型的训练目标，重点关注损失权重和输出参数化（噪声、干净图像、速度）等设计选择，以及它们与数据流形内在维度、模型架构和数据集大小的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 当前去噪生成模型有多种训练目标设计选择（如损失权重、输出参数化），但缺乏对这些选择如何与数据特性、模型架构等因素相互作用的系统性理解。研究旨在理清训练流匹配模型时各种因素的影响，为实际设计提供指导。
AI.method: 通过系统数值研究，在合成数据集（可控几何结构）和图像数据上实验，分析不同训练目标（噪声、干净图像、速度参数化）与数据内在维度、模型架构、数据集大小的相互作用。使用PSNR（去噪精度）和FID（生成质量）作为评估指标。
AI.result: 研究提供了关于训练目标设计选择的实用见解，揭示了损失权重、输出参数化与数据特性（如内在维度）、模型架构等因素之间的相互作用关系。这些发现有助于指导实际训练去噪生成模型时的设计决策。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统分析了去噪生成模型训练目标的关键设计选择，理清了各种因素（损失权重、输出参数化、数据特性、模型架构等）的相互作用，为训练流匹配模型提供了实用的设计指导，而非提出新方法。

title: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
summary: Strong semantic representations improve the convergence and generation quality of diffusion and flow models. Existing approaches largely rely on external models, which require separate training, operate on misaligned objectives, and exhibit unexpected scaling behavior. We argue that this dependence arises from the model's training objective, which poses a denoising task with little incentive to learn semantic representations. We introduce Self-Flow: a self-supervised flow matching paradigm that integrates representation learning within the generative framework. Our key mechanism, Dual-Timestep Scheduling, applies heterogeneous noise levels across tokens, creating an information asymmetry that forces the model to infer missing information from corrupted inputs. This drives learning strong representations alongside generative capabilities without external supervision. Our method generalizes across modalities and enables multi-modal training while following expected scaling laws, achieving superior image, video, and audio generation.

AI.tldr: Self-Flow：一种自监督流匹配范式，通过双时间步调度机制在生成框架内集成表征学习，无需外部模型监督
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖外部模型存在三个问题：需要单独训练、目标不一致、缩放行为不可预测。这种依赖源于生成模型的训练目标（去噪任务）缺乏学习语义表征的激励
AI.method: 提出Self-Flow自监督流匹配范式，核心机制是双时间步调度：在不同token上应用异构噪声水平，创建信息不对称，迫使模型从损坏输入中推断缺失信息
AI.result: 方法跨模态通用，支持多模态训练，遵循预期缩放规律，在图像、视频和音频生成上取得优越性能
AI.conclusion: Self-Flow成功将表征学习集成到生成框架中，无需外部监督即可同时学习强语义表征和生成能力

title: SCAN: Visual Explanations with Self-Confidence and Analysis Networks
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) has become essential in computer vision to make the decision-making processes of deep learning models transparent. However, current visual explanation (XAI) methods face a critical trade-off between the high fidelity of architecture-specific methods and the broad applicability of universal ones. This often results in abstract or fragmented explanations and makes it difficult to compare explanatory power across diverse model families, such as CNNs and Transformers. This paper introduces the Self-Confidence and Analysis Networks (SCAN), a novel universal framework that overcomes these limitations for both convolutional neural network and transformer architectures. SCAN utilizes an AutoEncoder-based approach to reconstruct features from a model's intermediate layers. Guided by the Information Bottleneck principle, it generates a high-resolution Self-Confidence Map that identifies information-rich regions. Extensive experiments on diverse architectures and datasets demonstrate that SCAN consistently achieves outstanding performance on various quantitative metrics such as AUC-D, Negative AUC, Drop%, and Win%. Qualitatively, it produces significantly clearer, object-focused explanations than existing methods. By providing a unified framework that is both architecturally universal and highly faithful, SCAN enhances model transparency and offers a more reliable tool for understanding the decision-making processes of complex neural networks.

AI.tldr: SCAN是一个通用的可解释AI框架，通过AutoEncoder重建特征并基于信息瓶颈原理生成高分辨率置信度图，为CNN和Transformer提供清晰、对象聚焦的解释。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉解释方法面临架构特定方法的高保真度与通用方法的广泛适用性之间的权衡，导致解释抽象或碎片化，难以在不同模型架构（如CNN和Transformer）之间比较解释能力。
AI.method: SCAN采用基于AutoEncoder的方法重建模型中间层特征，遵循信息瓶颈原理生成高分辨率自置信度图，识别信息丰富区域，为卷积神经网络和Transformer架构提供统一框架。
AI.result: 在多种架构和数据集上的实验表明，SCAN在各种定量指标（如AUC-D、Negative AUC、Drop%、Win%）上表现优异，定性分析显示其产生的解释比现有方法更清晰、更聚焦于对象。
AI.conclusion: SCAN提供了一个既架构通用又高度保真的统一框架，增强了模型透明度，为理解复杂神经网络的决策过程提供了更可靠的工具。

title: AV-Unified: A Unified Framework for Audio-visual Scene Understanding
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: When humans perceive the world, they naturally integrate multiple audio-visual tasks within dynamic, real-world scenes. However, current works such as event localization, parsing, segmentation and question answering are mostly explored individually, making it challenging to comprehensively understand complex audio-visual scenes and explore inter-task relationships. Hence, we propose \textbf{AV-Unified}, a unified framework that enables joint learning across a wide range of audio-visual scene understanding tasks. AV-Unified standardizes the diverse input-output formats of each task and incorporates a multi-scale spatiotemporal perception network to effectively capture audio-visual associations. Specifically, we unify the inputs and outputs of all supported tasks by converting them into sequences of discrete tokens, establishing a shared representation that allows a single architecture to be trained jointly across heterogeneous varied datasets. Considering the varying temporal granularity of audio-visual events, a multi-scale temporal perception module is designed to capture key cues. Meanwhile, to overcome the lack of auditory supervision in the visual domain, we design a cross-modal guidance-based spatial perception module that models spatial audio-visual associations. Furthermore, task-specific text prompts are employed to enhance the model's adaptability and task-awareness. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets (e.g., AVE, LLP, MUSIC-AVQA, VGG-SS and AVS) demonstrate the effectiveness of AV-Unified across temporal, spatial, and spatiotemporal tasks.

AI.tldr: AV-Unified是一个统一的音频-视觉场景理解框架，通过将多任务输入输出标准化为离散token序列，实现跨异构数据集的联合学习，包含多尺度时空感知模块和跨模态引导机制。
AI.motivation: 当前音频-视觉任务（如事件定位、解析、分割、问答）大多独立研究，难以全面理解复杂音频-视觉场景和探索任务间关系，需要统一框架进行联合学习。
AI.method: 1) 将所有任务输入输出标准化为离散token序列，建立共享表示；2) 设计多尺度时间感知模块捕捉不同时间粒度的音频-视觉事件；3) 设计基于跨模态引导的空间感知模块建模空间音频-视觉关联；4) 使用任务特定文本提示增强模型适应性和任务感知能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集（AVE、LLP、MUSIC-AVQA、VGG-SS、AVS）上的广泛实验表明，AV-Unified在时间、空间和时空任务上均表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: AV-Unified通过统一框架实现了多种音频-视觉场景理解任务的联合学习，标准化输入输出格式并设计多尺度时空感知机制，为全面理解复杂音频-视觉场景提供了有效解决方案。

title: Spatial Calibration of Diffuse LiDARs
